Their unsettling, tendriled form exudes the bottomless obsession of a voidsent sovereign.","enhanced_description":"Found in the Unmaking, these unsettling wings are reminiscent of Enuo, the dread voidsent who had made their domain in the ocean's depths. While their origin is shrouded in mystery, only one whose inner light can repel all-consuming nothingness can hope to bear them.","tooltip":"All shall return to nothingness!    - Emperor Xande","movement":"Airborne","seats":1,"custom_music":true,"order":354,"order_group":30506,"patch":"7.5","item_id":52270,"tradeable":false,"owned":"0.1%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/444.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/444.png","sources":[{"type":"Trial","text":"The Unmaking (Extreme)","related_type":"Instance","related_id":1116}]},{"id":432,"name":"Rocket Punch","description":"Call into action your rocket punch. When an incident occurred which saw riders swept out to sea, however, it was decided that the units would be fitted with wind crystals, that festival-goers may fly to safety in the event of an emergency.","tooltip":"All kinds of things come floating in on the waves.    - Zukin","movement":"Airborne","seats":1,"custom_music":false,"order":335,"order_group":402,"patch":"7.5","item_id":52258,"tradeable":false,"owned":"0%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/417.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/417.png","sources":[{"type":"Event","text":"Moonfire Faire (2026)","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":359,"name":"Alexandrian Axe Beak","description":"Summon forth your Alexandrian axe beak, a reptilian bird favored of the merchant Rowena. Not to be confused with the beast native to Thanalan.","enhanced_description":"Under the patronage of its mistress Rowena, this reptilian bird has led a pampered life. However, when a customer requested a specimen of the beast of the same name native to Thanalan, it was mistakenly transported all the way from Tural. The error did not come to light until it was too late, and the creature ended up in your care.","tooltip":"How do you hope to survive with even more beaks to feed?    - Sanu Vanu","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":false,"order":295,"order_group":1220,"patch":"7.5","item_id":44504,"tradeable":true,"owned":"0.2%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/359.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/359.png","sources":[{"type":"Wondrous Tails","text":"600 Faux Leaves","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":337,"name":"Alsvid","description":"Summon forth Alsvid, a unicorn whose rainbow hair makes it the rarest of its kind─a veritable unicorn among unicorns.","enhanced_description":"Legend holds that this unicorn, possessed of splendid rainbow hair, is destined to bear a soul who embodies the brilliance of the sun. In seeming confirmation of said legend, the creature spurns ordinary riders, and lends its back only to the Warrior of Light.","tooltip":"Spying on you is as simple as sliding down the back of a rainbow.    - Feo Ul","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":true,"order":275,"order_group":30020,"patch":"7.5","item_id":41498,"tradeable":false,"owned":"0%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/337.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/337.png","sources":[]},{"id":427,"name":"Royal Magicked Carpet","description":"Summon forth your royal magicked carpet, and set forth to see the world shining, shimmering, splendid.","enhanced_description":"According to Corvosi legend, there once lived a king who had a pari for a lover. At the monarch's behest, she wove an array of flying carpets, but his promiscuity led her to set fire to her handiworks in anger. This example was the only one to survive the blaze...or so certain peddlers might claim.","tooltip":"They have carpets. *Flying* carpets!    - G'raha Tia","movement":"Airborne","seats":1,"custom_music":true,"order":342,"order_group":16081,"patch":"7.45","item_id":50447,"tradeable":true,"owned":"0.3%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/427.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/427.png","sources":[{"type":"V&C Dungeon","text":"Trisassant - Old Sharlayan - 100 Pieces of Corvosi Brass","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":421,"name":"Hardy-Daytona","description":"Call into battle your Hardy-Daytona, a lore-bending battlebike that will have you feeling as though you were playing a minigame.","enhanced_description":"Designed for battle, the Hardy-Daytona is propelled by a V-type double overhead camshaft engine that produces so much power, it is regarded as a monster of a machine that chooses its rider. Rumor holds it was developed by the weapons division of a mega-corporation, but the truth of its origin cannot be verified.","tooltip":"Try catching us now, ya bastards!    - Burly Man","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":true,"order":338,"order_group":10181,"patch":"7.45","item_id":50443,"tradeable":false,"owned":"0.4%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/421.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/421.png","sources":[{"type":"Premium","text":"Online Store","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":412,"name":"Genie of the Lamp","description":"Summon forth your genie of the lamp. Not the actual being of legend so cannot grant wishes─unless your wish is to be carried somewhere.","enhanced_description":"In the region of Corvos, there exists a legend of a lamp-dwelling spirit that grants wishes to its master. As this particular entity is an imitation later brought forth by a sorcerer, it is far from the omnipotent being described in tales, but in accordance with its creator's design, it will dutifully carry you wherever you wish to go.","tooltip":"What child wouldn't have wanted a friend like that?    - Beruru","movement":"Airborne","seats":1,"custom_music":true,"order":330,"order_group":7180,"patch":"7.45","item_id":50438,"tradeable":true,"owned":"0.2%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/412.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/412.png","sources":[{"type":"V&C Dungeon","text":"Another Merchant's Tale","related_type":"Instance","related_id":1079},{"type":"V&C Dungeon","text":"Trisassant - Old Sharlayan - 100 Corvosi Manuscripts","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":426,"name":"Alert Red Warp Loader","description":"Call into action your alert red warp loader, and bulldoze your way through life faster.","enhanced_description":"The six-wheeled warp loader, tireless workhorse of the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, has been reimagined in spirited red. Although it is identical to the original yellow variant in practically every other way, the new color scheme has proven very popular among the Loporrits.","tooltip":"Warp loaders are simply the best!    - Cosmic Exploration Initiative Member","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":true,"order":341,"order_group":10261,"patch":"7.41","item_id":50446,"tradeable":true,"owned":"1.4%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/426.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/426.png","sources":[{"type":"Cosmic Exploration","text":"20,000 Cosmocredits","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":425,"name":"Rapid-fab Vacuum Suit","description":"Summon forth your rapid-fab vacuum suit, and live the dream of piloting a futuristic bipedal machina.","enhanced_description":"Created for the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, this mass-production model construction machina incorporates innovative engineering to minimize manufacturing cost without sacrificing performance. It primarily serves as a mode of transport for initiative members.","tooltip":"We've gone ahead and licensed the design for mass production.    - Biggs","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":true,"order":340,"order_group":10253,"patch":"7.41","item_id":50445,"tradeable":true,"owned":"1.5%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/425.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/425.png","sources":[{"type":"Cosmic Exploration","text":"20,000 Cosmocredits","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":416,"name":"Cosmic Armored Weapon","description":"Call into battle your cosmic armored weapon, a deadly imperial warmachina-turned-handy (leggy?) exploration vehicle.","enhanced_description":"This imperial warmachina has been adapted for use in the Cosmic Exploration Initiative. Its low stance and arachnoid legs combine to provide exceptional stability, allowing it to perform tasks with aplomb on Oizys, a planet where gravitational anomalies are a regularity.","tooltip":"Be sure you're properly armed and armored before beginning your task.    - Nahctahr","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":true,"order":334,"order_group":10270,"patch":"7.41","item_id":50442,"tradeable":true,"owned":"1.2%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/416.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/416.png","sources":[{"type":"Cosmic Exploration","text":"60 Oizys Token Booklets","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":415,"name":"Volatile Gravity Vacuum Suit","description":"Summon forth your volatile gravity vacuum suit, and live the dream of piloting a futuristic bipedal machina.","enhanced_description":"Created for the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, this construction machina was developed to handle the gravitational anomalies that rack Oizys. On account of its considerable bulk, along with its somewhat unwieldy model name, many initiative members have taken to fondly referring to it by the epithet “Big Boy.”","tooltip":"I'm the pilot, not you!    - Rex","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":true,"order":333,"order_group":10252,"patch":"7.41","item_id":50441,"tradeable":true,"owned":"1.9%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/415.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/415.png","sources":[{"type":"Cosmic Exploration","text":"Cosmic Fortune - Oizys","related_type":null,"related_id":null},{"type":"Cosmic Exploration","text":"Mech Pilot Reward - Oizys","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":371,"name":"Cosmic Countenance","description":"Summon forth your cosmic countenance, a Loporrit-designed defense system that serves with a smile─albeit an unsettling one.","enhanced_description":"Originally created to protect Smileton, this machina has the appearance of a face that smiles at residents and grimaces at trespassers. When the construction of the settlement was suspended with the forestalling of the Final Days, this unit was repurposed for general support duties.","tooltip":"Let's get out there and serve up some smiles, eh?    - Jammingway","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":true,"order":328,"order_group":16200,"patch":"7.41","item_id":50435,"tradeable":true,"owned":"0.5%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/371.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/371.png","sources":[{"type":"Cosmic Exploration","text":"Gold Ancient Record","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":428,"name":"Turali Snowman","description":"Summon forth your Turali snowman, and frolic as only Ryoqor Terteh can.","enhanced_description":"A snowman designed in the likeness of Ryoqor Terteh, one of the playful spirits that call Worqor Zormor home. Said spirit is known to disguise itself as a snowman in order to sneak into settlements─a trick which you can now also perform thanks to the enchantment which allows this imitation to carry a single person.","tooltip":"Have you ever beheld such a magnificent snowman!?    - Frost Fanatic","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":false,"order":343,"order_group":15011,"patch":"7.4","item_id":50448,"tradeable":false,"owned":"0%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/428.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/428.png","sources":[{"type":"Achievement","text":"Worqor and Peace V","related_type":"Achievement","related_id":3835}]},{"id":422,"name":"Wings of Mist","description":"Manifest your wings of mist. Their eldritch aura exudes an unstoppable resolve.","enhanced_description":"Found along the railroad tracks near Treno, these eldritch wings are reminiscent of the Doomtrain, the monstrous locomotive that had sped nonstop across the Mist Continent for long years. While their origin is shrouded in mystery, they exude the steely resolve of one who walks levin-ravaged wastes.","tooltip":"It's a veritable calamity on rails.    - Eyaney","movement":"Airborne","seats":1,"custom_music":true,"order":339,"order_group":30505,"patch":"7.4","item_id":50444,"tradeable":false,"owned":"0.4%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/422.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/422.png","sources":[{"type":"Trial","text":"Hell on Rails (Extreme)","related_type":"Instance","related_id":1077}]},{"id":414,"name":"Uolon","description":"Summon forth your uolon, a great big beast that tends the forest with a great big grin.","enhanced_description":"This enormous beastkin native to the temperate forests of eastern Yok Tural is believed to be closely related to trolls and yetis. Possessed of exceptional intelligence, it has been observed accelerating plant growth by way of peculiar dances and aetheric emissions, a behavior that has earned it the attention of scholars.","tooltip":"I'd have to recommend an uolon bristle hairbrush.    - Vapli","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":false,"order":332,"order_group":1181,"patch":"7.4","item_id":50440,"tradeable":false,"owned":"0%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/414.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/414.png","sources":[{"type":"Event","text":"Moogle Treasure Trove Event","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":413,"name":"Lowrider T1RANT","description":"Call into battle your Lowrider T1RANT, and rule the roads with an iron fist (around the custom leather-bound steering wheel).","enhanced_description":"This vintage vehicle manufactured in Lindblum once belonged to the president of the Arcadion, who had inherited it from his forebears. It was comprehensively modified with cutting-edge technology for the Tyrant's use, and boasts enhanced flight capabilities as well as the latest comforts, the better to lord it over the peasants.","tooltip":"Not bad for an antique...    - Vitus quo Messalla","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":true,"order":331,"order_group":10241,"patch":"7.4","item_id":50439,"tradeable":false,"owned":"0.7%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/413.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/413.png","sources":[{"type":"Raid","text":"AAC Heavyweight M4 (Savage)","related_type":"Instance","related_id":1075}]},{"id":411,"name":"Dynamite","description":"Summon forth your dynamite, a soulkin favored of the merchant Rowena. House-trained and should therefore not explode in a fiery conflagration.","enhanced_description":"A variety of fiend that is brought to life when an inanimate rock is imbued with aether. Due to the possibility that it harbors precious stones, this specimen was acquired by Rowena and entrusted to the care of Khloe Aliapoh. As a result, it has become so familiar with people that it is willing to carry a rider.","tooltip":"Oh, d-dear... A swarm of dynamite has drifted inside the burrow!    - Warringway","movement":"Airborne","seats":1,"custom_music":false,"order":329,"order_group":7170,"patch":"7.4","item_id":50437,"tradeable":true,"owned":"0.6%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/411.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/411.png","sources":[{"type":"Wondrous Tails","text":"600 Faux Leaves","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":394,"name":"Wanyudo","description":"Summon forth your wanyudo, and hold on for dear life as the nightmare rolls on.","enhanced_description":"Appearing as an oxcart wheel adorned with a demonic face, this automaton originating from the Far East is created in the likeness of mythical apparitions that steal the souls of any who look upon them. While originally intended to repel intruders, it can also serve as a mode of transport for those with sufficient endurance.","tooltip":"Creaky wheels get the grease around here!    - Nitowikwe","movement":"Airborne","seats":1,"custom_music":false,"order":315,"order_group":7160,"patch":"7.4","item_id":50436,"tradeable":false,"owned":"1.6%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/394.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/394.png","sources":[{"type":"PvP","text":"PvP Series 10 - Level 25","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":408,"name":"Ornamental Shrublet","description":"Summon forth your ornamental shrublet. Seeks either revenge or proliferation or both on its way to a new land.","enhanced_description":"This ambulating plant appears to be an offshoot of the ornamental shrubs you encountered along Pilgrim's Traverse. Though it is unclear whether it desires revenge for its fallen parents or simply wishes to sow its seeds in faraway lands, it has seemingly decided to follow you.","tooltip":"Only the most fearsome bits of shrubbery get given elite mark status.    - Aytienne","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":true,"order":327,"order_group":4521,"patch":"7.35","item_id":47335,"tradeable":true,"owned":"0.5%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/408.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/408.png","sources":[{"type":"Deep Dungeon","text":"Pilgrim's Traverse - Silver Sack","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":379,"name":"Pilgrim's Protector","description":"Summon forth the pilgrim's protector, a wandering worshiper's best friend.","enhanced_description":"A white-furred beast native to lands formerly belonging to the Kingdom of Voeburt. They can be domesticated if raised from birth, and were known to escort adherents of the Church of the First Light on pilgrimages. Due to its exceptional docility, this specimen is believed to be descended from such trained creatures.","tooltip":"There is much I could learn from your pilgrimage.    - Hien","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":false,"order":325,"order_group":3650,"patch":"7.35","item_id":47334,"tradeable":true,"owned":"0.3%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/379.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/379.png","sources":[{"type":"Deep Dungeon","text":"99 First Light Relics","related_type":null,"related_id":null},{"type":"Deep Dungeon","text":"Pilgrim's Traverse - Sack of First Light","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":403,"name":"Chandelier of First Light","description":"Summon forth your chandelier of First Light, and live like tomorrow doesn't exist. Alloyed gilding has since been discovered to dampen the effects of elemental charges and is now standard-issue.","tooltip":"You ditched your magitek armor!? Fool of a Lalafell!   - Biggs","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":true,"order":10,"order_group":10001,"patch":"2.1","item_id":6993,"tradeable":false,"owned":"34%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/21.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/21.png","sources":[{"type":"Achievement","text":"Everybody's Darling","related_type":"Achievement","related_id":862}]},{"id":20,"name":"Laurel Goobbue","description":"Summon your laurel goobbue, towering friend to the sylphs.","enhanced_description":"After having the moss and flowers growing upon his head pulled up and tossed aside like common weeds by a band of sylvan ne'er-do-wells, this quiet-mannered goobbue was taken in and cared for by the sylphs of Little Solace whose elders crafted for him a magnificent laurel with which to hide his scars.","tooltip":"Naught is as exhilarating as a romp through the forest on goobbueback.   - Unknown","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":false,"order":9,"order_group":1001,"patch":"2.1","item_id":6992,"tradeable":false,"owned":"27%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/20.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/20.png","sources":[{"type":"Tribal","text":"Sylphic Vendor - Little Solace (East Shroud) - 120,000 Gil (Rank 4)","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":19,"name":"Cavalry Drake","description":"Summon your cavalry drake, trained by the drake whisperer of the Brotherhood of Ash.","enhanced_description":"Training a cavalry drake is a long and arduous process that begins the moment the scalekin hatches. Never allowed to see its mother, the creature is raised solely in the presence of a drake whisperer while being weaned on the incendiary glands of aged battle drakes to ensure it is both submissive and deadly.","tooltip":"You are as a lost kitten that has wandered into the drake's lair.   - Zagozz Teh","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":false,"order":8,"order_group":3220,"patch":"2.1","item_id":6991,"tradeable":false,"owned":"25%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/19.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/19.png","sources":[{"type":"Tribal","text":"Amalj'aa Vendor - Ring of Ash (Southern Thanalan) - 120,000 Gil (Rank 4)","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":18,"name":"Behemoth","description":"Summon your mighty behemoth, trained from birth to carry you...not trample you underfoot like an ant.","enhanced_description":"Immediately following the Calamity, an adventurer returning to Gridania from Falcon's Nest in Coerthas claims to have happened upon a den of baby behemoths who had lost their mother. Despite objections from friends and family alike, she kept the beasts, eventually training them to serve as mounts.","tooltip":"Do not presume to provoke the behemoth to battle. You will die.   - Meurise","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":false,"order":7,"order_group":3210,"patch":"2.1","item_id":6990,"tradeable":false,"owned":"63%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/18.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/18.png","sources":[{"type":"Achievement","text":"Jonathas - Old Gridania - 6 Achievement Certificates","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":15,"name":"Unicorn","description":"Summon forth the single-horned steed you befriended in the Black Shroud.","enhanced_description":"Not long ago, Eorzean unicorns numbered in the thousands, and could oft be seen roaming the Coerthas highlands in great majestic herds that would render the mountains white as snow. Now, but a handful of skilled tamers living in recluse on the Pearl are said to be able to train them.","tooltip":"Hey, good lookin'! Catch my coeurl yet?   - Swygrael","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":false,"order":4,"order_group":3200,"patch":"2.0","item_id":6007,"tradeable":false,"owned":"32%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/8.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/8.png","sources":[{"type":"Premium","text":"A Realm Reborn Collector's Edition","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":6,"name":"Magitek Armor","description":"Call into battle your suit of Garlond Ironworks-modified magitek armor.","enhanced_description":"This suit of Garlean-developed reaper-class magitek battle armor has had its original control systems purged and replaced with a new, modified core built by Cid of the Garlond Ironworks.","tooltip":"At last, our very own suit of magitek armor!   - Cid Garlond","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":true,"order":3,"order_group":10000,"patch":"2.0","item_id":6008,"tradeable":false,"owned":"88%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/6.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/6.png","sources":[{"type":"Quest","text":"The Ultimate Weapon","related_type":"Quest","related_id":66060}]},{"id":5,"name":"Legacy Chocobo","description":"Five years and a realm-shaking Calamity were not enough to break the bonds between you and your loyal steed. A single whistle and he will be at your side once again.","enhanced_description":"In the five years following your sudden disappearance from the Carteneau Flats, your ever-faithful chocobo spent each waking moment galloping across the realm in search of his lost master. His myriad adventures are nothing less than fantastical and heartbreaking...but that is a story for another day.","tooltip":"Go find the chocobo you rode in on, and ride on out.   - Sevrin","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":false,"order":2,"order_group":101,"patch":"2.0","item_id":6006,"tradeable":false,"owned":"1.3%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/5.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/5.png","sources":[{"type":"Other","text":"Legacy Campaign","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":4,"name":"Goobbue","description":"Use the odd-shaped horn gifted to you by the wandering minstrel to call a massive goobbue to your side.","enhanced_description":"Traded for a song by the High Satrap of a distant land, the secret to taming these creatures once thought to be unbreakable was introduced to Eorzea by a mysterious wandering minstrel who journeyed through the realm in the final days before the Calamity.","tooltip":"Would that I had the girth of a goobbue!   - Nanamo Ul Namo","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":false,"order":1,"order_group":1000,"patch":"2.0","item_id":6002,"tradeable":false,"owned":"0.7%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/4.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/4.png","sources":[{"type":"Other","text":"At level 30 or above, speak with the Wandering Minstrel in Eastern La Noscea (Final Fantasy XIV 1.0)","related_type":null,"related_id":null}]},{"id":1,"name":"Company Chocobo","description":"Summon your Grand Company-issued battle chocobo.","enhanced_description":"Born and bred in the city–state of Ishgard, the majority of company chocobos are geldings of the rouncey variety; however, massive destriers and miniature Belah'dian jennets are also raised to accommodate the builds of Roegadyn and Lalafellin riders respectively.","tooltip":"Chocobos are stout-hearted creatures, but they have their limits.   - Mimigun","movement":"Terrestrial","seats":1,"custom_music":false,"order":0,"order_group":100,"patch":"2.0","item_id":6001,"tradeable":false,"owned":"96%","image":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/large/1.png","icon":"https://ffxivcollect.com/images/mounts/small/1.png","sources":[{"type":"Quest","text":"My Little Chocobo (Immortal Flames)","related_type":"Quest","related_id":66238},{"type":"Quest","text":"My Little Chocobo (Maelstrom)","related_type":"Quest","related_id":66237},{"type":"Quest","text":"My Little Chocobo (Twin Adder)","related_type":"Quest","related_id":66236}]}]

minions.enhanced_description: Raised by a flame private from an egg found abandoned in the company stables he was charged with cleaning, this adorable fledgling is a symbol of new beginnings for the Immortal Flames.
minions.name: Flame Hatchling
minions.tooltip: Chocobo dander can be a mite ripe.   - Chocobokeep

verminion.skill_description: Reduces action points of all enemies within range by 50% of the maximum value.

minions.description: Summon your morbol seedling minion...if you think you can stand his breath.
minions.enhanced_description: It is in fashion amongst wealthy Ul'dahn merchants and nobles to bring morbol seedlings to banquets, so that the upper crust might inhale the seedkin's “boot-like” bad breath to induce vomiting, allowing them to engorge themselves for the duration of the gatherings.

minions.tooltip: Did a morbol just empty its innards? I feel ill...   - Imperial Soldier

minions.enhanced_description: It was only recently that an enterprising merchant from the Sapphire Avenue Exchange in Ul'dah was tossed into the sultanate's oubliettes for fluffing the tails of rats caught on Pearl Lane and selling prettied pests to tourists as “tiny squirrels.”
minions.name: Tiny Rat

sources.text: Chachamun - Highbridge (Eastern Thanalan) - 2,400 Gil (Requires FATE "Attack on Highbridge: Act III")

minions.tooltip: Pray waste no time chasing rats.   - Nanamo Ul Namo

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces DEF of all enemies within range by 25%.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your baby bun minion. Tastes great on salads and in stews.
minions.enhanced_description: For those wondering on the ill effects of inhaling spores released by common funguars, according to the *Encyclopedia Eorzea* (third edition), funguar spores “befoul the body's humours and claim control of an individual's very soul, rendering them a mindless thrall.”
minions.name: Baby Bun
minions.tooltip: You mushroom-headed, spindly-legged, spore-spewing abominations!   - Gabineaux

verminion.skill_description:

minions.description: Summon your chigoe larva minion. This tiny vilekin takes the blood pact with his master *very* seriously.
minions.enhanced_description: Chirurgeons of the fallen city of Gelmorra once used chigoes to leech the dark humours of the infirm until it was realized the patients were contracting additional maladies as a result of the treatment.
minions.name: Chigoe Larva
minions.tooltip: What am I going to do with a pile of dead vilekin?   - Waltheof

verminion.skill_description:

minions.description: Summon your bluebird minion. Known to retroactively bring good fortune to those who have already experienced good fortune.
minions.enhanced_description: Fortunate to hatch before being eaten by lizards. Unfortunate to fall from its nest before learning to fly. Fortunate to land in an empty treasure coffer. Unfortunate to still be in said coffer as it is filled with booty and locked up again. Fortunate to be plundered...by you.
minions.name: Bluebird

sources.text: The Palace of the Dead - Bronze Sack

minions.tooltip: The disbelieving cries of our foe will be as the sweetest birdsong.   - Yadovv Gah

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 90 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wide-eyed fawn minion. His mother was either lost in a terrible hunting accident...or perhaps is just lost.
minions.enhanced_description: An easy target for Eorzea's carnivorous fauna, antelopes must use every advantage they have to remain free from death's dripping jaws. One of those is the remarkable ability to run mere minutes from birth. Unfortunately, that trait did not save this specimen from capture.
minions.name: Wide-eyed Fawn

sources.text: Auriana - Mor Dhona - 3 Allagan Tomestones of Poetics

minions.tooltip: When making an offering of antelope innards, it is proper they are still warm.   - Common Knowledge

verminion.skill_description:

minions.description: Summon your infant imp minion. Hopes that one day, he will rule the seven hells. But for now, your backside will do.
minions.enhanced_description: Scholars believe there are three ways in which voidsent can make the journey from their realm to ours─tearing a hole in the aether on their side, having a hole torn for them on our side, or stumbling into a randomly occurring hole, the latter being the most common for imps.
minions.name: Infant Imp
minions.tooltip: This bastard's got some nasty spells!   - Stalwart Swordsman

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 90 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your coeurl kitten minion. It will still be several summers before his trademark whiskers grow out.
minions.enhanced_description: Coeurls are extremely proud and defiant creatures, even when young. Faced with insurmountable odds, a coeurl will rarely shy away from a fight, choosing rather to perish in combat than run. This characteristic keeps coeurl numbers low, but ensures the strength of those who survive.
minions.name: Coeurl Kitten
minions.tooltip: Coeurl got your tongue?   - Wilred

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your black coeurl minion. Beware, for if one should cross your path, you will experience seven years of...AWWWWWW.
minions.enhanced_description: To the untrained eye, this coeurl appears to be of an entirely new species, when in fact the only thing separating him from his mottled brethren is that his spots are so large, they overlap with one another, rendering him completely black.
minions.name: Black Coeurl
minions.tooltip: Look what the coeurl dragged in.   - Momodi

verminion.skill_description: Delivers 5% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up gentleman minion. If “clockwork Hildibrand” doesn't quite roll off the tongue, both “minion of enquiry” and “mammet extraordinaire” are acceptable alternatives.
minions.enhanced_description: Though he has once more taken to the heavens in a selfless act of sacrifice, Inspector Hildibrand lives on in the hearts of all whose lives he touched with his inimitable brand of gallantry, perception, and panache. Wind him up and let him follow you as only a Manderville can.
minions.name: Wind-up Gentleman
minions.tooltip: I have peeled away the foul scab of uncertainty to reveal the truth within!   - Hildibrand

minions.enhanced_description: Mage-controlled golems were in such wide use by the end of the Fifth Astral Era that entire battles were waged by armies comprised of nothing but the lifeless soulkin. This recreation, however, is nothing but a standard model #001 mammet outfitted with simple gravel plating.
minions.name: Gravel Golem
minions.tooltip: Gummice pollums? I fear I'm not familiar with them.   - Yhom Epocan

sources.text: The Palace of the Dead - Bronze Sack

minions.tooltip: I came expectin' to fight one tonberry, not a whole bloody mess of 'em.   - Soft Marauder

minions.enhanced_description: Hatched from an egg laid in the ivory sands of La Noscea's Salt Strand, if lucky, this baby adamantoise may live to see as many as ten score summers...that is, if it does not accidentally launch itself off a cliff with its constant spinning.
minions.name: Tiny Tortoise

minions.name: Baby Raptor

minions.tooltip: Each sapling is another glimpse into the wonder of the world around us.   - Fufucha

sources.text: Auriana - Mor Dhona - 3 Allagan Tomestones of Poetics

minions.tooltip: Between the four of us, surely we can outsmart a few rogue spriggans.   - Augustiniel

minions.name: Gigantpole
minions.tooltip: These toads are huge, which means they have huge guts.   - Hamon

minions.tooltip: Ul'dah ain't more'n a sand-crusted pile o' puk dung bakin' in the desert.   - Baderon Tenfingers

minions.name: Buffalo Calf
minions.tooltip: I made the grievous error of visiting a great buffalo with a handsaw.   - Godbert

minions.name: Smallshell

sources.text: FATE "It's Not Lupus" - Eastern La Noscea

minions.tooltip: Got naught but a sea lion's share of crab offal 'twixt them ears, I reckon.   - Ighii Moui

minions.name: Wolf Pup
minions.tooltip: I've got no words to mince with whelps...unless you're here to become a wolf.   - Curious Gorge

minions.name: Beady Eye
minions.tooltip: Black scorpion to sharpen one's wit; ahriman membrane for the mind.   - Severian

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

minions.name: Fledgling Dodo

sources.text: Auriana - Mor Dhona - 3 Allagan Tomestones of Poetics

minions.tooltip: Lightning Drools over the Bismarck's Delightful Grilled Dodo!   - The *Harbor Herald*

minions.name: Coblyn Larva
minions.tooltip: The lads go through gear faster'n a coblyn chewin' on a chunk of mythril.   - Wawarukka

minions.name: Wind-up Aldgoat
minions.tooltip: A nice big aldgoat steak should put some color back in 'er cheeks.   - Lyngsath

verminion.skill_description: Removes all detrimental effects from all allies within range.

minions.description: Summon your fledgling apkallu minion. Will follow you until you give him a fish. Will continue to follow you after being given a fish.
minions.enhanced_description: While the hatchlings of other flightless cloudkin have been observed covered in a dull brown coat of down when they emerge from their eggs, apkallus enter the world covered in the same vivid green plumage they will bear for their entire lives.
minions.name: Fledgling Apkallu

sources.text: Out of Sight Out of Mind

minions.tooltip: Nesting hens do not spear a failed egg thief a score and a half times.   - Frandelont Raimdelle

minions.name: Goobbue Sproutling

sources.text: It Was a Very Good Year

minions.tooltip: These goobbues are wont to devour anything and everything.   - Aileen

minions.name: Bite-sized Pudding
minions.tooltip: A talking...pudding?   - You

minions.enhanced_description: Part of the Guildmaster Series, this high-quality replica is so exact in its rendition of the vanguard's build that Garlemald has banned the item's import into the Empire's outlying provinces, for fear the data gleaned from it will be used by rebel forces still active in these lands.
minions.name: Model Vanguard
minions.tooltip: I'd sooner face a vanguard while naked as my nameday!   - Flame Private

minions.name: Demon Brick
minions.tooltip: Underneath this gear, I'm built like a brick privy!   - Chachabi

minions.name: Mini Mole

minions.tooltip: The lifeblood spilled in Dalamud's name shall be blessed upon his return.   - Foxe

minions.description: Summon your minute mindflayer minion. Delights folk with its cuteness even as it fills them with an inexplicable sense of dread.
minions.enhanced_description: Similar to voidsent dullahans, mindflayers also lack a corporeal form and must possess a host to be able to exert force on our realm. Whereas the dullahan, however, are limited to the possession of inorganic objects such as steel, mindflayers tend to prefer the dead as their vessels.
minions.name: Minute Mindflayer

sources.text: The Palace of the Dead - Bronze Sack

minions.tooltip: It has a grisly penchant for sucking out the brains of men.   - Frandelont Raimdelle

minions.description: Summon your tight-beaked parrot minion. For best results, summon while wearing an eyepatch.
minions.enhanced_description: After witnessing the horrors experienced by his former master, Captain Madison, this once-outspoken oppo has gone silent, opening its beak only when offered a handful of sardines.
minions.name: Tight-beaked Parrot
minions.tooltip: Parley! Parley! Parley! Squaaawk!   - Loose-beaked Parrot

verminion.skill_description: Transports action party to the central summoning Gate.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Amalj'aa minion. What is burnt may never burn, but rises again, harder and stronger.
minions.enhanced_description: Amalj'aa blacksmith Narujj Boh of the Brotherhood of Ash began dabbling in clockwork after rescuing the mammet minion of an adventurer slain near his forges. This particular sample is the product of moons of meticulous calculations made to reproduce the telltale Amalj'aa tail sway.
minions.name: Wind-up Amalj'aa

sources.text: Amalj'aa Vendor - Ring of Ash (Southern Thanalan) - 25,000 Gil (Rank 4)

minions.tooltip: My people are the Amalj'aa, proud and strong.   - Loonh Gah

verminion.skill_description:

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Ixal minion. He believes he can fly. He believes he can touch the sky. Unfortunately he cannot.
minions.enhanced_description: Using a mammet obtained from the Goldsmiths' Guild by the ever-resourceful Tataramu, members of the Ehcatl Nine have succeeded in creating an automaton of their own...who also happens to be as grounded as their brethren.
minions.name: Wind-up Ixal
minions.tooltip: I heard a Wood Wailer telling Mummy that an Ixal teared his face off.   - Gridanian Child

verminion.skill_description:
Increases action party DEF by 40.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up kobold minion. With you, she will koboldly go where no kobold has gone before.
minions.enhanced_description: Another of 789th Order Acolyte Ba Go's masterpieces, this cuddly kobold miniature in fact houses several onzes of highly flammable firesand, designed to ignite when outward pressure is applied...such as with a tender hug.
minions.name: Wind-up Kobold

sources.text: Kobold Vendor - 789th Order Dig (Outer La Noscea) - 25,000 Gil (Rank 4)

minions.tooltip: Honestly, I will never understand the kobolds' sense of aesthetics.   - R'ashaht

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Sahagin minion. He's got a trident and he's not afraid to use it.
minions.enhanced_description: Ever the loving clutchfather, Novv had this toy crafted, complete with sharpened trident, for his infant spawnlings. When wound up, it displays various thrusts and parries to prepare the spawn for battle with their enemies.
minions.name: Wind-up Sahagin

sources.text: Sahagin Vendor - Novv's Nursery (Western La Noscea) - 25,000 Gil (Rank 4)

minions.tooltip: A Sssahagin does not flail and sssplash about so─ he rolls with the waves.   - Clutchfather Novv

verminion.skill_description: Removes all beneficial effects from all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up brickman minion. The brickman gets up and looks over as if it wants to join the party!
minions.enhanced_description: One unexpected side effect of the Calamity has been the significant increase in aetherial rifts appearing throughout the realm. As a result, strange creatures not of this world have been popping in and out of existence without warning─one of those being the bizarre brickman.
minions.name: Wind-up Brickman
minions.tooltip: Can ye smell it? 'Tis the scent o' profit, my friend!   - Beefy Businessman

verminion.skill_description:

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Shantotto minion. But remember: If you fail to treat her right, she will set your pants alight.
minions.enhanced_description: If it looks like a Lalafell, rhymes like a Lalafell, and alliterates like a Lalafell, then it is probably a Lalafell...except when it is a wind-up Shantotto. Then it is not a Lalafell.
minions.name: Wind-up Shantotto
minions.tooltip: Your judgment is quite wise─you may yet stave off an untimely demise.   - Shantotto

verminion.skill_description:

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Edvya minion. Sometimes moonlights as a miller girl, much to her father the sultan's chagrin.
minions.enhanced_description: Forty years after the founding of the Thorne Dynasty, Sultan Baldric Thorne was blessed by the gods with a single daughter, Edvya, whom he loved fiercely. The history surrounding the two, now known as the “Legend of the Lost Lady” gave rise to the festival of Little Ladies' Day.
minions.name: Wind-up Edvya
minions.tooltip: Did Princess Edvya concern herself with glory and riches? I think not!   - Gossiping Girl

minions.description: Summon your wind-up sun minion. May the sun never go down on you.  /poke to adjust elevation.
minions.enhanced_description: Designed to provide light for road repairmen toiling during the small hours of the night, wind-up suns have become all the talk amongst Ul'dahn mesdames ever since it was discovered the extra light worked wonders at hiding unsightly blemishes and wrinkles.
minions.name: Wind-up Sun

sources.text: Magic Pot - The Isles of Umbra (Western La Noscea) - 1 Elixir

minions.tooltip: We find the pages of our memories are blank, as if bleached by the sun.   - Kan-E-Senna

minions.description: Summon your plush cushion minion. Ever ready to shield your buttocks from the hardest of places.
minions.enhanced_description: Preferring to take a more hands-on approach with his latest project, Redolent Rose of the Weavers' Guild personally researched the resilience and contour of over four score buttocks in order to create a cushion so light and fluffy, even the clouds would darken with envy.
minions.name: Plush Cushion
minions.tooltip: Bumbling one spends all day sleeping on paper-stack pillow, yes?   - Olmxio

minions.name: Minion of Light
minions.tooltip: Next you'll be telling me you're one of the Warriors of Light.   - Mother Miounne

minions.enhanced_description: A thoroughbred descended from the legendary Veillantif, this noble bird of Ishgard seeks a rider who will not sully his family's name.
minions.name: Princely Hatchling
minions.tooltip: I had a feeling you'd be riding up on your golden chocobo.   - Path Companion

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Odin minion. Guaranteed not to wipe out your entire party in one fell stroke.
minions.enhanced_description: Many have pondered why a Dark Divinity with roots in northern mythology would wield a blade with a decidedly Far Eastern name. A popular theory is that Odin acquired the blade upon slaying an Auri warrior who was the first ever to notch his theretofore unsullied plate.
minions.name: Wind-up Odin
minions.tooltip: If Odin is truly come to the Shroud, time is not on our side.   - Lewin

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 90 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Warrior of Light minion. “Wheresoever thou goest, so too shall Light follow.” ─Ancient benediction
minions.enhanced_description: The brilliant blue suit of armor worn by the wind-up Warrior of Light is based upon ancient Allagan designs rediscovered in recent years by adventurers returned from the Crystal Tower.
minions.name: Wind-up Warrior of Light
minions.tooltip: There will be no Warriors of Light to save you this time.   - Gaius van Baelsar

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Bahamut minion. This mysterious being emerged from within a broken wind-up Dalamud, and is nigh inseparable from its former prison.
minions.enhanced_description: Despite strict orders from the Goldsmiths' Guild to *never* open up the Dalamud minion under any circumstances, someone decided to unleash their inner Pandora and release the terrors hidden within─a wind-up Bahamut...which no one from the guild recalls creating!
minions.name: Wind-up Bahamut

sources.text: Item code included with A Realm Reborn Original Soundtrack

minions.tooltip: Bahamut can't live on  good wishes and a smile, so why should I?   - Flame Private

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 90 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up moogle minion. With its button nose and fluffy pom, this clockwork moogle will make you the envy of all your friends.
minions.enhanced_description: A creation born of 90% love and 10% jealousy (or was that 90% jealousy and 10% love?), this clockwork masterpiece was conceived after the moogles of the Black Shroud began noticing all the adventurers with their new shiny minions, and decided they were not about to be left out.
minions.name: Wind-up Moogle
minions.tooltip: What the moogles lack in grace, they amply make up for in wit.   - Jehantel

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 90 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your baby opo-opo minion. The only thing he loves more than you is a juicy sprite apple.
minions.enhanced_description: A daring rescue from the clutches of the goblin hero Brayflox's minions is the only thing separating this opo-opo from a life of swinging free from tree to tree through the lush jungles of the Longstop...and forever trudging in the wake of the brave adventurer who “saved” him.
minions.name: Baby Opo-opo

sources.text: The Palace of the Dead - Bronze Sack

minions.tooltip: These beans are covered in opo-opo droppings!   - Mun–Tuy Cellarkeep

minions.description: Summon your magic broom minion. For safety reasons, do not fall asleep while it is at work.
minions.enhanced_description: While you may not hear many of the realm's mages admit it, magicking a household broom to become a self-propelled sweeping servitor (albeit one which does very little actual cleaning) is far more complicated than it sounds, requiring no fewer than seven cants of binding.
minions.name: Magic Broom
minions.tooltip: A lancer who fears to attack is naught but a man holding a pole.   - Ywain

verminion.skill_description: Removes all effects from all enemies and allies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up succubus minion. 100% anatomically correct. Handle with tender loving care.
minions.enhanced_description: One of countless clockwork servitors discovered in the home of a Gridanian goldsmith recently hanged for the crime of ritual summoning. It is believed while crafting the automata, he became increasingly obsessed with the void, until the darkness bid him do the unthinkable.
minions.name: Wind-up Succubus

sources.text: Hunt Billmaster - Any Grand Company Headquarters - 500 Allied Seals

minions.tooltip: That succubus will drain you to a lifeless husk!   - Cocobygo

**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your zu hatchling minion. This newborn zu has yet to exhibit aggressive or territorial behavior, but when it gets bigger...
minions.enhanced_description: While native to the scorching deserts of the Near East, the zu will migrate to a cooler Eorzea after hatching its fledglings in the spring. Since the Calamity, however, there have been an increasing number of cases where the giant cloudkin remain in Eorzea year-round.
minions.name: Zu Hatchling
minions.tooltip: These birds move slow, but they've a nasty peck!   - Jacke

verminion.skill_description:
Increases action party ATK by 60.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Nanamo minion. She vehemently refuses to sit upon any shoulder but Raubahn's...and yours.
minions.enhanced_description: This clockwork doll is a reproduction of a model first crafted in the year of the Calamity to celebrate the tenth anniversary of Nanamo Ul Namo's ascendance to the Ul'dahn throne. Seventeenth in her line, the sultana was crowned when she had seen but five summers.
minions.name: Wind-up Nanamo
minions.tooltip: Take me, Raubahn... I am your sultana... <snore>    - Slumbering Lalafell

verminion.skill_description:
Increases caster ATK by 10 and DEF by 5 for every 5% of HP lost.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Gilgamesh minion. Several arms appear to be missing, but that does not seem to otherwise hinder basic functionality.
minions.enhanced_description: The masterwork of one of Eorzea's finest goldsmiths, this wind-up automaton, designed to resemble a close acquaintance of the smith's son, was pieced together using parts left over from other projects─his only regret being that he was unable to incorporate hip-gyrating functionality.
minions.name: Wind-up Gilgamesh
minions.tooltip: For Gilgamesh... It is embiggening time!   - Gilgamesh

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 300 to all enemies within range. The action party is immediately withdrawn from the playing field after execution.

minions.description: Summon your Onion Prince minion. He would die 4 U. Or possibly cry 4 U. Or most likely make U cry. 4 U.
minions.enhanced_description: After learning his parents married not for love, but for duty, the Onion Prince vowed he would never walk in the footsteps of his parents, and to this day promises his baseborn sweetheart, the Leek Maid, that they will run away and be wed.
minions.name: Onion Prince
minions.tooltip: Aw, bloody hells! Who's cutting onions back there!?   - Buscarron

verminion.skill_description: Delivers 5% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

minions.description: Summon your Eggplant Knight minion. His childhood dream to become a wizard was frowned upon by his overbearing father.
minions.enhanced_description: House Eggplant has faithfully served the royal line of Tomato kings for eighteen generations, never once betraying the throne...until, that is, the knight of the nineteenth generation laid eyes on the fair Mandragora Queen.
minions.name: Eggplant Knight
minions.tooltip: If you eat too many of this vegetable, you will turn into one.   - Common Wives' Tale

**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your Garlic Jester minion. Every breath you take will act as a reminder that your pungent pal is right behind you.
minions.enhanced_description: The son of a traveling mummer who performed under the name Garlic Star, the jester swore he would never follow in the footsteps of his father. However, after being deemed too malodorous to serve in the royal guard, he swallowed his pride and fell back on the only trade he knew.
minions.name: Garlic Jester
minions.tooltip: And this irresistible aroma... Mmmmmmmmm...   - Ingham

verminion.skill_description:
Increases ATK of all allies within range by 20 (40 if the ally is a **critter**).
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your Tomato King minion. Has issued a royal decree for the public defenestration of any and all who mistakenly claim the king is a vegetable.
minions.enhanced_description: After the flames of the Calamity rendered Lord Tomato a king without a kingdom, the ruby red regent packed up his seeds and set out on a journey to find a new land to rule. He currently roams the realm recruiting any taproot, tuber, or corm who will follow his standard.
minions.name: Tomato King
minions.tooltip: It is apparently a rogue, outcast from its kin, a stranger in a strange land.   - Tomaj

verminion.skill_description:
Increases action party ATK by 40.
**Duration:** 15s

minions.description: Though wed to the Tomato King in a move to strengthen the bond of houses Tomato and Mandragora, the queen longs to steal away with her one true love─the Eggplant Knight. What will become of this forbidden romance!? Summon the Mandragora Queen minion today and find out!
minions.enhanced_description: Destined to a life with a man she did not love, nary a night passed when the Mandragora Queen did not dream of throwing herself into the sea's eternal embrace...until, that is, she laid eyes on the noble Eggplant Knight.
minions.name: Mandragora Queen
minions.tooltip: I want to be waist-deep in little white mandragora limbs!   - Yellowjacket

verminion.skill_description: Restores 100 HP to all allies within range (150 if the ally is a **critter**).

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Y'shtola minion. If we are to take her word for it, the Circle of Knowing Archon has seen but twenty-three summers.
minions.enhanced_description: Nearly half of the coin provided to the Goldsmiths' Guild for the crafting of this wind-up doll bearing the likeness of Scion of the Seventh Dawn Y'shtola was paid to Atelier Fen-Yll for hand-sewn leather boots matching those worn by the enigmatic Archon.
minions.name: Wind-up Y'shtola
minions.tooltip: Gods forfend...    - Y'shtola

verminion.skill_description:
Increases DEF of all allies within range by 20.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your magic wind-up onion knight minion. An accurate representation of the soldiers who once made up the greater portion of the Allagan Imperial Army.
minions.enhanced_description: If Sons of Saint Coinach anthropogeographer Rammbroes is to be believed, towards the end of their civilization, the Allagans began using automata such as this to fight their wars (which had been deemed inhumane, yet ultimately necessary to spread imperial peace).
minions.name: Wind-up Onion Knight
minions.tooltip: By the onion!   - Bloezoeng

verminion.skill_description:
Renders action party immune to all attacks.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your treasure box minion. It is unknown what manner of spirit possesses this tiny treasure chest, but the fact that it will not hesitate to nip at the fingers of any who try and pry it open is painfully evident.
minions.enhanced_description: Originally used by an Eorzean Alliance paymaster to store Allied Seals...until the box began eating them. She sold the box in hopes of recouping some of her losses (skimming off adventurer rewards to cover the rest...until she was caught and sentenced to a public flogging).
minions.name: Treasure Box

sources.text: Hunt Billmaster - Any Grand Company Headquarters - 440 Allied Seals

minions.tooltip: A pirate don't abandon 'is treasures!   - Ahtzapfyn

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 120 to all enemies within range while increasing action party ATK by 20.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your tiny tapir minion. Natives of the New World claim that tapirs grow by devouring the dreams of their unsuspecting owners. And now you know what to expect.
minions.enhanced_description: Before it was realized that the tapirs were, in fact, consuming the dreams of their owners, several hundred were sold to Ul'dahn nobles seeking a better night's sleep. Surprisingly, there were few complaints from buyers, even after learning the truth.
minions.name: Tiny Tapir
minions.tooltip: Our dreams are what sustain us.   - Gundobald

verminion.skill_description:

**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your Nana bear minion. Pundits claim bears to be the deadliest beasts in the realm─obviously having never stared into *this* cute cub's nebulous eyes.
minions.enhanced_description: The Nana bear's origins can be traced back to Ul'dahn princess Nanakko who, on her eighth nameday, asked her father for a bear. Despite a realm-wide search, no bears were found, and so the Goldsmiths' Guild was commissioned to craft one from a drawing found in an ancient bestiary.
minions.name: Nana Bear
minions.tooltip: There isn't enough honey in all the Yard to satisfy that sweet-toothed sellary.   - Honey Yard Hivekeep

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your miniature minecart minion. Best when ridden in abandoned mines and temples of doom.
minions.enhanced_description: Despite adamant claims by Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern that their donation of over five score carts to the orphans of Stonesthrow was a simple act of charity, opponents of the guild insist it was a scheme to recruit inexpensive child labor for Thanalan's myriad mines.
minions.name: Miniature Minecart
minions.tooltip: Mines mine! Mines all miiiiiiiiine!   - Biggy the Spriggan

verminion.skill_description: Grants 10 action points to all allies within range who do not have similar actions.

minions.description: Summon your nutkin minion. That nutkins are infamous for being shy and timid creatures shows that this brave beastkin comes complete with a pair of iron acorns on him.
minions.enhanced_description: Inspired by the words of Millith Ironheart, this daring squirrel longs to travel the realm in search of the legendary golden acorn, and hopes that trailing in your shadow will ensure that he isn't eaten before he discovers the mother lode.
minions.name: Nutkin

sources.text: The Palace of the Dead - Bronze Sack

minions.tooltip: I had no idea squirrels could bite so hard!   - Arold

minions.enhanced_description: This clockwork automaton has been crafted at the behest of the Adventurers' Guild in celebration of the Rising, Eorzea's annual celebration of rebirth. All linkshell privileges have been revoked so one not need dread incessant calls throughout the small hours of night.
minions.name: Wind-up Minfilia
minions.tooltip: ...Hello? Hello? Can you hear me? It is I, Minfilia.   - Minfilia

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Thancred minion. 200% more dreamy than previous models.
minions.enhanced_description: This clockwork automaton has been crafted at the behest of the Adventurers' Guild in celebration of the Rising, Eorzea's annual celebration of rebirth. Reports of crazed Thancred fans stalking the summoned servitors are more common than one might believe.
minions.name: Wind-up Thancred
minions.tooltip: I suppose any name is as good as another, though most call me Thancred.   - Thancred

minions.description: Summon your model magitek bit minion. An exact 1:9 scale replica of a ceruleum-powered magitek bit (Ultima Weapon action figure not included).
minions.enhanced_description: This miracle of modern mechanics is actually a miracle of ancient Allagan mechanics reverse engineered and then modified with advanced Garlean magitek technology.
minions.name: Model Magitek Bit

sources.text: Crafted by Blacksmith - The Binding Coil of Bahamut -Turn 1, 2, 4 and 5

minions.tooltip: The Empire owes its might to magitek.   - Yda

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your puff of Darkness minion. When standing nearby, prithee refrain from coughing, sneezing, waving, flailing, or performing any other means of wild gesticulation, lest the puff be lost for eternity.
minions.enhanced_description: When this automaton resembling one crafted by a goldsmith hanged for dabbling in the dark arts was discovered, it prompted authorities to exhume the recently buried body. This, however, only confirmed their worst fears─that the coffin was empty.
minions.name: Puff of Darkness
minions.tooltip: What I do not smother, I devour. What I cannot devour, I destroy.   - The Cloud of Darkness
