minions.tooltip: Now there's a trick what took some bollocks.    - Perimu Haurimu

verminion.skill_description:
Increases action party DEF by 40.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your road sparrow minion. This house sparrow's home is on the road. Sparrow.
minions.enhanced_description: Tired of his humdrum life back in Yanxia, this former house sparrow set off on the journey of a lifetime, finally arriving several moons later in Bardam's Mettle, where he fell in with a flock of ferocious yol and learned the true meaning of freedom.
minions.name: Road Sparrow
minions.tooltip: We will need wine...and sparrow-stuffed pheasant.    - Jannequinard

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces DEF of all enemies within range by 50%.
**Duration:** 15s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Lyse minion. Most certainly not a repurposed wind-up Yda.
minions.enhanced_description: Tataru's choice of raiment for this lifelike recreation of Ala Mhigo's newest heroine was, by no means, made with the sole intention of confusing the public into believing Lyse was a dancer by profession. Honest.
minions.name: Wind-up Lyse
minions.tooltip: It was brave of Lyse to remove her mask after so long...    - Alphinaud

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your dress-up Yugiri minion. One Yugiri is never enough.
minions.enhanced_description: Inspired by an automaton brought across the sea from faraway Aldenard, a Doman dollmaker set out to see if he could replicate the foreign techniques used to breathe life into the creation, the result being this fairly faithful rendition.
minions.name: Dress-up Yugiri
minions.tooltip: Her name is Yugiri. Perchance you know of her?    - Ihanami

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers 10 points of damage every second to all enemies within range.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Gosetsu minion. Wanted by the Empire...and good little boys and girls across Othard.
minions.enhanced_description: Crafted to honor Gosetsu─hero and leader of the oppressed peoples of Far Eastern Doma─this miniature replica is faithful down to the blademaster's sword, Samonji.
minions.name: Wind-up Gosetsu
minions.tooltip: Notorious fugitive wanted dead or alive by the Empire!    - Isse

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 150 to all enemies within range while reducing DEF by 30%.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Yotsuyu minion. For that delicious disdain you never knew you needed.
minions.enhanced_description: Searching for artistic inspiration, a goldsmith chanced to see an imported painting of a Doman beauty. The woman was apparently a renowned courtesan, and her exquisitely haughty features so enthralled him that he decided to immortalize her in mammet form.
minions.name: Wind-up Yotsuyu

sources.text: Item code included with The Art of the Revolution -Western Memories-

minions.tooltip: Surely Yotsuyu has crossed the line now...    - Alisaie

verminion.skill_description: Sets a trap which can be activated by button after 10 seconds. When triggered, it delivers an attack with a potency of 180 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your mock-up Grynewaht minion. Bwahahahaha!
minions.enhanced_description: This anatomically accurate simulacrum of the imperial soldier Grynewaht appears to have been built by magitek engineers to determine the most efficient means by which to incorporate magitek implants into the Roegadyn's body.
minions.name: Mock-up Grynewaht
minions.tooltip: It's like all my namedays have come at once!   - Grynewaht

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 90 and knocks back all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Namazu minion. Half cat. Half fish. All fish.
minions.enhanced_description: Not too many summers past, there wasn't a house in all Radz-at-Han that didn't echo with the pitter-patter of Hingan-made wind-up Namazu dolls, their misplaced eyes and bewhiskered lips the source of much mirth in the Near Eastern nation.
minions.name: Wind-up Namazu
minions.tooltip: He's not heavy, but gods, the smell...    - Lyse

verminion.skill_description: Removes all beneficial effects from all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your Ivon Coeurlfist doll minion. Technically “Coeurl*paw*.”
minions.enhanced_description: A complete dismantling of the coeurl-fisted caricature shows that, unlike the automata of Ul'dah, the puffered paunch of this poppet contains naught but cotton and straw, leading one to wonder...how in the seven hells does it walk!?
minions.name: Ivon Coeurlfist Doll
minions.tooltip: He had a pair o' Sphairai crafted─fists what looked like coeurls.    - Gerolt

verminion.skill_description:
Doubles the amount of HP restored to allies stationed in Gates.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up chimera minion. Crafted by piecing together the remnants of unsold automata.
minions.enhanced_description: It is hard to imagine anyone taking pleasure in creating to-scale replicas of the very abominations that contributed to the end of an entire civilization. Then again, it is so utterly *adorable*.
minions.name: Wind-up Chimera
minions.tooltip: That chimera must be his latest prize.    - Hildibrand

verminion.skill_description: Reduces action points of all enemies within range by 50% of the maximum value.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up meateater minion. Watch out boys, he'll (literally) chew you up.
minions.enhanced_description: This fully functioning automaton was discovered in the pack of a Qiqirn bandit slain on the Hunt. Why a Qiqirn was carrying a copy of itself on its person is a question you *could* ask yourself, but as they say, “ignorance is bliss.”
minions.name: Wind-up Meateater
minions.tooltip: Empty bellies send blood aboiling!    - Qiqirn Bandit

verminion.skill_description: Disarms deployed enemy traps.

minions.description: Summon your magitek avenger F1 minion. Avenger, assembled!
minions.enhanced_description: It appears the Empire created these faithful reproductions to train field engineers on how to repair actual avenger-class warmachina. The fact that the selfsame models are sold to imperial children as toys is a telling sign of the invaders' mindset.
minions.name: Magitek Avenger F1
minions.tooltip: The desire to protect and the desire to avenge are opposing forces that can ill be reconciled.    - Alberic

verminion.skill_description:
Increases caster ATK by 10 and DEF by 5 for every 5% of HP lost.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your Ghido minion. There is most likely a logical explanation as to why this aged turtle can navigate the skies. Most likely.
minions.enhanced_description: Some say this denizen of the Sirensong Sea has seen upwards of seven hundred summers, and in that time his hate for blue-blazoned armor has only grown. As for why, no one knows.
minions.name: Ghido
minions.tooltip: Matron's teats, those turtles are huge!    - Waemlydir

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces minion summoning recast time by 50%.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Exdeath minion. Most maniacal tree beings bent on world domination are usually not intimidated by turtles. This one is.
minions.enhanced_description: Retrieved in the Deltascape, this full-metal automaton is a recreation of a terrible villain appearing in ancient legend. While its scintillant blue armor suggests the figure is a knight, Exdeath was believed to be a powerful warlock born from a tree.
minions.name: Wind-up Exdeath
minions.tooltip: Death is but the blissful terminus of the lives of the weak.    - Nhazaa Jaab

verminion.skill_description:
Changes action party auto-attacks to area of effect attacks.
**Duration:** 12s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Khloe minion. Because there is nothing wrong with a fully automated mechanical reconstruction of a young girl of three and ten summers.
minions.enhanced_description: Ever since she began receiving them on her doorstep─one a day, every day, without fail─Khloe Aliapoh can't help but think there is something seriously wrong with whoever is sending her these disturbingly lifelike automata.
minions.name: Wind-up Khloe
minions.tooltip: This will make Khloe's best friend so happy!    - Khloe Aliapoh

verminion.skill_description: Grants 10 action points to all allies within range who do not have similar actions.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Susano minion. If the Kojin believe that within every item resides a deity, then who exactly resides inside this automaton?
minions.enhanced_description: With an itsy Yata-no-Kagami in his left hand and a bitsy Ame-no-Murakumo in his right, one might almost forget the miniature Magatama throbbing wildly in this liliputian Lord of the Revel's breast. Almost.
minions.name: Wind-up Susano

sources.text: Crafted by Weaver - The Pool of Tribute (Extreme)

minions.tooltip: We are Susano, and in revelry do we rejoice!    - Lord of the Revel

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 90 and knocks back all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Lakshmi minion. Your, your, your serpentine.
minions.enhanced_description: Created to epitomize Lakshmi's flawless beauty, a certain minstrel prone to wandering flippantly deemed it “not to his liking,” ultimately driving the original craftsman to take his own life, and leaving his apprentice to hastily touch up the features.
minions.name: Wind-up Lakshmi
minions.tooltip: There isss naught She would not give.    - Sarisha

verminion.skill_description: Restores 100 HP to all allies within range (150 if the ally is a **monster**).

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Bismarck minion. The hairiest whale you will see this fortnight.
minions.enhanced_description: Seeing Limsa Lominsa crawling with wind-up Ifrits, Titans, Ramuhs, even Ravanas, the Bismarck proprietor wondered why there were still no automata designed in the likeness of his establishment's namesake, and so commissioned one made.
minions.name: Wind-up Bismarck

sources.text: Crafted by Weaver - The Limitless Blue (Extreme)

minions.tooltip: The Bismarck is as good as mine.    - H'mhasi Tia

verminion.skill_description: Reduces HP of enemy Shield by 70%. No effect if Shield is already inoperable.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Hien minion. Be proud, my new owner. Be proud.
minions.enhanced_description: Under imperial rule, Doman dollmakers were forbidden from crafting automata such as the kiyofusa, but this did not stop one brave soul from honoring the popular young Lord Hien with a mammet in his likeness. Its creator can rightly be proud!
minions.name: Wind-up Hien
minions.tooltip: There is no denying that he has a presence...    - Haname

verminion.skill_description:
Increases ATK of all allies within range by 20 (40 if the ally is a **poppet**).
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Ravana minion. Low on low he stands, gazing up to see.
minions.enhanced_description: Desiring that the tale of Ravana's clash with the Warrior of Light be preserved for posterity, a Gnath historian commissioned the Weavers' Guild to recreate the Lord of the Hive as a mammet. Comes complete with Chandrahas and fierce love of battle.
minions.name: Wind-up Ravana

sources.text: Crafted by Weaver - Thok ast Thok (Extreme)

minions.tooltip: O Lord Ravana! Master of the Sacred Blades! Wrath of the Colony! Conqueror of the World!    - Gnath Priest

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 120 and knocks back all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Kojin minion. Is it green? Is it blue? Or...is it neither?
minions.enhanced_description: A mammet made in the likeness of the vessel for the kami Tsukumo, but given a green rather than blue coat of paint in order to differentiate it from the actual divinity. The Blue Kojin are hopeful of making a tidy profit by selling scores of these in Kugane.
minions.name: Wind-up Kojin

sources.text: Shikitahe - Tamamizu (The Ruby Sea) - 5 Kojin Sango (Rank 5)

minions.tooltip: Tsukumo is no ordinary puppet. He is of the divine!    - Kabuto

verminion.skill_description: Restores 100 HP to all allies within range (150 if the ally is a **poppet**).

minions.description: Summon your mameshiba minion. Who let the newborn miniature Far Eastern canine specimen out? Who, who, who, who, who!?
minions.enhanced_description: An unscrupulous merchant passed this pup off as a rare species of miniature dog known as the mameshiba. Such a thing does not exist. Rather than have the hapless owners discover the deception when it grows, it was trained to run away.
minions.name: Mameshiba
minions.tooltip: There's a smile made of puppy fat!    - Delivery Moogle

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 150 to all enemies within range while reducing DEF by 30%.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your tengu doll minion. And you know what they say about the size of a doll's nose.
minions.enhanced_description: A doll made in the likeness of a legendary Far Eastern creature, surprisingly animated for an inanimate object─a mystery Far Eastern folk would attribute to the mischievous tengu. Much like how a coveted piece of gear boasting five materia slots suddenly becomes a doll.
minions.name: Tengu Doll
minions.tooltip: How do you hope to survive with even more beaks to feed?    - Sanu Vanu

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces movement speed of all enemies within range by 70%. 
**Duration:** 5s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Matanga minion. This is not Matanga. Matanga is graceful.
minions.enhanced_description: A mammet made to resemble a Matanga found in the Hidden Canals of Uznair. Originally clothed, it was divested of its modesty by thieves targeting the jewels that adorned its lavish garments, hence its embarrassment. If only someone would cover up its shame. Shame. Shame.
minions.name: Wind-up Matanga
minions.tooltip: To think you beat a Matanga with just your fists.    - Impressed Dotharl

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Ramza minion. Stands ready to fight for truth, justice, and the Ivalician way.
minions.enhanced_description: Designed after Ramza Beoulve─unsung champion of Ivalician legend and not the son of the exiled Majestic Theater Company principal─this mammet's creation was commissioned by Jenomis cen Lexentale to pay honor to the true hero of the Zodiac Brave Story.
minions.name: Wind-up Ramza
minions.tooltip: Put that damnable thing down, Ramza. You're not helping matters!    - Jenomis cen Lexentale

verminion.skill_description:
Renders action party immune to all attacks.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your koala joey minion. Shows no signs of stress or crotch rot, so hug away.
minions.enhanced_description: This small ursine creature dropped onto the retainer who was cutting down its tree and has apparently decided to see the world. Though ordinarily placid, it can be savage when threatened, and folk are cautioned against─ Awww, look at the adorable little critter!
minions.name: Koala Joey
minions.tooltip: Fool is the man who calls a koala a bear within its hearing.    - Ancient Saying

verminion.skill_description: Removes all detrimental effects from all allies within range.

minions.description: Summon your salt & pepper seal minion. What a seal, what a mighty good seal.
minions.enhanced_description: None can say how this seal pup came to be at Loch Seld, but the person who first saw it took to calling it “salt” for the briny water, then someone else came along and added “pepper,” because why not. The rest, as they say, is history.
minions.name: Salt & Pepper Seal
minions.tooltip: Love makes for the best seasoning.    - Gildon

verminion.skill_description: Reduces action points of all enemies within range by 70% of the maximum value.

minions.description: Summon your axolotl eft minion. Because there truly is nothing more adorable than an oddly Lalafellin face on the body of a moist, frilled salamander.
minions.enhanced_description: The retainer who reeled in this specimen claims it is the fabled hundred-eyed axolotl, but at a glance it is short at least ninety-eight. Nor would the man say where he found the creature. For now, it shall be called an “axolotl eft” until such time as naturalists decide what it actually is.
minions.name: Axolotl Eft
minions.tooltip: The plot thickens like a dollop of salamander oil.    - Godbert

verminion.skill_description:
Doubles the amount of HP restored to allies stationed in Gates.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Ixion minion. A horse is a horse, of course. Except when it is Ixion.
minions.enhanced_description: In a bid to lure brave (or foolish) adventurers to hunt the legendary steed Ixion, the people of Gyr Abania pitched in coin to have this mammet produced─a handsome reward, they believe, for risking grisly death by impalement and/or lightning.
minions.name: Wind-up Ixion

sources.text: Eschina - Rhalgr's Reach - 5 Ixion Horns (FATE "A Horse Outside" - The Lochs)

minions.tooltip: Brave one! Your loyal steed awaits!    - Voyce

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers 10 points of damage every second to all enemies within range.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Shinryu minion. Exhibits an almost preternatural urge to hide in treasure chests and guard powerful weapons.
minions.enhanced_description: The designer of this mammet was tasked with recreating the dread-filled moment when Shinryu gains his freedom, bursting forth from a cocoon of light. The result is a rather loose interpretation, to say the least.
minions.name: Wind-up Shinryu

sources.text: Crafted by Weaver - The Minstrel Balad: Shinryu's Domain

minions.tooltip: I should very much like to see this “Shinryu” creature for myself.    - Nero tol Scaeva

verminion.skill_description: Renders both ally and enemy Shields and Search Eyes inoperable. The action party is immediately withdrawn from the playing field after execution.

minions.description: Summon your dress-up Raubahn minion. Detachable arm optional.
minions.enhanced_description: Ostensibly produced to commemorate Ala Mhigo's liberation, this avatar of the Flame General was originally meant to serve as an apology for the campaign's troubled start. To that end, it was said to have been programmed to beg forgiveness a dozen different ways.
minions.name: Dress-up Raubahn
minions.tooltip: Wait till the Flame General hears about this!    - M'naago

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 90 and knocks back all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Ananta minion. Why did it have to be a snake?
minions.enhanced_description: The ex-Gatekeeper sapper who crafted this doll claims her model was a recently molted Sarisha─new scales glistening in the sun. Proceeds from the sale of each piece are used as remuneration to those who aid the battlemaids in their endeavors.
minions.name: Wind-up Ananta

sources.text: Madhura - Castellum Velodyna (The Fringes) - 7 Ananta Dreamstaves (Rank 4)

minions.tooltip: Someone bring the snake!    - Fordola rem Lupis

verminion.skill_description: Restores 200 HP to all allies within range (250 if the ally is a **poppet**).

minions.description: Summon your private moai minion. It's watching you, watching you, watching you.
minions.enhanced_description: Carved from the remnants of a larger statue found deep beneath the Ruby Sea, the reasons why or even how it can propel itself remain unknown. Rumors of bright rings pouring forth from the effigy's mouth, however, are largely exaggerated.
minions.name: Private Moai

sources.text: Subaquatic Voyages - Deep-Sea Site (I), Sea of Ash (T), Sea of Jade (B)

minions.tooltip: Either that was a trick of the light, or that statue just moved...    - Shigure

verminion.skill_description:
Increases DEF of all allies within range by 10 (30 if the ally is a **gadget**).
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your white whittret minion. Once you pop...
minions.enhanced_description: This young male weasel with fur as yellow? as the winter's first snow once dreamed of becoming a pupil of the great auspice Kamaitachi. However, upon witnessing the Warrior of Light's prowess in Hells' Lid, he decided he would be better off siding with the latter.
minions.name: White Whittret
minions.tooltip: Don't talk to me! Talk to the cat...or the weasel.    - Tataru

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 90 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your motley egg minion. The tiny Archon inside is certain to kickstart your heart.
minions.enhanced_description: As thanks for aiding Jihli Aliapoh in the retrieval of several stolen eggs, the original Egg Dreamer has gifted you with an eggspertly crafted automaton featuring Radcliffe the Red, famed first Archon of the Sixth Umbral Era.
minions.name: Motley Egg
minions.tooltip: Personally, I've always had a thing for a motley.    - Cornell

verminion.skill_description: Removes all detrimental effects from all allies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Kefka minion. Just can't believe it? Believe it!
minions.enhanced_description: Other than a vague claim by Y'shtola that the doll you discovered in Omega's Sigmascape seems “eerily familiar,” none of your companions can recall ever hearing of a wicked jester known as Kefka, be it in history books or children's tales.
minions.name: Wind-up Kefka
minions.tooltip: Now, if you'll excuse me, I have an appointment with Kefka!    - Locke Cole

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces minion summoning recast time by 50%.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Magnai minion. Ever in search of true love.
minions.enhanced_description: When, after countless moons, their most radiant brother could still not find a suitable wife, several of the Oronir visited Kugane to have poppets created in Magnai's likeness. As of this writing, the outspoken leader remains alone.
minions.name: Wind-up Magnai
minions.tooltip: You're not related or something, are you?    - Lyse

verminion.skill_description: Delivers 10% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

minions.description: Summon your aurelia polyp minion. Lighter than air─er...water.
minions.enhanced_description: Hitching a ride in the ballast tank of a submersible proved an enlightening experience for this infant wavekin, allowing it to listen in on the incessant mumblings of the vessel's pilot─a mammet voyager tasked with taking an audio log of all discoveries made.
minions.name: Aurelia Polyp

sources.text: Subaquatic Voyages - Deep-sea Site (E/G/K/S/U/AA), Sea of Ash (S), Sea of Jade (C), Sirensong Sea (I)

minions.tooltip: Tonight we will feast on the jellyfish while my jealous fish of a brother drinks in his tears!    - Nortmoen

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers 10 points of damage every second to all enemies within range.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your Byakko cub minion. Got to be the fuzziest.
minions.enhanced_description: While not the actual progeny of the thousand-year-old auspice lord, this eponymous recreation (in newborn form) is sought after by Hingans hoping to see their luck turn for the better.
minions.name: Byakko Cub

sources.text: Crafted by Weaver - The Jade Stoa (Extreme)

minions.tooltip: Genbu may be the oldest, but Byakko's got to be the fuzziest.    - Kamaitachi

verminion.skill_description: Knocks back all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Fafnir minion. Protective eyewear highly recommended.
minions.enhanced_description: Why the scholar who crafted this mechanical marvel felt that an already deadly dragon need carry a sword (and a legendary one, at that) remains unclear. When questioned, he simply refused to alter the design and began muttering about “drop rates.”
minions.name: Wind-up Fafnir
minions.tooltip: Those hard scales, those claws...that puny body. Are you some kind of lesser dragon, kupo?    - Mogzin

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 90 and knocks back all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Mithra minion. Opinions on how Miqo'te rate compared to their supposed ancestors are best kept to oneself.
minions.enhanced_description: A stack of dusty tomes and a healthy imagination served as inspiration for this automaton designed to depict the Mithra─supposed ancestor of the Miqo'te. She wears a traditional scorpion harness rendered in painstaking—and pointless—detail by her Sharlayan creator.
minions.name: Wind-up Mithra
minions.tooltip: Looking to make a new frrriend, are we?    - Nanaa Mihgo

verminion.skill_description:
Increases ATK of all allies within range by 20 (40 if the ally is a **poppet**).
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your Prince of Anemos minion. Cute and cudgely.
minions.enhanced_description: Much to the chagrin of his father─the Lord of Anemos─the young heir has yet to outgrow the odd habit of concealing cudgels and using them to bludgeon anyone who dares question his merits. Thankfully, an absence of thew leaves his lively blows lacking.
minions.name: The Prince of Anemos

sources.text: FATE "The Shadow over Anemos" - Eureka Anemos

minions.tooltip: By the Twelve, what a hideous, monstrous abomination!    - The Impresario

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 150 to all enemies within range while reducing DEF by 30%.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your komainu minion. Part lion, part dog, all lion-dog.
minions.enhanced_description: Believed to ward the places from intruders with evil intent, statues of these mythical lion-dog creatures are oft erected at the gates of sacred locations such as shrines. When paired with another, they will always face forward.
minions.name: Komainu
minions.tooltip: Bright as a lamp, brave as a lion.    - Haermaga

verminion.skill_description: Disarms deployed enemy traps.

minions.description: Summon your Gold Whisker minion. Beckons you to enter his barrel of sin, but don't go in.
minions.enhanced_description: This gaudy rendition of a Namazu is not actually solid gold, but merely a wooden automaton adorned with gold leaf. Its creator, however, hopes that will be enough to fool trade ships from the West to import his “lucky catfish.”
minions.name: The Gold Whisker
minions.tooltip: Within these whiskers lies unbound potential.    - Old Namazu Master

verminion.skill_description: Grants 10 action points to all allies within range who do not have similar actions.

minions.description: Summon your magic monkey minion. King of monkeys. Equal of heaven. Inspirer of “awww.”
minions.enhanced_description: A miniature doppelganger of Qitian Dasheng magically brought into being by the ancient auspice himself. Originally used by the monkey king to cozen corrival and companion alike, now it merely serves to act adorable as it hovers nearby its new owner.
minions.name: Monkey King
minions.tooltip: It seems this year shall belong to the monkey after all!    - Saru Doshin

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your clockwork lantern minion. Hands-free illumination for the busy insomniac.
minions.enhanced_description: Seeing as collaborations are now all the rage in Eorzea, it did not take long for the tinkers of Eshtaime's Lapidaries to find their way to Frondale's Phrontistery to see what madness their collective minds could conceive. (A lantern. They made a lantern.)
minions.name: Clockwork Lantern
minions.tooltip: They can scarce make do without their lanterns.    - Armelle

verminion.skill_description:
Sets a trap that, when triggered, delivers an attack with a potency of 260 to all enemies within range.
**Activation Delay:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your frilled dragon minion. Also known as the *chlamydosaurus* but...uh, yeah.
minions.enhanced_description: Tree-dwellers by nature, frilled dragons only descend to hunt, using their powerful rear legs to propel them forward at speeds that rival most Lalafell. When intimidated, they will spread out the spiked frills adorning their necks, hoping to frighten would-be predators.
minions.name: Frilled Dragon

sources.text: Confederate Custodian - Crick (The Ruby Sea) - 10 Empyrean Potsherds

minions.tooltip: Are you some kind of lesser dragon, kupo?    - Mogzin

verminion.skill_description:
Increases movement speed of all allies within range by 35%.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Cirina minion. Hungry for divine guidance. Also buuz.
minions.enhanced_description: Commissioned for the Rising to promote interest in Xaela culture, this fully operational automaton was designed with painstaking detail, using the Mol youth Cirina as a model.
minions.name: Wind-up Cirina
minions.tooltip: She's braver than she looks.    - Lyse

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces minion summoning recast time by 50%.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Sadu minion. Will most likely not call any of your companions a stunted chuluu.
minions.enhanced_description: There once lived a young Dotharli warrior who dreamed of taking the khatun into his arms and, well, doing things that young Dotharli warriors dream of doing. He quickly realized he valued his life and instead crafted this less imposing stand-in.
minions.name: Wind-up Sadu
minions.tooltip: Is the khatun woman or man? A stupid question. She is Sadu.    - Koko

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 300 to all enemies within range. The action party is immediately withdrawn from the playing field after execution.

minions.description: Summon your copycat bulb minion. The only companion you need if you want no other companions.
minions.enhanced_description: Swaddled in crimson cloth and transfixed with an all-too-familiar earring, this shambling seedkin─seemingly fallen from the infamously fetid Cassie─reeks of rotting rutabagas and sour spirits.
minions.name: Copycat Bulb
minions.tooltip: The sapling is well on its way to becoming a tree.    - Beatin

verminion.skill_description:
Binds all enemies within range.
**Duration:** 5s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Tarutaru minion. Remarks relating to a certain people's stature and the diminutiveness thereof are best kept to oneself.
minions.enhanced_description: A stack of dusty tomes and a healthy imagination served as inspiration for this automaton designed to depict the Tarutaru─supposed ancestor of the Lalafell. She wears a gaudy vermilion cloak rendered in painstaking—and pointless—detail by her Sharlayan creator.
minions.name: Wind-up Tarutaru
minions.tooltip: Ages ago, there lived a female mage of no small repute who was known by all sorts of unsavory epithets.    - Gerolt

verminion.skill_description: Grants 10 action points to all allies within range who do not have similar actions.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Tsukuyomi minion. Barren waters, heed unto the tide.
minions.enhanced_description: Conscripted into the imperial army, only to be handed over to Eorzean Alliance officials in an unreported prisoner exchange, one humble goldsmith celebrated his regained freedom how most goldsmiths do─he crafted a lifelike replica of the Lady of the Moon, Tsukuyomi.
minions.name: Wind-up Tsukuyomi

sources.text: Item code included with Stormblood Original Soundtrack

minions.tooltip: And I am but the moon.    - Lebrassoir

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 90 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Zhloe minion. Cannot thank you enough, but will certainly try.
minions.enhanced_description: Impressed with Zhloe's tireless efforts at the orphanage, a craftsman employed by Rowena's House of Splendors created an automaton version of the altruist and gifted it to her sister, Khloe...who silently added it to her table of rewards.
minions.name: Wind-up Zhloe
minions.tooltip: But deep down, I knew that Mummy and Daddy were never coming back.    - T'kebbe

verminion.skill_description: Restores 100 HP to all allies within range (150 if the ally is a **poppet**).

minions.description: Summon your Construct 8 minion. Batteries not included.
minions.enhanced_description: Inoperative when discovered in the Clockwork City of Goug, the queer device whirred to life when a crystal was inserted under its chest plate. As long as the crystal is not replaced with auracite, the automaton should prove harmless.
minions.name: Construct 8
minions.tooltip: A construct born of desperation and denial.    - Penitent Heretic

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack 5 times the potency of the caster's ATK.

minions.description: Summon your Palico minion. Very punny.
minions.enhanced_description: Hailing from a land so distant it does not appear on any map, this catlike hunter has traveled to far eastern Othard in pursuit of his quarry─the fire-breathing Rathalos. How he came to fight by your side is a story better told over a roast leg of wyvern.
minions.name: Palico

sources.text: The New King on the Block

minions.tooltip: They allowed him to bring the sum of his skills to bear...or maybe *cat*, on his foes.    - Gerolt

verminion.skill_description:
Increases ATK of all allies within range by 25.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your Poogie minion. Beloved by hunters, though the feeling is not always mutual.
minions.enhanced_description: Many a hunter from lands both near and far has proclaimed this tiny piglet “cute enough to eat.” Not literally, of course. Alright, sometimes literally, but not this time. There will be no eating of Poogie, and that is final.
minions.name: Poogie
minions.tooltip: Ungodly swine! I would sooner *die* than surrender to you!    - Vault Priest

verminion.skill_description: Disarms deployed enemy traps.

minions.description: Summon your attendee #777 minion. Wasshoi, yes, yes.
minions.enhanced_description: Gyoshin labored through several nights to fincraft this tiny Namazu (though the happi stitchwork is clearly Gyorei's). He intended to make it in the likeness of the 777th attendee, but soon lost count, so model selection was ultimately random.
minions.name: Attendee #777

sources.text: Gyosho - Dhoro Iloh (The Azim Steppe) - 7 Namazu Koban (Rank 4)

minions.tooltip: I am happy to have met some-one so delici─deft of hand.    - Cirina

verminion.skill_description:
Increases DEF of all allies within range by 20.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your scarlet peacock minion. Prettier than your average peacock, and several times as flammable.
minions.enhanced_description: Peafowl have long been admired in the Far East for their brilliant plumage, but it is their penchant for hunting venomous vilekin that has earned them reverence typically reserved for kami. As such, effigies of the birds are believed to bring their owners good fortune.
minions.name: Scarlet Peacock
minions.tooltip: There will come a time when we must confront Suzaku.    - Genbu

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 80 to all enemies within range while reducing DEF by 30%.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Alpha minion. Kweh-ing along under some distant sky.
minions.enhanced_description: Crafted at the Garlond Ironworks, this miniature reproduction of your faithful (if not somewhat deformed) companion was gifted to you by engineer Jessie Jaye upon your triumphant return from the Alphascape.
minions.name: Wind-up Alpha
minions.tooltip: Well, Alpha certainly seems keen.    - Cid

verminion.skill_description: Transports action party to the central summoning Gate.

minions.description: Summon your OMG minion. Weird. Technological. Fascinating.
minions.enhanced_description: Despite a striking resemblance to the extra-dimensional mechanical monstrosity that nearly ended your life, this miniature model of Omega does naught but follow in your wake. Wedge of the Garlond Ironworks posits it may have been created to observe your behavior.
minions.name: OMG
minions.tooltip: Soon, Omega, soon... I will see you rise again!    - Nero tol Scaeva

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 150 to all enemies within range while inflicting a weakness to **monsters**.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up G'raha Tia minion. The future is where his destiny awaits.
minions.enhanced_description: In order to fund the expedition to the Syrcus Trench, Tataru crafted this series of automaton, modeled upon a certain Archon, the tales of whom she heard from Rammbroes.
minions.name: Wind-up G'raha Tia
minions.tooltip: A man could study for two lifetimes and only learn half of what you know.    - Cid

verminion.skill_description:
Renders ally Gates, Shield, and Search Eye impervious to damage.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your Little Yin minion. Turn around.
minions.enhanced_description: One half of a pair of (literally) animated decorations you stumbled across during the All Saints' Wake festivities. Members of the Continental Circus are at a loss as to why this sullen specter appears to have a will of its own, though “possession” is high on their list of theories.
minions.name: Little Yin
minions.tooltip: Are we really sleepin' at a graveyard? 'Cause I'm afraid of ghosts...    - Hal

verminion.skill_description: Removes all beneficial effects from all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your Little Yang minion. Every now and then he gets a little bit closer.
minions.enhanced_description: One half of a pair of (literally) animated decorations you stumbled across during the All Saints' Wake festivities. Members of the Continental Circus are at a loss as to why this spry specter appears to have a will of its own, though “possession” is high on their list of theories.
minions.name: Little Yang
minions.tooltip: Everyone'll think you a ghost!    - Erapi Taropi

verminion.skill_description:
Renders action party immune to all attacks.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Cloud minion. Sharp hair, don't care.
minions.enhanced_description: At first glance, it appears that the artisan took numerous liberties in this rendition of the legendary hero─the distinct lack of upper-body muscle mass suggesting Cloud would have been unable to even lift a weapon the size of the Buster Sword, let alone brandish it over his head.
minions.name: Wind-up Cloud
minions.tooltip: ...something.    - Cloud

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 380 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Aerith minion. The future ith not only yourth.
minions.enhanced_description: A somber reimagining of the ill-fated flowermonger who would set off on a journey to discover herself, only to find more than she bargained for. What is wind-up can never die.
minions.name: Wind-up Aerith
minions.tooltip: This guy are sick.    - Aerith

verminion.skill_description:
Renders all allies within range immune to attacks by **critters**.
**Duration:** 5s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Tifa minion. Not the wrong person.
minions.enhanced_description: A gravity-defying rendition of the legendary bartending brawler, carved with tender loving care by a seven-fingered craftsman who is oft overheard mumbling to himself, “Words aren't the only way to tell someone how you feel.”
minions.name: Wind-up Tifa
minions.tooltip: Fu, fu, fu... Be nice, Don.    - Tifa

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 150 and knocks back all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your mudpie minion. At last, portable filth.
minions.enhanced_description: A thick, brown mass of living effluence squeezed forth from one of the horror Tokkapchi's many hidden orifices. Though the squirt stinks of sopping sod, one might find themselves pressed to deny the amorphous alluvium is anything but adorable.
minions.name: Mudpie
minions.tooltip: I was almost certain you'd want to muddy the waters.    - Jessie

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 60 to all enemies within range while reducing movement speed by 70%.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your bridesmoogle minion. What is a blushing bride without a dutiful bridesmoogle to scatter petals in her general vicinity?
minions.enhanced_description: Moogles serving the Sanctum of the Twelve claim the magicked poppets (provided with purchase of a lavish Ceremony of Eternal Bonding) are guaranteed to bring happiness. Conveniently offer no refunds if you do not hap upon said happiness.
minions.name: Bridesmoogle

sources.text: Attend a Ceremony of Eternal Bonding (Gold/Platinum)

minions.tooltip: Wh-What have you done with my bride!?    - Vannes

verminion.skill_description:
Increases ATK of all allies within range by 10.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Elvaan minion. Remarks relating to a certain people's perpetually dour facial expressions are best kept to oneself.
minions.enhanced_description: A stack of dusty tomes and a healthy imagination served as inspiration for this automaton designed to depict an Elvaan─possible (but improbable) ancestor of the Elezen. He wears a blue cotehardie rendered in painstaking—and pointless—detail by his Sharlayan creator.
minions.name: Wind-up Elvaan

sources.text: FATE "You Do Know Jack" - Eureka Pyros

minions.tooltip: Curious pointed ears... I wonder where they could have come from, kupo?    - Mogleo

verminion.skill_description:
Increases action party DEF by 40.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your dhalmel calf minion. Oddly short yet alarmingly tall.
minions.enhanced_description: Considering this young specimen was most likely bred in captivity for the purpose of research, it is nothing short of a miracle that the calf has managed to survive the harsh environment of Eureka for as long as it has.
minions.name: Dhalmel Calf
minions.tooltip: Yes, you─with the long neck.    - Tsukumo

verminion.skill_description: Reduces action points of all enemies within range by 50% of the maximum value.

minions.description: Summon your capybara pup minion. Loves bath time, and you.
minions.enhanced_description: Known in Hingashi as the “onitenjikunezumi” (quite liberally translated as “Near Eastern demon rat”), this rodent auspice of unknown age has developed a fondness for Far Eastern hot springs, and will spend days in the restorative waters if not reminded to come out and eat.
minions.name: Capybara Pup
minions.tooltip: Such simple creatures, rats.    - Charibert

verminion.skill_description: Delivers 5% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

minions.description: Summon your baby gremlin minion. Feeding after midnight may result in injury. Yours.
minions.enhanced_description: Be not fooled by a gremlin's snow-white fur, for its intentions are as black as the night in which it thrives. Unlike more common stock, this particular breed appears to be resistant to both light and water, making them perfect pets for someone who doesn't mind a bit of mischief.
minions.name: Baby Gremlin
minions.tooltip: Thin skin and big mouths make for an uneasy combination.    - Hunter-scholar

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces ATK of all enemies within range by 50%.
**Duration:** 15s

minions.description: Summon your Conditional Virtue minion. Cuddle not to dullness; coddle not to elevation.
minions.enhanced_description: From a pulsating mass of aetherial flesh sloughed off the Eurekan elemental Absolute Virtue did rise this uncanny facsimile, identical to its progenitor in every way─every way, that is, except size and, well, absoluteness.
minions.name: Conditional Virtue

sources.text: The Baldesion Arsenal (Eureka Hydatos) - Absolute Virtue Chest

minions.tooltip: Men measure virtue in many ways.    - Yayaroku

verminion.skill_description:
Increases caster ATK by 10 and DEF by 5 for every 5% of HP lost.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your yukinko snowflake minion. Falling, falling, falling, falling, falling...falling on his head.
minions.enhanced_description: The yukinko's woven headdress serves not only to protect the creature from the elements, but spare it the embarrassment of having its nakedness exposed unto the world─not that any sane man would dare peek under the straw, lest he risk eternal damnation.
minions.name: Yukinko Snowflake
minions.tooltip: It is the enemy that weighs on me─snow, rather than fire.    - Martiallais

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 70 to all enemies within range while reducing movement speed by 50%.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your dress-up Tataru minion. Say what you will, she wears it well.
minions.enhanced_description: To thank those adventurers who have come to her aid while in Kugane, Tataru Taru of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn has been presenting her knights in shining armor with handcrafted replicas of...herself, fully clad in the finest silks from Bukyo.
minions.name: Dress-up Tataru

sources.text: Item code included with The Art of the Revolution -Eastern Memories-

minions.tooltip: Tataru's expression grows ever darker each time I see her pass by.    - Slafborn

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces minion summoning recast time by 50%.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up weapon minion. Somewhat buggy.
minions.enhanced_description: Scaled-down replicas of armored weapons have long been mass-produced by the Garlean Imperial Army in an effort to train new recruits in the proper methods of magitek deployment and repair.
minions.name: Wind-up Weapon
minions.tooltip: Be on your guard─ he's known to be armed!    - Brass Blade

verminion.skill_description:
Sets a trap that, when triggered, delivers an attack with a potency of 260 to all enemies within range.
**Activation Delay:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Qalyana minion. She may or may not break through the borderline.
minions.enhanced_description: The ex-Gatekeeper who crafted this doll claims her model was a Qalyana battlemaid who awoke from her reverie to join Alpa in the headstrong Vira's endeavor to protect the realm. She hopes it serves to strengthen the bond 'twixt the Ananta tribes.
minions.name: Wind-up Qalyana

sources.text: Madhura - Castellum Velodyna (The Fringes) - 7 Ananta Dreamstaves (Rank 9)

minions.tooltip: The Qalyana are another Ananta tribe─the strongest and the most influential.    - M'naago

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 30 and knocks back all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Redback minion. Don't tell mom the Kojin minion's red.
minions.enhanced_description: A master craftsman hailing from the Kojin of the Blue conceived this miniature automaton with the hopes that it might one day bring together his clan and the Kojin of the Red. How exactly an automaton might do that has yet to be determined...
minions.name: Wind-up Redback

sources.text: Shikitahe - Tamamizu (The Ruby Sea) - 5 Kojin Sango (Rank 9)

minions.tooltip: I'm a giant tortoise! A tortoise!    - Soroban

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 80 to all enemies within range while reducing DEF by 10%.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your minitek conveyor minion. The latest in miniature transport technology.
minions.enhanced_description: It is not in Garlean nature to leave well enough alone, and so imperial magitek engineers crafted miniature versions of their mountable conveyor unit. However, through some design flaw, the automaton atop the belt appears highly susceptible to possession by voidsent.
minions.name: Minitek Conveyor
minions.tooltip: Thankless job, carrier is.    - Ehcatl Nine Carrier

verminion.skill_description:
Binds all enemies within range.
**Duration:** 8s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Fran minion. Stilettos guaranteed not to impede progress through markedly rough terrain such as jungles, bogs, and abandoned monasteries serving as prisons for extra-dimensional forces of evil.
minions.enhanced_description: Taking a page from the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, Bangaa fusilier Rinok secretly commissioned the creation of scores of miniature Fran fetishes in an effort to fill the coffers of the perpetually under-funded resistance movement spearheaded by Lente's Tears.
minions.name: Wind-up Fran
minions.tooltip: Fran is not too bad, once you're on her good side.    - Rinok

verminion.skill_description: Reduces HP of enemy Shield by 70%. No effect if Shield is already inoperable.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Nu Mou minion. So cuddlesome it hurts.
minions.enhanced_description: Designed in the likeness of a former member of Clan Nutsy, this automaton appears so cuddlesome as if it were made of cotton. Most folk think twice about cuddling it, however, when they learn it was actually made by a Nu Mou claybender using mud and mushroom spores.
minions.name: Wind-up Nu Mou

sources.text: Xylle (The Crystarium) / Ilfroy (Eulmore) - 800 Sacks of Nuts

minions.tooltip: A ring, a ring, a wondrous thing, when its metal band hides a Nu Mou's sting!♪     - Nee Marn

verminion.skill_description: Grants 10 action points to all allies within range who do not have similar actions.

minions.description: Summon your Seitei minion. Dragon-ness is in the eye of the beholder.
minions.enhanced_description: While the true Seiryu has been documented as being more serpent than dragon, this replica of the azure auspice bears a striking resemblance to Kirin (though assurances have been made that this design decision was by no means a cost-cutting measure).
minions.name: Seitei

sources.text: Crafted by Weaver - The Wreath of Snakes (Extreme)

minions.tooltip: Hurry up and knock some sense into Seiryu's noggin!    - Kamaitachi

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 90 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your zephyrous zabuton minion. More pushing for another cushion.
minions.enhanced_description: It is well documented that Hingans shun chairs, preferring instead to sit upon the floor. What is less known, however, is that when a speaker utters something deemed clever, she is rewarded with cushions that she may sit in a position elevated above her peers.
minions.name: Zephyrous Zabuton

sources.text: Shikitahe - Tamamizu (The Ruby Sea) - 5 Kojin Sango (Rank 9)

minions.tooltip: We would be singing of mending socks and sitting on cushions.    - The Wandering Minstrel

verminion.skill_description: Transports action party to the central summoning Gate.

minions.description: Summon your abroader otter minion. Hobbies include playing and having fun on an island in the sun.
minions.enhanced_description: Legend tells of a right mad otter who, dissatisfied with the fare of his home waters, bought a ship and made south for more bountiful seas. There, he ate like a king...until his boat sank in a storm, leaving the slippery pup alone on stranger tides.
minions.name: Abroader Otter

sources.text: Subaquatic Voyages - Deep-sea Site (W), Sea of Ash (F/G/Q), Sea of Jade (A)

minions.tooltip: He seemed...odd. Well, odder than usual.    - Cocobezi

verminion.skill_description:
Doubles the amount of HP restored to allies stationed in Gates.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your hedgehoglet minion. Only your selfless love and affection can keep him blissfully dilemma-free.
minions.enhanced_description: For centuries, hedgehogs have been considered a delicacy in the Far East, their succulent flesh supped upon by prince and pauper alike. An influx of Western traders more interested in keeping the pups as pets, however, has all but put an end to this grisly tradition.
minions.name: Hedgehoglet
minions.tooltip: I need not explain what a needle is, I trust?    - Redolent Rose

verminion.skill_description: Removes all detrimental effects from all allies within range.

minions.description: Summon your brave new Y'shtola minion. Not wont to run from her troubles─and couldn't get very far, anyway.
minions.enhanced_description: Lovingly crafted by the Night's Blessed, this tiny mechanical Y'shtola─“Master Matoya,” to some─wears the black garb that marks her a member of their community, and bears a deadwood rod symbolizing her commitment to driving back the Light.
minions.name: Brave New Y'shtola
minions.tooltip: Did you really think I would go gently into that dark night with so much left undone?    - Y'shtola

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 90 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Ryne minion. Not merely a palette swap.
minions.enhanced_description: With hair of spun gold and eyes of clearest sapphire, this young maiden was an incarnation of Minfilia, by whose name she was known. In the course of her journey, however, she chose to take her destiny into her own hands, and with it came a new look, name, and automaton likeness.
minions.name: Wind-up Ryne
minions.tooltip: What about... Ryne?    - Thancred

verminion.skill_description:
Doubles the amount of HP restored to allies stationed in Gates.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your black hayate minion. Gaze upon the visage of a ruthless killer.
minions.enhanced_description: Despite their endearing appearance, black hayate are oft employed as guard and sheep dogs, as they react to threats with shocking ferocity. It was for this reason that the breed was named after a piece of lethal weaponry from its eastern homeland, now lost to the Flood.
minions.name: Black Hayate
minions.tooltip: They expected hounds on their trail and I sssent them a dragon!    - Eshana

verminion.skill_description:
Increases action party ATK by 40.
**Duration:** 15s

minions.description: Summon your chameleon minion and marvel as it melts into your surrounds.
minions.enhanced_description: By channeling aether into its crystal-coated scales, the chameleon can alter its appearance to blend into the surrounding environment in a mechanism not unlike that of glamour prisms. For its penchant for adopting new looks, it has earned a reputation as the “glamourous scalekin.”
minions.name: Chameleon
minions.tooltip: Oh, I suggest nothing so glamorous.    - Nero tol Scaeva

verminion.skill_description: Reduces HP of closest enemy Gate by 50%. No effect if Gate is already inoperable.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Fuath minion. Markedly less murderous than the real thing.
minions.enhanced_description: Though this clockwork automaton─magically rendered waterproof for amphibious adventuring─possess no heart in which to harbor malice, the fact that it was created at the hands of *real* Fuath is cause enough to wonder what tricks it may be hiding up its tiny sleeve.
minions.name: Wind-up Fuath
minions.tooltip: The first rule of dealing with the Fuath...is do *not* deal with the Fuath.    - Ardbert

verminion.skill_description:
Sets a trap that, when triggered, reduces the movement speed of all enemies within range by 70%.
**Duration:** 20s
**Activation Delay:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your armadillo bowler minion. Possessed of a superior sense of balance.
minions.enhanced_description: Armadillos are seldom caught without their rocks, which they use to defend themselves from enemies. As a large rock bespeaks strength and status, one may occasionally see bravado-bound beasts that unwisely choose something beyond their ability to lift.
minions.name: Armadillo Bowler
minions.tooltip: Who was that armored devil!?     - Alphinaud

verminion.skill_description:
Renders all allies within range immune to attacks by **monsters**.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your Great Serpent of Ronka minion. Tremble, child of man, for a creature of purest divinity wiggleth before thee.
minions.enhanced_description: This creature, Quinfort insists, is none other than the all-seeing, all-powerful Great Serpent of Ronka. Though its wobbly girth may deceive the eye, that is, presumably, a mere mark of the serpent's mercy, for its true form would be too terrible for mortal minds to comprehend.
minions.name: The Great Serpent of Ronka
minions.tooltip: Screee!    - The Great Serpent of Ronka

verminion.skill_description:
Increases action party movement speed by 30%. 
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your micro gigantender minion. Is it small or is it big? You be the judge.
minions.enhanced_description: Though known for their prodigious size, gigantenders come into the world small and grow ever so slowly. This creature is estimated to be between twenty and thirty years of age, which by gigantender standards is still considered young. The oldest known creatures are said to live beyond two centuries.
minions.name: Micro Gigantender
minions.tooltip: In another three hundred years, I'll be bigger and stronger than you will ever be!    - Ohl Deeh

verminion.skill_description: Delivers 8% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

minions.description: Summon your clionid larva minion, small on size but massive on appetite.
minions.enhanced_description: A relative of the sea slug, the clionid feeds on plankton early in life. As it matures, however, it begins consuming flesh in order to satisfy its voracious appetite, and uses the tentacles extending from its head to latch onto prey. For now it follows you obediently. For now...
minions.name: Clionid Larva
minions.tooltip: What a delicious morsel! I wanna get my tentacles around her...    - Ultros

verminion.skill_description: Reduces HP of enemy Search Eye by 90%. No effect if Search Eye is already inoperable.

minions.description: Summon your bitty duckbill minion. Do not attempt to put on your feet.
minions.enhanced_description: Named for its duck-like bill, this creature hunts not by sight or smell, but rather by sensing the aetheric discharge from prey. It can also deliver a potent venom from the spurs on its hindfeet, causing great pain if not death─a sobering contrast to its adorable appearance.
minions.name: Bitty Duckbill

sources.text: Xylle (The Crystarium) / Ilfroy (Eulmore) - 800 Sacks of Nuts

minions.tooltip: For what was once shattered may be forged anew.    - Ryne

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 380 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your giant beaver minion, a mystery better left unsolved.

minions.name: Giant Beaver

sources.text: Giant Beaver - Il Mheg - 1 Dancing Wing (Requires Quest "And Then There Were None")

minions.tooltip: Something tells me that's one more mystery better left unsolved.    - Ellie

minions.enhanced_description: Upon hearing the tale of his compatriot Soroban's adventures, a Kojin dollmaker was moved to honor the Four Lords, guardians of the Ruby Sea. This recreation of Suzaku is one of the fruits of his efforts, masterfully capturing the essence of the legendary auspice.

minions.tooltip: If anyone can make Suzaku see reason, it's you. Good luck!    - Senri

minions.enhanced_description: This automaton is the work of a goldsmith who desired to explore new definitions of beauty. Upon delivering a batch to the House of Splendors, the man is said to have declared, “To understand the one, one must understand the other. For their beauty lies in the whole.”
minions.name: Wind-up Omega-M
minions.tooltip: <bleep> hELLo, WOrlD!?

minions.enhanced_description: This automaton is the work of a goldsmith who desired to explore new definitions of beauty. minions.name: Wind-up Omega-F

minions.enhanced_description: Discovered fallen off the monstrous Archaeotania by an Ondo youth, this enigmatic instrument, half-bell and half-maiden, is believed to be either an adornment from ancient times or a recreation thereof. Upon it is inscribed an enchantment that amplifies magical power.
minions.name: Tinker's Bell

sources.text: Fathard - Eulmore - 6 Archaeotania's Horn (FATE "The Head, The Tail, the Whole Damned Thing" - The Tempest)

minions.tooltip: How do you measure half a bell anyway?    - Mauto

minions.description: Summon your tiny echevore minion. Its tail tastes like nectar...but you wouldn't know such things.
minions.enhanced_description: The scales on this critter's back are arranged in such a way as to put one in mind of the succulent echeveria. Lying concealed in tall grass, it lures insects with its tail, which secretes a sweet-tasting fluid akin to nectar.
minions.name: Tiny Echevore
minions.tooltip: I shall enjoy sucking on its tail for that sweet, sweet nectar taste!    - Overzealous Nu Mou

minions.description: Summon your sharksucker-class insubmersible minion. Warning: do not immerse.
minions.enhanced_description: Built by a mammet voyager in a moment of boredom, this clockwork ship raises several questions about machine ethics by its very existence. Another, perhaps more significant question it raises is, “Why build a functioning model submersible and not make it watertight?”
minions.name: Sharksucker-class Insubmersible

sources.text: Subaquatic Voyages - Sea of Ash (E/I/K/R), Sirensong Sea (H)

minions.tooltip: Not water! Anything but water!    - Zahar'ak Hatchling

minions.description: Summon your shoebill minion, an unflappable bird possessed of a regal air...or perhaps simply a condescending one.
minions.enhanced_description: Common to Kholusia, the shoebill is known for being literally unmoving. Its hunting effort consists of waiting for prey to wander by its feet before it deigns to strike. For reasons unknown, it saw fit to accept you as its master, and now follows you wherever you go...with the bare minimum of exertion.
minions.name: Shoebill
minions.tooltip: Love can move shoebills.    - Ancient Ballad

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces ATK of all enemies within range by 40%.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your butterfly effect minion. Illusory and therefore incapable of invoking any history-shattering consequences...right?
minions.enhanced_description: There is a theory which states that the fluttering of a butterfly's wings may give rise to a raging storm a thousand malms away. This crystal has nothing to do with that theory; rather, it is said to simply be the work of a priest of Ronka, created during a bout of boredom.
minions.name: Butterfly Effect

sources.text: Nacille - Fanow (The Rak'tika Greatwood) - 400 Bicolor Gemstones (Rank 3)

minions.tooltip: Take wing, ye souls of war!    - Ravana

verminion.skill_description: Grants 10 action points to all allies within range who do not have similar actions.

minions.description: Summon your ironfrog ambler minion, a darling, diminutive, dwarven-made...automaton.
minions.enhanced_description: This diminutive automaton is designed to automatically load itself with the ore which serves as its energy source. However, the function appears to be overactive, resulting in it compulsively checking whether the ore is present. The wind-up key is a purely aesthetic addition.
minions.name: Ironfrog Ambler

sources.text: Fathard - Eulmore - 6 Formidable Cog (FATE "A Finale Most Formidable" - Kholusia)

minions.tooltip: A-digging we will go!    - Korutt

verminion.skill_description: Delivers 5% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

minions.description: Summon your forgiven hate minion. Having repented its sins, it poses no danger.
minions.enhanced_description: A sin eater-esque something or other found on Mt. Gulg. Though it follows you relentlessly, as if driven by hate, it can do little save flutter about and occasionally unravel itself. There seems to be no harm in keeping it with you for now...
minions.name: Forgiven Hate
minions.tooltip: I'm just going to assume that cube is an eater.    - Thancred

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 30 and knocks back all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your bacon bits minion. Tastes like bacon...if bacon and clay taste the same to you.
minions.enhanced_description: After seeing a dream wherein they were being followed by a flying pig, a retainer out gathering absent-mindedly worked some clay into the creature's likeness. To their surprise, the creature suddenly sprang to life─most likely at the hands of a pixie bent on mischief.
minions.name: Bacon Bits
minions.tooltip: I am curious as to what mischief the flying pig has in mind...    - Sue-Rend

verminion.skill_description: Removes all effects from all enemies and allies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up pixie minion. Won't make mischief at your expense─pixie's honor.
minions.enhanced_description: The Dreamspinners present this mammet as a gift to those children whom they have befriended. Unlike a real pixie, it doesn't make mischief, so you don't need to constantly be looking over your shoulders.
minions.name: Wind-up Pixie

sources.text: Jul Oul - Lydha Lran (Il Mheg) - 8 Fae Fancies (Rank 6)

minions.tooltip: Come and play with us...    - Titania

verminion.skill_description: Restores 100 HP to all allies within range (150 if the ally is a **poppet**).

minions.description: Summon your mystic weapon minion. Only slightly cursed.
minions.enhanced_description: While out on a venture, your retainer discovered a timeworn blade and took it in their hand...whereupon a peculiar creature manifested. Though the weapon was believed to be cursed, the retainer was reportedly not concerned, as it was to be given to you in any case.
minions.name: Mystic Weapon
minions.tooltip: I ain't got the patience for no mystic rubbish today.    - Gerolt

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your meerkat minion. Keeps an eye out for danger while basking in the sun.
minions.enhanced_description: Native to lands bordering the Sea of Ash, these small beastkin dwell in underground colonies, emerging from their burrows as the sun rises in order to bask in the warmth. Curiosity brought this creature to a submersible undergoing repairs on the shore, and it hasn't looked back since.
minions.name: Meerkat

sources.text: Subaquatic Voyages - Sea of Ash (M/N/P), Sea of Jade (E/P), Sirensong Sea (B)

minions.tooltip: I am rather looking forward  to basking in the sunshine of her praise.    - Emmanellain

verminion.skill_description: Removes all detrimental effects from all allies within range.

minions.description: Summon your miniature white knight minion. Aids in the purging of sickness. Or not.
minions.enhanced_description: Crafted by the Skysteel Manufactory, this mammet was originally conceived for the Temple Knights to use in their strategizing, its mobility allowing for greater realism in battle simulations. Programmed to seek out formidable opponents.
minions.name: Miniature White Knight
minions.tooltip: Only a knight errant may break a stalemate.    - Drillemont

minions.enhanced_description: Lovingly crafted by an ex-Illuminati scientist now in the employ of the Garlond Ironworks, this colorful toy version of Brute Justice is composed of multiple pieces cast in solid zinc so that it may stand against even the most rambunctious of children.
minions.name: Cute Justice

sources.text: Maudlin Latool Ja - Ul'dah - 400 Allied Seals

minions.tooltip: Verdict: Guilty. Punishment: Eradication!    - Brute Justice

minions.description: Summon your domakin minion. Close, but not a warrior with the body of a mortal and soul of a dragon.
minions.enhanced_description: Reeled in by your retainer, this delightfully plump fish was created by a Doman goldfish enthusiast, its name a portmanteau of his nation and the local word for gold. It floats in the air by virtue of the cloudsbreath seeds it devoured, though how it manages to breathe is unknown.
minions.name: Domakin
minions.tooltip: Quite a catch indeed!    - Nortmoen

minions.tooltip: I find myself less and less inclined to sear your squid!    - Orn Khai

minions.description: Summon your little leannan minion. Doesn't see you as food. Yet.
minions.enhanced_description: Having just recently sprouted, this leannan young still possesses a mild temperament, but as its demands for nutrients grow, it will begin to hunt men and beasts alike. In preparation for this, it has already begun practicing its skills of enthrallment.
minions.name: Little Leannan
minions.tooltip: Seeds know no borders; they will sprout wheresoever the earth embraces them.    - Martineau

verminion.skill_description: Reduces HP of closest enemy Gate by 60%. No effect if Gate is already inoperable.

minions.enhanced_description: Contrary to what certain dwarves may claim, the hobgoblin upon which this mammet was based is no relation of yours; rather, it was a creature that was haunting your retainer's dreams. minions.name: Wind-up Hobgoblin
minions.tooltip: Your mother was a hobgoblin!    - Giott

minions.name: Cerberpup
minions.tooltip: We'll see if our bite's worse than our bark.    - Hilda

minions.name: Pod 054
minions.tooltip: Machines are not to be trusted, least of all those that can think.    - Estinien

minions.name: Pod 316
minions.tooltip: Machina are mighty and can smite muchly, yes, but they need fuel.    - Softknox

minions.name: Sungold Talos

minions.tooltip: A much smaller Talos from our company could just as easily perform the same task!    - Chai-Nuzz

minions.name: Malone
minions.tooltip: There are too many of them. Too many dinosaurs for us to face alone!    - Vath Braveheart

minions.name: Little Leafman

sources.text: Sul Lad - Lydha Lran (Il Mheg) - 400 Bicolor Gemstones (Rank 3)

minions.tooltip: We're going to get along like a leafman on fire, I just know it!    - Uin Nee

minions.name: The Behelmeted Serpent of Ronka

sources.text: Yuqurl Manl - Hopl's Stopple (The Rak'tika Greatwood) - 8 Qitari Compliments (Rank 4)

minions.tooltip: Scree! Scree!    - The Behelmeted Serpent of Ronka

minions.enhanced_description: Seeking to honor the Great Serpent of Ronka, the Stewards recreated the stylish ensemble it was once observed sporting, and made an offering of it to one of the divinity's incarnations gracing the Stopple. All agree that the outfit brings out the stately serpent's adventurous aspect.
minions.name: The Behatted Serpent of Ronka

sources.text: Yuqurl Manl - Hopl's Stopple (The Rak'tika Greatwood) - 8 Qitari Compliments (Rank 8)

minions.tooltip: Screee-eee!    - The Behatted Serpent of Ronka

minions.enhanced_description: This little bird suddenly appeared inside the hold of a submersible, in all likelihood wandering in when the mammet pilot surfaced the vessel and opened the hatch for fresh air. It has since gone on to charm everyone with its adorable appearance and antics.
minions.name: Silver Dasher

sources.text: Subaquatic Voyages - Sea of Ash (P), Sea of Jade (D/T), Sirensong Sea (C), South Indigo Deep (J)

minions.tooltip: Oh, isn't it adorable?    - Jihli Aliapoh

minions.enhanced_description: This paissa young was found amongst supplies sent from Camp Cloudtop. As punishment for pillaging the victuals, it was put to work in the kitchens, where it surprised everyone by demonstrating an aptitude for the culinary arts. The caramel milk tea it makes is to die for.
minions.name: Paissa Patissier
minions.tooltip: They don't come much curiouser than the paissa.    - Noelle

verminion.skill_description: Removes all beneficial effects from all enemies within range.

minions.enhanced_description: When mysterious embroidery began appearing on the garments of her Rose Knights, Lady Laniaitte set out to uncover the perpetrator. Her surveillance led to the capture of this paissa young, which was made to work in Ishgard's restoration as punishment, though it appears happy enough.
minions.name: Paissa Threadpuller
minions.tooltip: Death by ungainly paissa... thought mortifies Vanu worse than forgetting sundrop dance!    - Eenu Vanu

verminion.skill_description: Removes all detrimental effects from all allies within range.

minions.enhanced_description: This lifelike miniature of an ancient was recreated from a small concept crystal discovered in Anamnesis Anyder. Though believed to have been some manner of toy, given the towering stature of the ancients, its size is comparable to that of a Lalafellin child.
minions.name: Ancient One
minions.tooltip: The challenge of deciphering the wisdom of the ancients is a researcher's dream.    - Y'mhitra

verminion.skill_description:

**Duration:** 5s

minions.description: Summon your Major-General minion. It's a shark. With legs.
minions.enhanced_description: “Many heads are so passé. Legs are the wave of the future,” someone did say. Little did they know that there already were sharks that possessed not only legs, but arms besides. How these killing machines came to be, however, is a question left unpondered if you value your sanity.
minions.name: The Major-General

sources.text: No More Fish in the Sea I

minions.tooltip: To think I almost 'ad ye fed to the sharks!    - Rhoswen

minions.enhanced_description: On the occasion of their twentieth anniversary, Chai-Nuzz gifted his wife her mammet likeness, which he made using Talos construction techniques. It was subsequently presented to the departing Warrior of Darkness as a memento─with one small addition.
minions.name: Wind-up Dulia-Chai

sources.text: Item code included with The Art of Reflection -Histories Forsaken- Artbook

minions.tooltip: Dear─ Dearest─ I─ I can't─    - Chai-Nuzz

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers 10 points of damage every second to all enemies within range.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your amaro hatchling minion. It may make a fine steed if you live long enough to see it reach maturity.
minions.enhanced_description: This infantile amaro's wings are not yet strong enough to lift it more than an ilm or so off the ground, try as it might. Given enough time around people, it may gain the gift of speech, but with you for a master, that process may be somewhat delayed...
minions.name: Amaro Hatchling
minions.tooltip: Oh, how I envy the amaro. In all of creation, no animal is so pure, so perfect...    - Bethric

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces minion summoning recast time by 50%.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your Laladile minion. Because small is beautiful.
minions.enhanced_description: Unlike its monstrous cousins, this scalekin grows no more than a few fulms long and is docile besides. Once favored as a pet by Ishgardian nobility, who named it for the affable Lalafellin folk, it is known to befriend other creatures such as small birds.
minions.name: Laladile
minions.tooltip: Never fuss over a sarcosuchus.    - Traditional Children's Song

verminion.skill_description:
Renders ally Gates, Shield, and Search Eye impervious to damage.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your unlucky rabbit minion. Has known the bitterest lows and the sweetest highs.
minions.enhanced_description: Born of an idea proposed by Godbert Manderville, this leporine mammet proved tremendously popular in Ul'dah, but questions of ownership rights led to it serving as the mascot of the Platinum Mirage for a spell. It eventually returned to the Gold Saucer after legal matters were settled.
minions.name: Unlucky Rabbit
minions.tooltip: The damn things reproduce faster than rabbits in heat.    - Raganher

verminion.skill_description:
Increases action party movement speed by 30%. 
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your Lalinator 5.H0 minion. It doesn't feel pity, or remorse, or fear. And it absolutely will not stop, ever, until you have been lali-ho'd.
minions.enhanced_description: Wishing to improve his lackluster lali-hoing, Ronitt created this automaton in secret to be his practice partner. Boasting precision movement and powered by dwarven ethanol, it performs rousing lali-hos the equal of any dwarf worth his ale.
minions.name: Lalinator 5.H0
minions.tooltip: A “lali-ho” gets a “lali-ho,” you hear?    - Giott

verminion.skill_description:
Binds all enemies within range.
**Duration:** 5s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Mystel minion. Modeled upon no one in particular. No, really.
minions.enhanced_description: Desiring to honor a certain individual with a mammet likeness but knowing that it would go against his wishes to do so, the artisans of the Crystalline Mean came up with the perfect solution: make a mammet likeness anyway but give it a vague name. That makes everything all right...right?
minions.name: Wind-up Mystel
minions.tooltip: By any other name, I would still be a rose!    - Masked Rose

verminion.skill_description:

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Ardbert minion. What he lacks in size, he makes up for in heart...and his disproportionately large axe.
minions.enhanced_description: This mammet was created to honor Ardbert, the hero who fought to save the First as a Warrior of Light and Darkness both. His spirit lives on in all who has ever thought to lend a helping hand to his fellow man.
minions.name: Wind-up Ardbert
minions.tooltip: As brightly as a hero's tale shines, it is not without its shadows.    - The Wandering Minstrel

verminion.skill_description:
Renders ally Gates, Shield, and Search Eye impervious to damage.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your magitek helldiver F1 minion. Minimal firepower, maximum attitude.
minions.enhanced_description: Although a single-rider flying machina like the sky armor, the helldiver is an entirely different beast to handle due to its fundamentally distinct design. Thus were such scale models produced, that would-be pilots might study their flight dynamics prior to taking the helm.
minions.name: Magitek Helldiver F1
minions.tooltip: Did that man just bring down flying armor with a single stroke *in midair*?    - Aymeric

verminion.skill_description: Delivers 10% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

minions.description: Summon your weatherproof gaelicat minion. Makes you feel toasty warm simply to behold it.
minions.enhanced_description: It is theorized that the gaelicat's garb is no garb at all, but an extension of its corporeal form. That this specimen appears to be wearing a winter coat is the result of its adaptation to Coerthan climes, while its ample girth came about via a more mundane process: overeating.
minions.name: Weatherproof Gaelicat
minions.tooltip: There is no creature so heavenly as the cat!    - Feline Fanatic

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 80 to all enemies within range while reducing DEF by 13%.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your ephemeral necromancer minion. If it could, it would summon forth an army of equally adorable undead.
minions.enhanced_description: As a token of gratitude for playing with them, a pixie created for you this miniature version of the spectral necromancer, the hero from a distant world whom you fought. Whoever that mysterious maiden may have been, her tale may never be known.
minions.name: Ephemeral Necromancer
minions.tooltip: If you go and die on me, I'll pay a  necromancer to raise you from the dead so I can kill you out of spite!    - Renda-Rae

verminion.skill_description: Instantly restores damaged ally Shield.

minions.description: Summon your Allagan melon minion. Capable of movement and tremendously juicy.
