minions.enhanced_description: Born and raised at the ranch in Wachunpelo, this adolescent alpaca has a mild temperament and friendly disposition. Owing to its young age, its spit has yet to become smelly, so if you wish to indulge in its irresistible fluffiness, now is the ideal time.
minions.name: Alpaca Cria
minions.tooltip: The little monster spat on me!    - Wuk Lamat

verminion.skill_description:
Increases ATK and DEF of all allies within range by 40. The action party is immediately withdrawn from the playing field after execution.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your honeysuckler minion. Doesn't have a taste for blood...yet.
minions.enhanced_description: This juvenile creature belongs to a bloodsucking species native to Yok Tural known for preying upon livestock. Owing to their sanguine eyes, sharp fangs, protruding tongue, and spiky back, they have long been feared as demons, but they are harmless when young, feeding only on nectar until they are able to hunt.
minions.name: Honeysuckler
minions.tooltip: Suck the life out of my precious trees, will you!?    - Gabineaux

verminion.skill_description: Removes all beneficial effects from all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your not-so-bighorn minion. The bigger the horns, the brighter the future.
minions.enhanced_description: The horns of this Turali sheep can weigh as much as thirty-three ponzes, and the sound of their clashing in territorial battles is said to echo for malms around. Juvenile specimens that develop prominent horns are a rarity, held to be an elite among its kind.
minions.name: Not-so-bighorn
minions.tooltip: They call me “the Ram that batters,” not the “battered sheep”!    - Isaudorel

verminion.skill_description:
Inflicts a weakness to **critters** on all enemies within range.
**Duration:** 15s

minions.description: Summon your Ilyikty'i minion. A little cub that has aspirations to be a great hunter.
minions.enhanced_description: A close cousin to the coeurl, this feline native to Yak T'el has long been revered by the Xbr'aal, who are known to take in lost cubs to raise as capable hunting beasts. This particular creature has taken to you, and seems intent on honing its skills at your side.
minions.name: Ilyikty'i

sources.text: Rral Wuruq - Yak T'el - 700 Bicolor Gemstones (Rank 4)

minions.tooltip: Well, well, look what the coeurl drug in!    - Baderon

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces ATK of all enemies within range by 50%.
**Duration:** 15s

minions.description: Summon your quetzal minion. Do not be fooled by its winsome appearance─you are in the presence of *divinity*.
minions.enhanced_description: Making its home in the forests of Tural, this beautifully hued bird is deified as the herald of good fortune and abundant harvests. While ordinarily difficult to domesticate, this adventurous specimen was so taken by your retainer's tales, it decided to embark upon a journey with you.
minions.name: Quetzal
minions.tooltip: I daresay I'm *green* with envy.    - Shallow Moor

verminion.skill_description:
Increases DEF of all allies within range by 20.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your Squeak the Coyote minion. Quiet as a cloud and swift as a lightning bolt when on the prowl.
minions.enhanced_description: Being on the small side for a coyote, this creature might be mistaken for a fox save for its distinct greyish brown coat. It was roaming the land in search of purpose when it stowed away on a merchantman to arrive at the Wolves' Den, but not before being named “Squeak” by the sailor who discovered it in the ship's hold.
minions.name: Squeak the Coyote
minions.tooltip: Spend too long peering at the ground, and a coyote is sure to come and bite you on the arse.    - Thaffe

verminion.skill_description: Removes all detrimental effects from all allies within range.

minions.description: Summon your Rororrlo Teh minion. Caution: staring directly at its head may result in temporary blindness.
minions.enhanced_description: In the Yok Huy tongue, the name of this being means “a tiny little snow spirit that shines as if smiling in the moonlight.” They are born in the mountains of Urqopacha when the moon illuminates the snow, and when approximately four of them combine, they are said to become the larger Rorrlo Teh.
minions.name: Rororrlo Teh
minions.tooltip: Now give me a Coerthan winter! Enough ice and snow to bury a behemoth!    - Pipin

verminion.skill_description:
Binds all enemies within range.
**Duration:** 5s

minions.description: Summon your Cornservant minion. Will never let you go hungry.
minions.enhanced_description: At the conclusion of your travels with the Cornservant, the corn-shaped spirit that provides sustenance to the hungry, the being quietly left one of its kernels in your bag. That kernel quickly grew into another Cornservant, which ever regards you anxiously, worried that you might require a feed.
minions.name: The Cornservant
minions.tooltip: Where there are those in need of sustenance, I will be there.    - The Cornservant

verminion.skill_description: Restores 100 HP to all allies within range (150 if the ally is a **critter**).

minions.description: Summon your tankardtender minion. Rather more manageable than a barrel.
minions.enhanced_description: Once this adolescent barreltender has fully matured, it will possess the size and strength to vanquish foes with a single strike. For now, however, its needles are of the perfect potency for use in acupuncture to relieve ailments such as stiff shoulders and back pain.
minions.name: Tankardtender
minions.tooltip: If it ain't worth a tankard o' mead, I don't give two shites!    - Gerolt

verminion.skill_description:
Increases DEF of all allies within range by 10 (30 if the ally is a **monster**).
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your bluecoat cat minion. Surprisingly sweet-tempered despite its regal bearing.
minions.enhanced_description: A handsome breed of cat prized for its beautiful, bluish grey coat. Though some believe that it hails from northern Aldenard, its origin is still the subject of dispute. In recent years, a breeding program at the Studium has led to the bluecoat being seen in those lands with ties to Sharlayan.
minions.name: Bluecoat Cat

sources.text: Ryubool Ja - Tuliyollal - 800 Sacks of Nuts

minions.tooltip: Why is your laboratory overrun with felines? Did the stress finally break you?    - Margrat

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 90 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your speaking stone minion. Don't even think about getting it started.
minions.enhanced_description: This relic of the Yok Huy found in the Skydeep Cenote appears to be little more than a loud-mouthed mammet, but it is in fact the core of a stone golem. Having been divested of its shell, it now stalks you with a view to merge with the body of its destroyer.
minions.name: Speaking Stone
minions.tooltip: Might be as ol' Bremondt's a chatterbox, but he sure as hells ain't no busybody.    - Bremondt

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers 10 points of damage every second to all enemies within range.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Mamool Ja minion. Innocence never looked so adorable.
minions.enhanced_description: Appearing to be a piece of local handicraft, this mammet designed in the likeness of a Mamool Ja child was picked up by your retainer during a venture. From the traditional garments to the supple scales, so true to life are the details, one can only assume it was made by a most exacting artisan.
minions.name: Wind-up Mamool Ja
minions.tooltip: Traditional Mamool Ja bathing dance will be shunned no more!    - Bugaal Ja

verminion.skill_description:
Renders all allies within range immune to attacks by **critters**.
**Duration:** 5s

minions.description: Summon your mischief maker minion. Should only make mischief and not do you one, if the name is to be believed...
minions.enhanced_description: This souvenir clown doll was found at the Strayborough Deadwalk. A demonstration of electrope's capabilities, it moves as if it were a living thing, but it is merely an object and therefore can neither harbor malicious intent nor act upon them...knock on wood.
minions.name: Mischief Maker
minions.tooltip: I did not realize there was another clown in town!    - Papa Gruff

verminion.skill_description:
Sets a trap that, when triggered, delivers an attack with a potency of 260 to all enemies within range.
**Activation Delay:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your tin sentry T1 minion. It's your own fault if you get hit.
minions.enhanced_description: This toy soldier was popular centuries ago in the Alexandria of old. Legend has it the living Sphene was gifted one by a child she met when she had snuck into town, and it became the basis for the design of the mechanical soldiers that were developed shortly thereafter.
minions.name: Tin Sentry T1
minions.tooltip: It's time we gave that new toy of yours a proper field test.    - Cid

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your Ambrose the Unfinished minion. Unfinished it may be, but it is certainly not unwilling.
minions.enhanced_description: The researchers of Origenics created this miniaturized prototype in order to ascertain the effects of excess soul use in their latest test subject. For this purpose, the souls of small animals were infused into the unit, which may explain its tendency to follow after people.
minions.name: Ambrose the Unfinished
minions.tooltip: I'm only here because of unfinished business.    - Aldis

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 70 to all enemies within range while reducing movement speed by 50%.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your Black Kitten minion. Can you hold your own against her feline ferocity!?
minions.enhanced_description: An electrope doll designed in the likeness of Black Cat, the rising star of the Arcadion's light-heavyweight division. Harnessing the soul of the fearsome Cath Palug, she possesses razor-sharp claws and looks the part of a feline out to toy with her foe. All spectators can enter the draw for a chance to win one of their very own!
minions.name: Black Kitten
minions.tooltip: I hope you're ready to be ripped to shreds!    - Black Cat

verminion.skill_description:

minions.description: Summon your brushed-up Krile minion. She is not to be brushed off in the face of danger.
minions.enhanced_description: On the occasion of the anniversary of Eorzea's rebirth, the Adventurers' Guild commissioned a new mammet designed in Krile's likeness. With the hood of her pictomancer's attire drawn back to reveal her precious earring, she exudes a spirit of adventure and discovery.
minions.name: Brushed-up Krile
minions.tooltip: I'm eager to put my pictomancy to the proof.    - Krile

verminion.skill_description: Reduces action points of all enemies within range by 30% of the maximum value.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Zero minion. And thus she is returned.
minions.enhanced_description: A mammet inspired by a hero of the Thirteenth, who wandered alone for millennia after her world was consumed by Darkness. Sharing her taste in cuisine, the Hannish artisan responsible poured their heart into its creation and ensured accuracy in every detail, such as the scythe she wields from her days as an avatar.
minions.name: Wind-up Zero

sources.text: Item code included with Dawntrail Original Soundtrack

minions.tooltip: I will let it burn, this fire in my breast.    - Zero

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers 10 points of damage every second to all enemies within range.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Erenville minion. Happy to follow rather than guide you for a change.
minions.enhanced_description: A complementary companion to an illustrated encyclopedia, this automaton was commissioned by the Studium's publications department as part of a recruitment campaign for gleaners. Though designed in the likeness of Erenville, the man himself was not consulted on its creation on account of being afield at the time.
minions.name: Wind-up Erenville

sources.text: Item code included with The Art of Succession -Relics of Heritage- Artbook

minions.tooltip: Don't try to fool an expert.    - Erenville

verminion.skill_description:
Increases ATK of all allies within range by 10.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your Nano Lord minion. The land probably won't tremble before his might.
minions.enhanced_description: A diminutive manifestation of the Shadow Lord, which arose from the core of his memories in the wake of battle. While the original Shadow Lord was a dreaded existence in the world of Vana'diel, where he led the Beastman Confederate in a war of conquest against the Enlightened Races, this entity thankfully appears to pose no danger.
minions.name: Nano Lord
minions.tooltip: Minions of the Shadow Lord!?    - Iroha

verminion.skill_description:
Increases action party DEF by 40.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your uma-no-unicolt minion. Wishes to embark on a journey with one who is pure of heart.
minions.enhanced_description: On the occasion of the Heavensturn celebration, House Fortemps helped to secure the loan of this unicorn young to serve as the mascot for the visiting Far Eastern delegation. Though initially nervous to be away from home, the creature was able to find its stride at your side, and there it appears content to remain.
minions.name: Uma-no-unicolt
minions.tooltip: The unicorn must have sensed kinship in you.    - Braya

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 120 to all enemies within range while increasing action party ATK by 20.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your Adamant Weapon minion. A diamond by any other name would shine as bright─at least when scale is accounted for.
minions.enhanced_description: Retrieved from an imperial base, this scale prototype of a warmachina appears to have been created for counter G-Warrior testing and carries no armaments. After completing their analysis, the Eorzean Alliance saw fit to bestow it upon members as a reward for exemplary service.
minions.name: Adamant Weapon
minions.tooltip: 'Twould require a heart as hard as diamond to raise one's voice in anger to beings possessed of such profound...saccharinity.    - Urianger

verminion.skill_description: Delivers 8% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

minions.description: Summon your toco toquito minion. A tropical bird that is all beak and has a squawk to match.
minions.enhanced_description: Inhabiting the tropical forests of Tural, the toco toquito is most notable for its prodigious beak, which is deceptively light on account of being hollow. Further identifiable by its blue-ringed eyes and the reddish emblazoning upon its hind, it is also fondly referred to as the jewel of the forest.
minions.name: Toco Toquito
minions.tooltip: Why, this is it! The very jewel I spoke of!    - Sula

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces minion summoning recast time by 50%.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your shshuye minion. One day it may become a dread tural vidraal, but it is not this day.
minions.enhanced_description: Its name meaning “leaping sun” in the Shetona tongue, this variety of jackrabbit native to Yyasulani is held by the Shetona people to be a distant relative. In the past, a fearsome tural vidraal emerged from this otherwise harmless species and terrorized the people of Yuweyawata.
minions.name: Shshuye
minions.tooltip: Clearly, you are at a complete loss as to the identity of the virile gentle-rabbit who stands before you!    - Godbert

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your spinettesaurus minion. Small though it may be, never let it be said that it has no spine.
minions.enhanced_description: The young of a prehistoric reptile, this creature possesses protruding spines that are likened to a sail, which it uses to regulate body temperature and perform courtship displays. In contrast to its stunted forelimbs, it is blessed with powerful legs that allow it to move quickly and snatch up prey in its elongated jaws.
minions.name: Spinettesaurus
minions.tooltip: So long, spiny whatever-you-are.    - Languid Lominsan

verminion.skill_description:
Renders all allies within range immune to attacks by **monsters**.
**Duration:** 5s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Pelupelu minion. The perfect souvenir, if it does say so itself.
minions.enhanced_description: A series of this automaton was crafted by a potsworn goldsmith to serve as a promotional souvenir for the Pelupelu-run Turali Travel Agency. While the use of Kozama'uka lumber lends it a homespun appearance, it moves in a highly lifelike manner thanks to the advanced mechanisms within.
minions.name: Wind-up Pelupelu
minions.tooltip: The Pelupelu value the act of spreading joy through trade.    - Erenville

verminion.skill_description: Delivers 10% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

minions.description: Summon your tin soldier S3 minion. The toy with a body of tin and a heart of gold.
minions.enhanced_description: Boasting remarkably expressive movements despite its old-fashioned design, this tin soldier was brought to Limsa Lominsa on a vessel that plies the trade route west. According to the merchant who acquired it, such pieces were made in the likeness of a soldier of a bygone and faraway kingdom.
minions.name: Tin Soldier S3
minions.tooltip: I shall have to examine one of these mechanical soldiers later.    - Y'shtola

verminion.skill_description: Transports action party to the central summoning Gate.

minions.description: Summon your Deathservant minion. Literally has a taste for life.
minions.enhanced_description: In the course of being used in ritual sacrifices to ward off famine, this ancient stone dagger awakened as a malevolent spirit driven by an insatiable hunger for life force. By journeying with you and absorbing the essence of felled fiends, it is hoped that it will be able to suppress its murderous urges.
minions.name: The Deathservant
minions.tooltip: Another sacrificial ritual!    - X'rhun Tia

verminion.skill_description:
Sets a trap that, when triggered, delivers an attack with a potency of 260 to all enemies within range.
**Activation Delay:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your wisp of Darkness minion. What it cannot smother, it nibbles. What it cannot nibble, it tickles.
minions.enhanced_description: In the course of recalling your ferocious battle with the Cloud of Darkness, this curious mammet somehow came to be in your possession. While its design is highly reminiscent of the works of the notorious goldsmith who crafted the wind-up succubus, there is no way to ascertain the truth of its origin.
minions.name: Wisp of Darkness
minions.tooltip: I can't begin to imagine how powerful it must have been.    - Ryne

verminion.skill_description: Delivers 5% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Themis minion. A minion as loyal as your star is bright─a minion not bound by the confines of this world, or any other.
minions.enhanced_description: Designed in the likeness of Themis, two of these mammets were produced at Professor Claudien's behest, with one being delivered by your own hands to Erichthonios. Cutting-edge Sharlayan techniques were employed in its fabrication, that it might not look amiss in the world of the ancients.
minions.name: Wind-up Themis
minions.tooltip: Were my eyes mistaken? Was that Themis?    - Erichthonios

verminion.skill_description:
Inflicts a weakness to **poppets** on all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your Lawnblazer minion. Railroad not required.
minions.enhanced_description: Created by Xak Tural Railing as part of a publicity campaign, this toy locomotive marries a simple and warm design with spirited movement. So well received was the product by staff members, the company is entertaining the possibility of venturing into toy manufacturing in earnest.
minions.name: The Lawnblazer
minions.tooltip: Behold, the pinnacle of locomotive engineering!    - Shenza

verminion.skill_description:
Doubles the amount of HP restored to allies stationed in Gates.

minions.description: Summon your Psamathe minion. An entity born of the fire-wielding familiar Triton. That's the red one.
minions.enhanced_description: This peculiar entity appears to have manifested from Triton, the fire-wielding familiar that served among the collective of three that controlled the weather on the Occult Crescent. Though its intelligence has faded over the course of long years, in this diminutive state, it should largely be harmless.
minions.name: Psamathe
minions.tooltip: You would be well advised to ask yourself: can I stand the heat?    - Charlys

verminion.skill_description: Delivers 5% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

minions.description: Summon your Naiad minion. An entity born of the ice-wielding familiar Nereid. That's the purple one.
minions.enhanced_description: This peculiar entity appears to have manifested from Nereid, the ice-wielding familiar that served among the collective of three that controlled the weather on the Occult Crescent. Though its sense of morality has faded over the course of long years, in this diminutive state, it should largely be harmless.
minions.name: Naiad
minions.tooltip: I have no doubt that it is capable of chilling victims to the bone!    - The Impresario

verminion.skill_description: Grants 10 action points to all allies within range who do not have similar actions.

minions.description: Summon your Deimos minion. An entity born of the poison-wielding familiar Phobos. That's the green one.
minions.enhanced_description: This peculiar entity appears to have manifested from Phobos, the poison-wielding familiar that served among the collective of three that controlled the weather on the Occult Crescent. Though its sense of propriety has faded over the course of long years, in this diminutive state, it should largely be harmless.
minions.name: Deimos
minions.tooltip: Well, of course they'll be poisoned! How else would I gauge the efficacy of your work?    - Severian

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 120 and knocks back all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your boon baboon minion. May sound like a generous creature, but don't expect any favors.
minions.enhanced_description: The male of this species of baboon is identifiable by the luxurious growth of fur around its shoulders, which gives the impression of a mantle. In stark contrast, its buttocks are completely bare, with plump, red cheeks on display for all and sundry to see. In certain parts of the Far East, baboons are regarded fondly by avid readers due to their cry resembling the local name of a popular work of fantasy.
minions.name: Boon Baboon
minions.tooltip: This clearing is currently as bare as a white baboon's buttocks.    - Felicitous Furball

verminion.skill_description: Reduces HP of enemy Shield by 70%. No effect if Shield is already inoperable.

minions.description: Summon your clockwork oppressor. Painted a rugged shade of green, this miniature machina is a scale replica of the full-size model deployed in military training exercises.
minions.enhanced_description: An Ironworks machina enthusiast has replicated the Astragalos oppressor in tiny, toylike form. On account of its considerable bulk and heft, however, it failed to find willing merchants for distribution, and was ultimately repurposed as an allied training trophy.
minions.name: Clockwork Oppressor
minions.tooltip: We shall cast down the oppressors!    - Chalteaufite

minions.enhanced_description: Among the blue leafkin that inhabit Yak T'el, this particular creature is friendly to men, and dwelled near a settlement in the Ja Tiika Heartland. While superstition persists that that their kind are Mamool Ja who have been cursed, some believe that they are in fact pure souls who were reborn as guardians of the forest.
minions.name: Ja Tiika Leafkin

sources.text: Veerul Ja - Gok Golma (Yak T'el) - 8 Mamool Ja Nanook (Rank 6)

minions.tooltip: Have you heard of blue leafkin?    - Prudent Hunter

minions.description: Summon your Gulool Ja Ja minion. It watches your progress with great interest.
minions.enhanced_description: Designed in the likeness of Gulool Ja Ja, this mammet was created to commemorate the seventieth anniversary of his ascension as Dawnservant. It would seem that those Mamool Ja who journeyed to Eorzea brought these units with them with the intent of impressing upon the locals the glory of their kind.
minions.name: Wind-up Gulool Ja Ja
minions.tooltip: Gulool Ja Ja, mightiest of the blessed...arise!    - Zereel Ja

verminion.skill_description:
Increases ATK of all allies within range by 20 (40 if the ally is a **poppet**).

minions.description: Summon your micro rover minion. Won't be moving mountains, but can handle pebbles with aplomb.
minions.enhanced_description: This miniaturized model of a utility vehicle used in the Cosmic Exploration Initiative was produced for the amusement of young children. While it faithfully incorporates all the functions of the original machine and can perform various tasks, it lacks the power to move anything beyond pebbles.
minions.name: Micro Rover
minions.tooltip: Looking for a ride on the burrow's best rover?    - Drivingway

verminion.skill_description: Reduces action points of all enemies within range by 50% of the maximum value.

minions.description: Summon your tipping tortoise minion. Would be a generous tipper if its coins were real.
minions.enhanced_description: This tortoise possessed of a gleaming golden shell appears to be the offspring of the trade tortoise, the creature that sought to peddle cursed artifacts on the Occult Crescent. On account of its tender age, however, it is not yet permitted to handle legal tender, and must make do with imitation coins.
minions.name: Tipping Tortoise
minions.tooltip: I'd almost forgotten what it was like to feel the weight of coins in my pocket...    - Eismon

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces movement speed of all enemies within range by 70%.
**Duration:** 5s

minions.description: Summon your royal hound minion. As loyal as it is royal.
minions.enhanced_description: This bright-eyed canine is believed to be descended from hounds that were once bred by the royal family of Alexandria for hunting foxes and deer. Fiercely loyal by nature, it had long sought a worthy master to serve, and appears to have found one in you.
minions.name: Royal Hound
minions.tooltip: You've got the nose of a bloodhound.    - Midnight Dew

verminion.skill_description:
Renders all allies within range immune to attacks by **monsters**.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your Skallic uolosapa minion. A winsome bird with pure white feathers and a pink beak.
minions.enhanced_description: In ages past, the uolosapa was brought from the south sea isles to the nation of Skalla, where it quickly gained popularity as a pet. In the course of being bred in captivity, a specimen emerged that possessed pure white feathers, the descendants of which have been treated as a variety unto themselves to this day.
minions.name: Skallic Uolosapa
minions.tooltip: I seem to have made a feathered friend.    - Fufucha

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your Seikret fledgling minion. Dreams of the day it attains rugged good looks and colorful feathers.
minions.enhanced_description: The fluffy young of a Seikret, a beast of burden native to a faraway world. While full-grown creatures look imposing with their sharp countenance and bright plumage, chicks are plump and white in contrast, and cut a winsome figure scrambling after their masters as they train to become fully fledged mounts.
minions.name: Seikret Fledgling
minions.tooltip: Is that a hint of melancholy I detect in thy voice? Something akin to a pining mother bird whose chicks have flown the nest...    - Urianger

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces DEF of all enemies within range by 50%.
**Duration:** 15s

minions.description: Summon your Vigorwasp minion. Rest assured it won't dump its sac of nectar on you.
minions.enhanced_description: Thought to have arrived from another world, this variety of wasp is unique for hoarding nectar in an impressively large sac on its abdomen. In its native land, it primarily harvests the nectar of Vitalilies, whose healing properties make the creature sought after among seasoned hunters out in the wilds.
minions.name: Vigorwasp
minions.tooltip: So many ideas, like a swarm of wasps...making the mind race.    - Lost Chirurgeon

verminion.skill_description: Restores 100 HP to all allies within range (150 if the ally is a **critter**).

minions.description: Summon your model suit minion. Comes complete with pocket-sized pilot.
minions.enhanced_description: This meticulously handcrafted toy is modeled on the vacuum suit developed for use in the Cosmic Exploration Initiative. Rumor has it the initiative was approached by a certain machina enthusiast from Garlond Ironworks, whose unbridled passion for the suit paved the way for the production of these miniaturized units.
minions.name: Model Suit
minions.tooltip: These vacuum suits are a sight to behold...    - Cosmic Exploration Initiative Member

verminion.skill_description: Disarms deployed enemy traps.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Yok Huy minion. Gazes out into eternity with eyes unblinking.
minions.enhanced_description: With the cooperation of the Pelupelu, their business-minded neighbors, the Yok Huy produced a series of this mammet as a souvenir for visitors to Zirgorteh the Open-armed. Boasting nimble movement ordinarily unseen on their stout physique, it has also proven popular among the Yok Huy themselves.
minions.name: Wind-up Yok Huy
minions.tooltip: We shall soon come face-to-face─ or rather, face-to-knee─with those enormous Yok Huy.    - Alphinaud

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces movement speed of all enemies within range by 50%.
**Duration:** 5s

minions.description: Summon your raven-red gobtank. Faster than the blue one.
minions.enhanced_description: An Ironworks machina enthusiast has replicated the Ravens-colored Astragalos gobtank in tiny, toylike form. Though originally meant to be marketed with the permission of the goblins, negotiations broke down over the profit margin, and it was ultimately repurposed as an allied training trophy.
minions.name: Raven-red Gobtank
minions.tooltip: Pshhh... Gobbies whack for Ravens muchly!    - Goblin Mercenary

verminion.skill_description: Delivers 5% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

minions.description: Summon your falcon-blue gobtank. Stronger than the red one.
minions.enhanced_description: An Ironworks machina enthusiast has replicated the Falcons-colored Astragalos gobtank in tiny, toylike form. Though originally meant to be marketed with the permission of the goblins, negotiations broke down over the profit margin, and it was ultimately repurposed as an allied training trophy.
minions.name: Falcon-blue Gobtank
minions.tooltip: Pshhh... Gobbies whack  for Falcons muchly!    - Goblin Mercenary

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Eald'narche minion. After ten long millennia, the dreams of the Zilart will become reality!
minions.enhanced_description: A diminutive manifestation of Eald'narche, which arose from the core of his memories in the wake of battle. While the original Eald'narche was a cunning mastermind who threatened the world of Vana'diel with his brother, Archduke Kam'lanaut, this entity thankfully appears to pose no danger.
minions.name: Wind-up Eald'narche
minions.tooltip: Have you the strength to find the answers you seek?    - Eald'narche

verminion.skill_description:
Sets a trap that, when triggered, reduces the movement speed of all enemies within range by 70%.
 **Duration:** 20s 
 **Activation Delay:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your rroneek calf minion. Has tusks and horns and isn't afraid to use them.
minions.enhanced_description: The young of a hulking herbivore native to the continent of Tural. The patterns upon the faces of juveniles are pale and uneven, but gain in boldness and definition as they age. Even if they are still small, the creatures leave their parents' side when both their tusks and horns have sufficiently developed, as is the case with this calf.
minions.name: Rroneek Calf
minions.tooltip: Look at you all, shaking like rroneek calves!    - Nitowikwe

verminion.skill_description:
Increases ATK of all allies within range by 25.
 **Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your micro crow minion. Clever and loyal─what more could one ask for?
minions.enhanced_description: This crow found at a laboratory within the Meso Terminal was formerly an experimental subject. After researchers vanished from the facility, it managed to survive thanks to its cage's emergency power supply and automatic feeding system. Possessed of great intelligence and a strong sense of duty, it has decided to follow its liberator.
minions.name: Micro Crow
minions.tooltip: This would solve all our problems in one fell swoop!    - Benathaire

verminion.skill_description: Knocks back all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Feo Ul. As your lovely branch, it will lend you its strength!
minions.enhanced_description: This automaton designed in likeness of Feo Ul, a pixie of the First, was brought into being through the magicks of none other than the newly crowned Titania themself, who desired that you might always have your beautiful branch at your side. Its irrepressible cuteness and charm are true to life.
minions.name: Wind-up Feo Ul
minions.tooltip: Come what may, your beautiful branch will ever be at your side.    - Feo Ul

verminion.skill_description:
Sets a trap that, when triggered, delivers an attack with a potency of 180 to all enemies within range.
**Activation Delay:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your sunray ray minion. Its eyes are up here.
minions.enhanced_description: A variety of stingray native to Yok Tural, so named for the way it is believed to pierce the clouds like a ray of sunlight. On account of its majestic movement and its underside having the appearance of a friendly face, it has come to be worshipped as a guardian deity by the peoples who dwell by the waters of Zorgor.
minions.name: Sunray Ray
minions.tooltip: This may sting a little.    - Honey B. Lovely

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces movement speed of all enemies within range by 70%.
**Duration:** 5s

minions.description: Summon your mini yan minion. A sheep spirit whose child-pleasing form and diminutive size belie its might.
minions.enhanced_description: According to legends in the Ninth, this peculiar creature is a sheep spirit that, despite its adorable form, strikes fear into the hearts of all who encounter it. Though this particular entity appears to have taken a liking to you, you would do well to remember that it is possessed of unknowable power.
minions.name: Mini Yan
minions.tooltip: Yer sheep's got magical powers?    - Traveling Merchant

verminion.skill_description:
Doubles the amount of HP restored to allies stationed in Gates.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your gimme kitten minion. An ill-mannered winged feline fiend that wants everything.
minions.enhanced_description: This mischief-loving fiend said to mimic spirits in the Ninth is known to have a liking for precious stones, which it will brazenly demand from those it encounters. Though its mood will turn foul if refused, neither will satisfying its desire win you its gratitude, so there is little to be gained from knowing it...but here we are.
minions.name: Gimme Kitten
minions.tooltip: Gimme an elixir! No, that's not right...    - Magic Pot

verminion.skill_description: Removes all beneficial effects from all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your sin beaver minion. Another mystery better left unsolved.
minions.enhanced_description: A mysterious being that appeared in Pilgrim's Traverse. When sin eater meets giant beaver, which one becomes the other? Whatever may be the truth of its existence, some mysteries only deepen the more one ponders them...
minions.name: Sin Beaver
minions.tooltip: 'Tis truly a mystery among mysteries.    - G'raha Tia

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces DEF of all enemies within range by 50%.
**Duration:** 15s

minions.description: Summon your little mermaid minion. Wishes to be a little part of your world.
minions.enhanced_description: Legends pertaining to mermaids are common in the Corvos region, foremost among them the tale of a mermaid princess who falls in love with a man. Perhaps influenced by said tale, this diminutive entity born of an arcane pattern in an illuminated manuscript has chosen to accompany you on your journeys.
minions.name: Little Mermaid
minions.tooltip: Are you a mermaid!?    - Hokushin

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 60 to all enemies within range while reducing movement speed by 70%.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your magic lamp minion. Phenomenal cosmic powers in an itty-bitty living space.
minions.enhanced_description: Manifesting from an arcane pattern in an illuminated manuscript, this oil lamp appears to be home to a genie. Unlike the lamp-dwelling spirit of Corvosi legend that grants wishes, however, this one is hesitant to show itself, perhaps needing more time to decide whether you are a worthy master.
minions.name: Magic Lamp
minions.tooltip: It's probably some source of phenomenal cosmic power that's key to his plans.    - Cid Garlond

verminion.skill_description:
Increases action party movement speed by 30%. 
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your Droningway minion. No Loporrit will go missing on its watch.
minions.enhanced_description: Modified to serve as an autonomous search and rescue unit, this transport drone is equipped with a reinforced robotic hand that takes hold of lost Loporrits for secure conveyance back to base. When no one is missing, it is programmed to pass the time by tracking random individuals.
minions.name: Droningway
minions.tooltip: The moon will be as safe as safe can be once the drones are refurbished.    - Brawny Loporrit

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces movement speed of all enemies within range by 70%.
**Duration:** 5s

minions.description: Summon your G-Warrior MGSD minion. The “MGSD” part of its name supposedly stands for “Master Garlond Superior Design,” or something along those lines.
minions.enhanced_description: An Ironworks machina enthusiast has replicated the G-Warrior in tiny, toylike form. Boasting incredible detail despite their diminutive size, these units are being offered as an allied training trophy as part of a publicity campaign for the Garlond Ironworks.
minions.name: G-Warrior MGSD
minions.tooltip: I present Garlond Ironworks' adaptation of the Ultima Warrior, the G-Warrior!    - Cid Garlond

verminion.skill_description: Renders both ally and enemy Shields and Search Eyes inoperable. The action party is immediately withdrawn from the playing field after execution.

minions.description: Summon your La Noscean shorthair minion. Will hunt rodents for board and lodging.
minions.enhanced_description: This variety of feline originating from Vylbrand is identifiable by its plush grey fur, and owing to their talent as rodent hunters, they have long been considered a sailor's best friend. Recently, they have been found inhabiting the Occult Crescent, perhaps the descendants of creatures that arrived aboard grounded vessels.
minions.name: La Noscean Shorthair
minions.tooltip: Heeere kitty, kitty, kitty, kitty, kitty!    - Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic

Delivers 10 points of damage every second to all enemies within range.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your gallant shepherd minion. Courageous and loyal, it does credit to caninekind.
minions.enhanced_description: Since olden times, this robust breed of canine has served men as sheep and guard dogs both, and sailors are known to take them on voyages for protection at ports of call. Recently, they have been found inhabiting the Occult Crescent, perhaps the descendants of creatures that arrived aboard grounded vessels.
minions.name: Gallant Shepherd
minions.tooltip: As a shepherd leads his flock, I shall guide you to my irrefutable conclusion!    - Hildibrand

verminion.skill_description:
Increases action party ATK by 40.
**Duration:** 15s

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Red XIII. He is that which you see before you. Nothing less.
minions.enhanced_description: Legends tell of a four-legged beast, one of the last of his long-lived kind, who was possessed of reason and capable of speech. After escaping his captivity at a research facility, he cast aside his specimen designation, and with his new comrades went on to fight for the fate of the very star.
minions.name: Wind-up Red XIII
minions.tooltip: I saw a flash of red in that instant.    - Lalah Jinjahl

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 80 to all enemies within range while reducing DEF by 13%.
**Duration:** 6s

minions.description: Summon your Grooving Green minion. Can you keep up with the rhythm?
minions.enhanced_description: An electrope doll designed in the likeness of Dancing Green, the grooviest fighter in the Arcadion's cruiserweight division. Harnessing the soul of a terrible toad, he possesses a supremely supple body and the stamina to dance the night away. Join in the excitement at the arena and obtain limited-edition merchandise!
minions.name: Grooving Green
minions.tooltip: On the dance floor, everyone's a star!    - Dancing Green

verminion.skill_description:
Renders ally Gates, Shield, and Search Eye impervious to damage.
**Duration:** 20s

minions.description: Summon your Mistic condor minion. Feed it only perfectly cooked flesh, lest you incur its displeasure.
minions.enhanced_description: A large bird native to the Mist Continent that feeds on the flesh of dead animals. Formerly devouring only raw meat, the environment of the Ninth led its kind to develop a taste for lightning-seared morsels, and it is known to patiently wait for its prey to be struck by a lightning bolt.
minions.name: Mistic Condor
minions.tooltip: I had to dodge some lightning bolts, but I made it!    - Trainee Hunter

verminion.skill_description: Delivers 5% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

minions.description: Summon your soothing sea-beast minion. To simply behold its pleasing form is to be soothed to the soul.
minions.enhanced_description: Born of an arcane pattern in an illuminated manuscript, this entity assumes the likeness of the young of a sea creature native to the Corvosi coastline. The pastel hues of its iridescent skin allow it to blend in with the coral reefs it calls home, and it is believed to be kin to mermaids.
minions.name: Soothing Sea-beast

sources.text: Trisassant - Old Sharlayan - 12 Pieces of Corvosi Brass

minions.tooltip: Pshhh... Your seabeast sssteed awaits!    - Novv

verminion.skill_description:
Reduces ATK of all enemies within range by 50%.
**Duration:** 15s

minions.description: Summon your Senor Otter minion. An otter and a gentleman.
minions.enhanced_description: This automaton brings the odder otter to life in the gentlemanly attire of Senor Sabotender, one of the Gold Saucer's beloved mascots. Masterfully crafted by the inimitable Godbert Manderville for an event, it was distributed among select collaborators, with proceeds to go towards otter conservation efforts.
minions.name: Senor Otter
minions.tooltip: This is the legacy of the very first Senor Sabotender!    - Nanaphon

verminion.skill_description:
Increases action party ATK by 60.
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your little blue viking minion. Formerly red and vicious.
minions.enhanced_description: This automaton was deployed in Astragalos campaigns until it was inevitably incapacitated by adventurers. While such units are often damaged beyond repair, this example proved salvageable, and it was repurposed as an escort. Formerly red and vicious, it is now possessed of a calm temperament.
minions.name: Little Blue Viking
minions.tooltip: I borrowed this arena viking for you to demonstrate a few spells.    - Martyn

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 30 and knocks back all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your little red viking minion. Formerly blue and ruthless.
minions.enhanced_description: This automaton was deployed in Astragalos campaigns until it was inevitably incapacitated by adventurers. While such units are often damaged beyond repair, this example proved salvageable, and it was repurposed as an escort. Formerly blue and ruthless, it is now possessed of a gentle temperament.
minions.name: Little Red Viking
minions.tooltip: The Goldsmiths' Guild provides many of the mechanical combatants.    - Royse

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

minions.description: Summon your junior jinbei minion. A baby whale shark by any other name would be just as calm and carefree.
minions.enhanced_description: In the Far East, whale sharks are known as jinbei-zame on account of their markings, which resemble those typically seen on the jinbei, a traditional summer garment. This young creature is exceptionally placid by nature, and has taken to following you in hopes of being led to new waters.
minions.name: Junior Jinbei
minions.tooltip: The Navigator waits for no man─or shark!    - Foerzagyl

verminion.skill_description: Reduces HP of closest enemy Gate by 90%. No effect if Gate is already inoperable.

minions.description: Summon your caprino minion. So adorable you'll let it get away with anything.
minions.enhanced_description: Originating from the region of Corvos, this variety of goat spread north alongside Garlean migration, and products made with its milk were once common in the imperial capital. This young creature appears to have lost its master in the chaos of civil war, and it now looks to you to protect and pamper it.
minions.name: Caprino
minions.tooltip: The cranky old goat will have my hide.    - Theopauldin

verminion.skill_description: Delivers an attack 5 times the potency of the caster's ATK.

minions.description: Summon your wind-up Prishe minion. Ya ready for this?
minions.enhanced_description: This diminutive manifestation of Prishe arose from a fragment of electrope, which was left behind when her echo incarnation faded away. She had come to love this world as a second home, and this entity may well be the materialization of her desire to remain here.
minions.name: Wind-up Prishe
minions.tooltip: Prishe has taken the lead, but we won't be outdone, surely?    - Alxaal

verminion.skill_description:
Increases action party movement speed by 30%. 
**Duration:** 10s

minions.description: Summon your musical paca minion. Has an instrumental burden to carry so never skips leg day.
minions.enhanced_description: This alpaca cria is the offspring of creatures that were kept as pack animals by traveling musicians. The time it spent with the troupe gave it a taste for the itinerant lifestyle, and it was immediately drawn to you. Every day, it trains its legs in hopes of being able to carry heavy instruments like its parents.
minions.name: Musical Paca
minions.tooltip: Ugh, why did it have to be alpacas...    - Wuk Lamat

verminion.skill_description: Grants 10 action points to all allies within range who do not have similar actions.

minions.description: Summon your sweetkit minion. Smells as sweet as it looks.
minions.enhanced_description: This stray kitten once prowled the Studium's grounds until an experimental sweetener, surreptitiously eaten, turned the markings on its coat a distinctive pink, and it began giving off a sweet scent. Feeling responsible for its state, the researcher put out a call for adoption in academic journals.
minions.name: Sweetkit
minions.tooltip: Nothing is sweeter than the fruits of one's labors.    - Fahrafahr

verminion.skill_description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 30 to all enemies within range while reducing DEF by 30%.
 **Duration:** 6s

mounts.description: Summon your Grand Company-issued battle chocobo.
mounts.enhanced_description: Born and bred in the city–state of Ishgard, the majority of company chocobos are geldings of the rouncey variety; however, massive destriers and miniature Belah'dian jennets are also raised to accommodate the builds of Roegadyn and Lalafellin riders respectively.
mounts.name: Company Chocobo
mounts.tooltip: Chocobos are stout-hearted creatures, but they have their limits.   - Mimigun

mounts.description: Use the odd-shaped horn gifted to you by the wandering minstrel to call a massive goobbue to your side.
mounts.enhanced_description: Traded for a song by the High Satrap of a distant land, the secret to taming these creatures once thought to be unbreakable was introduced to Eorzea by a mysterious wandering minstrel who journeyed through the realm in the final days before the Calamity.
mounts.name: Goobbue

sources.text: At level 30 or above, speak with the Wandering Minstrel in Eastern La Noscea (Final Fantasy XIV 1.0)

mounts.tooltip: Would that I had the girth of a goobbue!   - Nanamo Ul Namo

mounts.description: Five years and a realm-shaking Calamity were not enough to break the bonds between you and your loyal steed. A single whistle and he will be at your side once again.
mounts.enhanced_description: In the five years following your sudden disappearance from the Carteneau Flats, your ever-faithful chocobo spent each waking moment galloping across the realm in search of his lost master. His myriad adventures are nothing less than fantastical and heartbreaking...but that is a story for another day.
mounts.name: Legacy Chocobo
mounts.tooltip: Go find the chocobo you rode in on, and ride on out.   - Sevrin

mounts.description: Call into battle your suit of Garlond Ironworks-modified magitek armor.
mounts.enhanced_description: This suit of Garlean-developed reaper-class magitek battle armor has had its original control systems purged and replaced with a new, modified core built by Cid of the Garlond Ironworks.
mounts.name: Magitek Armor
mounts.tooltip: At last, our very own suit of magitek armor!   - Cid Garlond

mounts.description: Summon your fleet-footed battle coeurl, trained from a pup to recognize you as a friend...not food.
mounts.enhanced_description: Native to the jungles of the Near East, coeurls were only recently introduced to Eorzea, brought over from faraway lands such as Thavnair by Ul'dahn nobles who thought to breed them as pets. Now, but a handful of skilled tamers living in recluse on the Pearl are said to be able to train them.
mounts.name: Coeurl
mounts.tooltip: Hey, good lookin'! Catch my coeurl yet?   - Swygrael

mounts.description: Summon forth a riding ahriman, bound to this realm with powerful magicks guaranteed to never fade.
mounts.enhanced_description: Though little is known of the void and the creatures which call the extra-dimensional realm home, scholars have discovered that there is a strict hierarchy amongst voidsent consisting of twelve distinct tiers. Ahrimans are believed to fall into the fifth, making them formidable foes...when not enthralled by curses.
mounts.name: Ahriman
mounts.tooltip: Ye'd 'ave t' be blinder'n an ahriman wi' an eyepatch t' miss the camp.   - Baderon Tenfingers

mounts.description: Summon forth the single-horned steed you befriended in the Black Shroud.
mounts.enhanced_description: Not long ago, Eorzean unicorns numbered in the thousands, and could oft be seen roaming the Coerthas highlands in great majestic herds that would render the mountains white as snow. Poaching has caused the population to decline, and if it were not for your act of kindness, there would be one fewer.
mounts.name: Unicorn
mounts.tooltip: Your precious horses, they're just unicorns with a big empty forehead.   - Chief Chocowacker

mounts.description: Summon your mighty behemoth, trained from birth to carry you...not trample you underfoot like an ant.
mounts.enhanced_description: Immediately following the Calamity, an adventurer returning to Gridania from Falcon's Nest in Coerthas claims to have happened upon a den of baby behemoths who had lost their mother. Despite objections from friends and family alike, she kept the beasts, eventually training them to serve as mounts.
mounts.name: Behemoth
mounts.tooltip: Do not presume to provoke the behemoth to battle. You will die.   - Meurise

mounts.description: Summon your cavalry drake, trained by the drake whisperer of the Brotherhood of Ash.
mounts.enhanced_description: Training a cavalry drake is a long and arduous process that begins the moment the scalekin hatches. Never allowed to see its mother, the creature is raised solely in the presence of a drake whisperer while being weaned on the incendiary glands of aged battle drakes to ensure it is both submissive and deadly.
mounts.name: Cavalry Drake

sources.text: Amalj'aa Vendor - Ring of Ash (Southern Thanalan) - 120,000 Gil (Rank 4)

mounts.tooltip: You are as a lost kitten that has wandered into the drake's lair.   - Zagozz Teh

mounts.description: Summon your laurel goobbue, towering friend to the sylphs.
mounts.enhanced_description: After having the moss and flowers growing upon his head pulled up and tossed aside like common weeds by a band of sylvan ne'er-do-wells, this quiet-mannered goobbue was taken in and cared for by the sylphs of Little Solace whose elders crafted for him a magnificent laurel with which to hide his scars.
mounts.name: Laurel Goobbue

sources.text: Sylphic Vendor - Little Solace (East Shroud) - 120,000 Gil (Rank 4)

mounts.tooltip: Naught is as exhilarating as a romp through the forest on goobbueback.   - Unknown

mounts.description: Call into battle your gilded suit of magitek armor. Its golden coating serves to resist magicks while impressing members of the opposite sex.
mounts.enhanced_description: It only took a few heated skirmishes with the allied city–states for Garlemald to realize that the magicks wielded by the realm's mages were too much for even the thickest of magitek armor plating. Alloyed gilding has since been discovered to dampen the effects of elemental charges and is now standard-issue.
mounts.name: Gilded Magitek Armor
mounts.tooltip: You ditched your magitek armor!? Fool of a Lalafell!   - Biggs

mounts.description: Summon forth the single-horned steed with a temperament as black as his coat.
mounts.enhanced_description: While it is no secret that it was the enigmatic Ascians who provided the beast tribes with nightmares, their reasons for doing so remain shrouded in mystery. Otherwise untamable, the single piercing tone of a magicked whistle is the only method known to soothe the savage beasts.
mounts.name: Nightmare
mounts.tooltip: See the nightmare for reality, and ready thyself for the coming chaos!   - Urianger

mounts.description: Summon forth your fat chocobo mount. Take care that there is sufficient room for his ample girth.
mounts.enhanced_description: Playfully described by some as “large and in charge,” in truth, when summoned, this gluttonous gourmand will flap nary a feather unless a garland of gysahl greens is dangled before him─in which case not even the laws of nature can slow the fat chocobo down.
mounts.name: Fat Chocobo
mounts.tooltip: Huff...huff...heave...heave...   - Fat Chocobo

mounts.description: Summon your cavalry elbst, raised from an egg by Pahh of Novv's Clutch.
mounts.enhanced_description: To ensure his elbst do not find themselves at a disadvantage to swift-running chocobos, Pahh of Novv's Clutch clips the webbing on their feet at a young age, rendering them more capable of achieving high speeds on land─though they will ever be slower than their brethren while underwater.
mounts.name: Cavalry Elbst

sources.text: Sahagin Vendor - Novv's Nursery (Western La Noscea) - 120,000 Gil (Rank 4)

mounts.tooltip: My elbst is your elbst.   - Pahh

mounts.description: Summon forth a bevy of bombs who will bear you in comfort upon a hovering palanquin.
mounts.enhanced_description: Upon learning that his creations were forever lacking the power to combust, 789th Order Acolyte Ba Go did what any master of explosives would─attach the bombs to the corners of an iron bench and create a floating coach.
mounts.name: Bomb Palanquin

sources.text: Kobold Vendor - 789th Order Dig (Outer La Noscea) - 120,000 Gil (Rank 4)

mounts.tooltip: Hack and slash and tossy-boom. Bang and boom and slashy-doom.♪   - Goblin Diddy

mounts.description: Summon forth Aithon, the legendary steed favored of the primal Ifrit. Its breath is said to be as hot as the seventh hell.
mounts.enhanced_description: Legend states that the Lord of the Inferno, Ifrit, forged this magicked steed from a nightmare offered by the Amalj'aa in sacrifice.
mounts.name: Aithon
mounts.tooltip: Nay is but a hoofbeat away from neigh!   - Uma Bugyo

mounts.description: Summon forth Xanthos, the legendary steed favored of the primal Garuda. At full gallop, it is said to be the very wind itself.
mounts.enhanced_description: Legend states that the Lady of the Vortex, Garuda, created this magicked steed from a nightmare offered by the Ixal in sacrifice.
mounts.name: Xanthos
mounts.tooltip: Nay is but a hoofbeat away from neigh!   - Uma Bugyo

mounts.description: Summon forth Gullfaxi, the legendary steed favored of the primal Titan. Its powerful legs set off tremors that can be felt from malms away.
mounts.enhanced_description: Legend states that the Lord of Crags, Titan, wrought this magicked steed from a nightmare offered by the kobolds in sacrifice.
mounts.name: Gullfaxi
mounts.tooltip: Nay is but a hoofbeat away from neigh!   - Uma Bugyo

mounts.description: Summon forth Enbarr, the legendary steed favored of the primal Leviathan. It is said to have been born of the surging waves.
mounts.enhanced_description: Legend states that the Lord of the Whorl, Leviathan, birthed this magicked steed from a nightmare offered by the Sahagin in sacrifice.
mounts.name: Enbarr
mounts.tooltip: Nay is but a hoofbeat away from neigh!   - Uma Bugyo

mounts.description: Summon forth your fearless warlion to rule over the battlefield, such is his station as king of the beasts.
mounts.enhanced_description: Early in the Sixth Astral Era, lions were brought over from the Near East and trained to serve as battle mounts for the Sultansworn of Ul'dah. Deemed unbreakable, those not sold to the Coliseum for venationes were released into the deserts of Thanalan where they eventually reverted back to a feral state.
mounts.name: Warlion
mounts.tooltip: I, too, see the friends I lost in the lions and spinners...   - Gregory

mounts.description: Summon forth your fearless warbear, veteran of a thousand battles, to fill your enemies with dread.
mounts.enhanced_description: In generations past, warriors seeking fame and glory would journey out into the untamed wilds of Abalathia's Spine in search of the giant grizzled bears that roamed the mountains, and would wrestle the beasts into submission, riding their prizes back to civilization. That is, or die trying.
mounts.name: Warbear
mounts.tooltip: How do you like my pets? Not too playful for you, I hope?   - Beast Trainer

mounts.description: Summon forth your draught chocobo, a massive bird large and strong enough to bear two riders.
mounts.enhanced_description: This heretofore unseen breed of chocobo was said to have been discovered by chocobo hunters searching for the legendary Chocobo Forest. Its enormous size would make it a fine pack chocobo, but its foul temper prevents it from completing even the simplest of tasks without the injury of some poor rider.
mounts.name: Draught Chocobo
mounts.tooltip: The thing was thrice my size and had already maimed several keeps.   - Battlewarden Ribald

mounts.description: Summon forth your deadly direwolf, one of five pups found huddling together in the snow near the corpse of their slain mother.
mounts.enhanced_description: Mass cullings of the beasts during the Sixth Astral Era prompted naturalists to deem the species extinct. However, this claim was proved false when Ixali scouts discovered a lone pack roaming the sparsely inhabited mountains of Xelphatol.
mounts.name: Direwolf
mounts.tooltip: I lost two good men to these wolves.   - Corentiaux the Colder

mounts.description: Summon forth your Maelstrom-issued warhorse and try to push from your mind the fact that your chocobo is sitting somewhere hungry and alone.
mounts.enhanced_description: After witnessing dazzling demonstrations of how a warsteed might turn the tide of battle, the Grand Companies of Eorzea emptied their coffers at the feet of the Far Eastern uma bugyo, each seeking to put themselves at an advantage during Frontline campaigns.
mounts.name: Storm Warsteed

sources.text: A Line in the Storm IV

mounts.tooltip: Hoof to neigh, Eorzea knows not the horse for one reason: the horsebird.   - Uma Bugyo

mounts.description: Summon forth your Order of the Twin Adder-issued warhorse and try to push from your mind the fact that your chocobo is sitting somewhere hungry and alone.
mounts.enhanced_description: After witnessing dazzling demonstrations of how a warsteed might turn the tide of battle, the Grand Companies of Eorzea emptied their coffers at the feet of the Far Eastern uma bugyo, each seeking to put themselves at an advantage during Frontline campaigns.
mounts.name: Serpent Warsteed

sources.text: A Line in the Glade IV

mounts.tooltip: Hoof to neigh, Eorzea knows not the horse for one reason: the horsebird.   - Uma Bugyo

mounts.description: Summon forth your Immortal Flames-issued warhorse and try to push from your mind the fact that your chocobo is sitting somewhere hungry and alone.
mounts.enhanced_description: After witnessing dazzling demonstrations of how a warsteed might turn the tide of battle, the Grand Companies of Eorzea emptied their coffers at the feet of the Far Eastern uma bugyo, each seeking to put themselves at an advantage during Frontline campaigns.
mounts.name: Flame Warsteed

sources.text: A Line in the Sand IV

mounts.tooltip: Hoof to neigh, Eorzea knows not the horse for one reason: the horsebird.   - Uma Bugyo

mounts.description: Summon forth Markab, the legendary steed favored of the primal Ramuh. It is said to have been born of a single thunderbolt.
mounts.enhanced_description: Legend states that the Lord of Levin, Ramuh, drew forth this magicked steed from a nightmare offered by the sylphs in sacrifice.
mounts.name: Markab
mounts.tooltip: Nay is but a hoofbeat away from neigh!   - Uma Bugyo

mounts.description: Summon forth your ceremony chocobo, large enough to bear both you and your special someone.
mounts.enhanced_description: Raised by Ishgard's master breeders for beauty and purity of stock, its snow white feathers are natural and, though fully developed, as soft as down. Temperament-wise, the bird is remarkably docile and one of few breeds who will allow dual riders upon its back.
mounts.name: Ceremony Chocobo
mounts.tooltip: Don't stand on ceremony, tick-tock, tick-tock!   - Helmhart

mounts.description: Summon forth Sleipnir─undying steed of the elder primal Odin. His coat is as dark as void, while his eyes glow a sanguine red.
mounts.enhanced_description: Blessed by the elder primal himself, Sleipnir will forever remain loyal to those who have proven themselves worthy. In addition to being fearless in battle, the dark steed is also able to manipulate his corporeal form to accommodate any rider, large or small.
mounts.name: Sleipnir
mounts.tooltip: If it hadn't been for that horse...    - Erik

mounts.description: Summon forth Boreas, the legendary steed favored of the primal Shiva. His breath is said to beget the winter's storms.
mounts.enhanced_description: Legend states that the Lady of Frost, Shiva, birthed this magicked steed from a unicorn offered by her followers in sacrifice.
mounts.name: Boreas
mounts.tooltip: Nay is but a hoofbeat away from neigh!   - Uma Bugyo

mounts.description: Summon forth your parade chocobo who, by the looks of him, has not marched in many parades.
mounts.enhanced_description: Originally purchased by the Adventurers' Guild for use in festival parades, this portly steed quickly wore out his welcome by devouring a moon's worth of fodder in a single turn of the sun. Unable to pay the price of upkeep, the guild passed the reins to someone more “commendable.”
mounts.name: Parade Chocobo
mounts.tooltip: I'll be at the parade with whomever else I can drag along.   - Botulf

mounts.description: Summon de forth your black de chocobo.
mounts.enhanced_description: A purebred Ishgardian black chocobo, trained from birth by House Fortemps knight, Ser Haurchefant, and presented to you in a gesture of true friendship. The bird is slightly more muscular than you expected and exhibits the strange habit of squatting when left to itself.
mounts.name: Black Chocobo
mounts.tooltip: Black chocobos are all well and good, but the true reward is the exoneration of your comrades.    - Haurchefant

mounts.description: Summon forth your adamantoise mount. He(?) is actually quite faster than he appears.
mounts.enhanced_description: Native to the Near Eastern island of Thavnair, adamantoises were long thought to be impossible to domesticate. However, through the efforts of both Ul'dahn naturalists and thaumaturges, a handful have been successfully trained not only to accept riders, but also wield ancient magicks which allow the colossal scalekin to fly.
mounts.name: Adamantoise
mounts.tooltip: M-Me? Perfectly fine! S-Solid as an adamantoise!   - Cocobezi

mounts.description: Summon forth Kirin, Far Eastern king of the beasts.
mounts.enhanced_description: Ask any man in Othard who rules the realm of beasts, and you will receive the same answer─Kirin. It is believed that the lionlike creature has walked the eastern lands for over a thousand years and will only answer the call of a hero it has deemed worthy.
mounts.name: Kirin
mounts.tooltip: Even folk in the Far East 'eard that tale, I reckon.   - Trachraet

mounts.description: Call into battle your Allagan logistics system. For your safety and the safety of those around you, all weaponry has been disabled.
mounts.enhanced_description: One of the automated system drones deployed by the Allagans to maintain and protect their strongholds. After being unearthed by the Sons of Saint Coinach, the mechanical sphere was modified by Nero tol Scaeva into a personal transportation device.
mounts.name: Logistics System
mounts.tooltip: Her report also mentions a violent encounter with a sentry heavily augmented by Allagan technology...   - Rammbroes

mounts.description: Summon forth a purebred Abalathian hoarhound named after its pack's legendary leader.
mounts.enhanced_description: Following the rise of Ishgard, hoarhounds all but disappeared from the Coerthas highlands. However, the shift in climate caused by the Calamity has seen the legendary beasts descend from their mountain dens once more.
mounts.name: Fenrir
mounts.tooltip: A good hound keeps his maw shut.    - Latata

mounts.description: Summon forth Midgardsormr, the slightly bigger one, but still not *the* big one.
mounts.enhanced_description: Only after proving your bravery in the face of countless perils has the Father of Dragons found you to be a worthy heir to the Light, and granted you a place upon his back.
mounts.name: Midgardsormr
mounts.tooltip: Correct me if I'm wrong, but if Midgardsormr had roared, wouldn't we have heard it?    - Moenbryda

mounts.description: Summon forth your amber draught chocobo, a rare breed large and strong enough to bear two riders.
mounts.enhanced_description: To Ishgardians, red represents true love and loyalty. To this wild chocobo from the Dravanian forelands, it meant capture at the hands of hunters who easily found a red chocobo sticking out like a sore thumb in the midst of all his yellow brethren.
mounts.name: Amber Draught Chocobo

sources.text: Calamity Salvager - 8 Gold Chocobo Feathers (Recruit a Friend Campaign)

mounts.tooltip: What about my forty acres and a chocobo?    - Imme

mounts.description: Summon forth your sanuwa, specially bred and trained for riding by Gundu merchant Luna Vanu.
mounts.enhanced_description: Countless turns of the sun did Luna Vanu train this wild sanuwa to obey the orders of man, and for many moons did he wait for one he deemed worthy of taking up this noble cloudkin's reins. Wait, he did, until you arrived.
mounts.name: Sanuwa

sources.text: Luna Vanu - Ok' Gundu Nakki (The Sea of Clouds) - 200,000 Gil (Rank 7)

mounts.tooltip: Wild sanuwa fierce as monsoon rains.    - Gunu Vanu

mounts.description: Summon forth your griffin─half eagle, half lion, all business.
mounts.enhanced_description: Fantastical winged beasts native to the unscalable peaks of Abalathia's Spine, griffins actually have a long history of serving as mounts. Indeed, before the city–state's fall, the Ala Mhigan army maintained a regiment of griffin–back soldiers who would harry opposing forces.
mounts.name: Griffin
mounts.tooltip: “Spread your wings and soar”    - Highwind Skyways Slogan

mounts.description: Call into battle your manacutter, a single-rider airship constructed at the Garlond Ironworks.
mounts.enhanced_description: Supervised (in spirit) by the ever-absent Cid, Biggs and Wedge (with a little bending over by Biggs) put their heads together to create this flight-ready miniature airship, powered by the realm's first corrupted crystal engine.
mounts.name: Manacutter
mounts.tooltip: There are more of these “manacutters” to be had, yes?    - Aymeric

mounts.description: Summon forth your war panther─a silent killer trained to maim anyone and everything...excepting you, of course.
mounts.enhanced_description: While more difficult to train than their cousins the coeurls, panthers bring their riders much more advantage on the field due to the beasts' inherent affinity to various magic. It is also believed that many dark knight battle techniques were conceived by watching panthers hunt.
mounts.name: War Panther

sources.text: But Somebody's Gotta Do It (Dark Knight)

mounts.tooltip: I have seen you move like a shadow.    - Daimbert

mounts.description: Call into battle your gobwalker, a steam-powered war vehicle designed by the infamous Illuminati.
mounts.enhanced_description: Originally designed to be a less-fickle replacement for pack raptors, the gobwalker was quickly reoutfitted into a tool of war after it took twenty goblins to chase down and topple a walker that had gone out of control and destroyed an entire workshop.
mounts.name: Gobwalker

sources.text: Alexander - The Burden of the Father (Savage)

mounts.tooltip: Ye would have more luck findin'...well, a gobmachine bangplate on a tree!    - Papana

mounts.description: Summon forth Twintania, an ancient wyvern who secretly dreams of freedom...and devouring you.
mounts.enhanced_description: Bound to eternal thralldom via an Allagan neurolink, this ancient wyvern from the southern continent of Meracydia will remain a loyal servant as long as you possess its identification key.
mounts.name: Twintania

sources.text: Calamity Salvager - 15 Gold Chocobo Feathers (Recruit a Friend Campaign)

mounts.tooltip: There are wyverns. Wyverns everywhere.    - Vath Drone

mounts.description: Summon forth your witch's broom. Here is to hoping it refrains from “flipping you over, flip flip” while flying.
mounts.enhanced_description: Once an ordinary household cleaning tool, relegated to such menial tasks as sweeping and...sweeping, this broom's life changed upon being enchanted by the ogre pumpkinhead. Now the skies are its dusty floors.
mounts.name: Witch's Broom
mounts.tooltip: Are you going to introduce yourself to that broom or not?    - Matoya

mounts.description: Summon forth a pegasus─winged white horse of legend.
mounts.enhanced_description: While rumors of a winged horse have graced ancient tomes for centuries, until recently, very little in the way of proof of their existence remained save the random feather or horseshoe housed in some remote monastery's reliquary.
mounts.name: Pegasus
mounts.tooltip: Sprout wings, I will!    - You

mounts.description: Call into battle the White Devil─Livia sas Junius's custom-made battle armor, now *your* custom-made battle armor.
mounts.enhanced_description: This masterpiece of imperial ingenuity is the selfsame suit of warmachina operated by XIVth Legion tribunus Livia sas Junius in the Garlean Empire's subjugation of Othard's southern reaches.
mounts.name: White Devil
mounts.tooltip: Ever the pessimist, my dear Livia.    - Nero tol Scaeva

mounts.description: Call into battle the Red Baron─Nero tol Scaeva's custom-made battle armor, now *your* custom-made battle armor.
mounts.enhanced_description: Constantly modified and improved by Nero himself, this warmachina of Garlean construct barely resembles the suit issued to tol Scaeva on the day of his promotion to tribunus.
mounts.name: Red Baron
mounts.tooltip: That mechanical monstrosity represented a feat of engineering far beyond aught Garlemald can presently achieve.    - Cid

mounts.description: Summon forth your wyvern, master of the skies and forever-loyal servant.
mounts.enhanced_description: Fifty score years ago, this wyvern made a pact with a knight to aid in vanquishing evil from the skies. Even now, long after the knight's passing, the wyvern has kept that promise, ever circling the heavens─ignoring the calls of his brethren to take up arms against mankind.
mounts.name: Wyvern
mounts.tooltip: A wyvern... I'd only ever heard stories about them.    - Saintrelmaux

mounts.description: Call into battle the SDS Fenrir, a lore-bending battlebike that looks as if it was driven straight from an age unknown.
mounts.enhanced_description: Manufactured for use by the now-defunct Strife Delivery Service, this two-wheeled monstrosity's ceruleum engine howls like the silver wolf of legend as it propels its rider across desert and plain.
mounts.name: SDS Fenrir
mounts.tooltip: Misfortune is no excuse for failing a delivery!    - Hildeyerd

mounts.description: Summon forth your kongamato, raised with care by the Vath stickpeddler.
mounts.enhanced_description: After hatching from an egg laid near the riverbanks, the kongamato larva spends its early life as a water-dwelling insect. Its maturity is signified by metamorphosis, during which its wings sprout forth and it takes to the skies.
mounts.name: Kongamato

sources.text: Vath Stickpeddler - Loth ast Vath (The Dravanian Forelands) - 200,000 Gil (Rank 7)

mounts.tooltip: Kongamato can be fickle─yes, very fickle─but they always return home to us.     - Vath Kintamer

mounts.description: Summon forth your zu. Its weighty wings have carried it from the Near East.
mounts.enhanced_description: This massive bird hunts by grasping its prey within its saw-like beak, and finishes it off with a few violent shakes of its long neck before swallowing the now-dead quarry whole.
mounts.name: Zu

sources.text: Spoils Collector - 1 Iron Voyage Spoil (Sea of Clouds Sector 24)

mounts.tooltip: Could you imagine how noisy it'd be with even more anzu flying around, kupo?     - Mogoon

mounts.description: Summon forth the mythical bennu. Very few have had the privilege of viewing this bird up close.
mounts.enhanced_description: This bird was reborn after drinking deep of the aether that flowed forth from the immortal Phoenix, who appeared in the skies of Carteneau during the Calamity. Named after a legendary bird, bennu means “a shining object, rising in brilliance.”
mounts.name: Bennu
mounts.tooltip: 'Twixt this world and the next do the aetherial currents swirl, bearing the very essence of life.     - Urianger

mounts.description: Summon forth the white lanner. Favored of the primal Bismarck, he soars the skies unchallenged.
mounts.enhanced_description: These birds are clad in roiling clouds, and noble Vanu Vanu warriors would sit astride them as part of Bismarck's retinue. The grace with which they glide through the skies evokes the image of a flower petal being carried by gentle western winds.
mounts.name: White Lanner
mounts.tooltip: From what we have observed, Bismarck is a creature of pure instinct, driven primarily by hunger.     - Cid

mounts.description: Summon forth the rose lanner. Favored of the primal Ravana, his wings pierce the night sky like a blade of moonlight.
mounts.enhanced_description: The ferocity of these birds is enough to give pause to the bravest warrior, and their keen talons cut through flesh as cleanly the Chandrahas themselves. Any who endeavor to mount the rose lanner must possess the savagery that defines the Wrath of the Colony.
mounts.name: Rose Lanner
mounts.tooltip: Master of the Sacred Blades! Wrath of the Colony! Conqueror of the World! Hear our prayer!     - Gnath Priest

mounts.description: Summon forth the round lanner. Favored of the primal King Thordan, he serves his master's knights dutifully.
mounts.enhanced_description: These birds are possessed of dignity equal to the noble personages whom they serve. Ancient Ishgardian knights often indulged themselves in falconry, and lanners were revered for their abilities, their lyncean eyes being well suited for sighting prey on the ground.
mounts.name: Round Lanner
mounts.tooltip: For the glory of King Thordan...     - Zephirin

mounts.description: Summon forth the warring lanner. Favored of the primal Sephirot, it carries the seeds of the World Tree.
mounts.enhanced_description: These birds are enveloped in an aura radiating a majesty that belies the savage nature of their master. According to the ancient legends of a treelike people native to Meracydia, the lanners bore the seeds of the World Tree across the seas, planting the verdant forests that dot the realm today.
mounts.name: Warring Lanner
mounts.tooltip: The trunk of the World Tree, or the Bole, offers protection to the weak, defending them from harm.     - Mace

mounts.description: Summon forth the Gloria-class airship. This single-occupancy airship is a singular feat of engineering.
mounts.enhanced_description: Taking inspiration from the half-remembered dream of his grandfather Tatanora, Tataramu used his encyclopedic knowledge to design a small-scale version of a rotary-winged airship. Its name derives from an airship that appears in an obscure novel of unknown origins.
mounts.name: Gloria-class Airship
mounts.tooltip: No, it must be one made to extremely exacting specifications.     - Tataramu

mounts.description: Summon forth the flying cumulus. It is unclear whether its previous owner was a boy with a tail or simply a monkey.
mounts.enhanced_description: There is but one man in all of Hydaelyn who can create such a mystical masterpiece, and it is said he resides upon a misty peak hidden within the mountain ranges of Doma. Crafted by stitching together dozens of smaller clouds, the cumulus allows a single rider to explore the skies...but only if she has an inherent affinity for magicks.
mounts.name: Flying Cumulus
