mounts.tooltip: I dunno about you, but I ain't so keen on the notion of callin' a bloody tomato *Yer Grace*.    - Tiny Trader

mounts.description: Summon forth your island Mandragora Queen, a well-cultivated vegetable fit for a king.
mounts.enhanced_description: The life of this island-grown princess was forever changed when she met her future husband the island Tomato King, whom the tides had borne to her. Overcoming their difference in origin, they wed and unified the island's vegetables under the banner of the West Mandra Empire.
mounts.name: Island Mandragora Queen
mounts.tooltip: I fear a diet comprised entirely of one type of root vegetable will not hold up to scrutiny...    - Hinageshi

mounts.description: Summon forth your lynx of eternal darkness, which could be what a certain eldest of all primals might look like as a large, winged feline.
mounts.enhanced_description: A phantom creation whose elemental aspect is tipped strongly towards the astral. Its shadowed wings call to mind the valiance of Zodiark, eldest and mightiest of primals, but the origins of this familiar are shrouded in eternal Darkness.
mounts.name: Lynx of Eternal Darkness
mounts.tooltip: Who are you, the Warrior of bleedin' Darkness!?    - Gallant Guardsman

mounts.description: Summon forth your lynx of divine light, which could be what a certain will of the star might look like as a large, winged feline.
mounts.enhanced_description: A phantom creation whose elemental aspect is tipped strongly towards the umbral. Its radiant wings call to mind the majesty of Hydaelyn, the will and protector of the star, but the origins of this familiar are shrouded in divine Light.
mounts.name: Lynx of Divine Light
mounts.tooltip: So bold, so majestic─ just like a Warrior of Light!    - Humphrey

mounts.description: Summon forth Argos, Venat's faithful familiar, to bear you places while you marvel at the softness of his golden coat.
mounts.enhanced_description: Created by Venat, this dog-like familiar lends his back only to those who have won his favor─which you already had by the time you first met him in Mare Lamentorum owing to the quirks of time travel.
mounts.name: Argos
mounts.tooltip: Gosh, he's a fast doggy!    - Nashu Mhakaracca

mounts.description: Summon forth your dreadnaught, a hulking machina that's equally at home on the battlefield as it is at construction sites.
mounts.enhanced_description: Originally used as a weapon, this Allagan machina was eventually superseded by newer models and repurposed for construction. Legends tell of a young man who took one such unit on a rampage, wreaking havoc through enemy ranks.
mounts.name: Dreadnaught
mounts.tooltip: What does it do?    - Inquisitive Young Man

mounts.description: Summon forth Demi-Phoinix. Because four wings are better than two and three heads better than one.
mounts.enhanced_description: This entity is a recreation of the being found imprisoned inside Pandæmonium. The original was the fruit of the ancients' research into immortal birds, but owing to its volatility, it was branded a failure.
mounts.name: Demi-Phoinix
mounts.tooltip: How do you spell that again?    - An Ancient

mounts.description: Summon forth Calydontis. He's wild but he's yours.
mounts.enhanced_description: Once a dreaded presence in its forest domain, this lord among wild boars met its match in a band of dauntless adventurers. Having thus learned to bow before the strong, it found a master in you.
mounts.name: Calydontis
mounts.tooltip: When I'm skilled enough to fell a wild boar on my own, I'll allow myself to indulge...    - Isarmoix

mounts.description: Summon forth Victor, a dog to rule over all dogs─at dog shows, that is.
mounts.enhanced_description: Lauded by no less a personage than Emperor Varis, Victor is a perennial champion at Garlean dog shows. Being bred and trained for competition, it isn't suited to combat, though it may at least intimidate foes with its fearsome mien.
mounts.name: Victor
mounts.tooltip: Hmph, all bark an' no bite!    - Rabid Wives Houndkeep

mounts.description: Summon forth your level checker, a mysterious machine that can determine your strength...and apparently also shrink and carry you inside it.
mounts.enhanced_description: When this mysterious machine first determined your strength, the result was “level 90.” By what method it came up with its figure, and whether it is even accurate, none can possibly say.
mounts.name: Level Checker

sources.text: Nesvaaz - Radz-at-Han - 12 Chi Bolts (FATE "Omicron Recall: Killing Order" - Ultima Thule)

mounts.tooltip: You've really taken it to another level with this!    - Kai-Shirr

mounts.description: Summon forth Papa Paissa. It's for a good cause.
mounts.enhanced_description: This exceptionally large paissa has sired no less than eight offspring, and in order to earn the coin to rear them, it chose to work as an adventurer's mount. By taking it into your service, you are supporting its adorable brood.
mounts.name: Papa Paissa
mounts.tooltip: I can only imagine the burden they bear with so many mouths to feed.    - Pip

mounts.description: Summon forth your wivre, a mighty horned beast said to be nature's battering ram.
mounts.enhanced_description: Native to the New World, these ill-mannered scalekin are notoriously difficult to tame. Yet where others have failed, the Mamool Ja have succeeded, their people employing wivres as beasts of burden and weapons of war both.
mounts.name: Wivre

sources.text: Edelina - Mor Dhona - 500 Bicolor Gemstone Vouchers

mounts.tooltip: I pray that you at least consider a watchful trot into danger rather than a headlong charge...    - Iliud

mounts.description: Summon forth your porxie king. Smells like bacon that's a cut above the rest─though that might just be an effect of the crown.
mounts.enhanced_description: Unlike its kin, this porxie was born without the ability to cure the tempered. Rather than have it go to waste, however, it was made into a mount and given a crown─perhaps to evoke a sense of luxury and comfort.
mounts.name: Porxie King
mounts.tooltip: This specimen can be considered royalty among them.    - Martineau

mounts.description: Summon forth your Garlond GL-II. For those who've got a nice place─who never wanted to be anybody else.
mounts.enhanced_description: This prototype magitek vehicle was developed by Garlond Ironworks to be a mode of transportation for a new era. A compact-but-powerful twin-bank ceruleum engine provides effortless acceleration which, coupled with the rugged chassis, allows it to devour rough terrain─such as that one might see on a desert island.
mounts.name: Garlond GL-II
mounts.tooltip: Latest technology! Revolutionary ideas!    - Razel Huizan the Stationary

mounts.description: Summon forth your mechanical lotus, a flower-shaped mode of transport with a spiritual aura.
mounts.enhanced_description: Fashioned by the enigmatic Onishishu, this mechanical conveyance assumes the form of the lotus flower, a symbol of purity and sanctity in the Far East. Indeed, it gives off a distinctly spiritual aura, though how it does so is a jealously guarded secret.
mounts.name: Mechanical Lotus
mounts.tooltip: Their purity is...astounding.    - Rammbroes

mounts.description: Summon forth Fylgja, a dragon with a soft spot for heroes and songs.
mounts.enhanced_description: Like her noble forebear Ratatoskr, Fylgja is passing fond of mankind, and traveled the world in search of mortals worthy of immortalizing in song. During the course of her journeys, she would encounter a soul who shone most brilliantly in battle. So moved was she by the hero's selfless valor, she chose to become her follower.
mounts.name: Fylgja
mounts.tooltip: Would you look at that─ my dulcet voice has drawn yet another devoted follower!    - Ulala

mounts.description: Summon forth your alkonost, an imposing antlered avian native to northern Ilsabard.
mounts.enhanced_description: Captured in the Bozjan wilderness, this creature was passed around as a curiosity before eventually being released again. From the start, it seemed unperturbed in the presence of men, leading some to believe it was trained by an imperial beastmaster.
mounts.name: Alkonost

sources.text: Nesvaaz - Radz-at-Han - 3 Resplendent Feathers (The Excitatron 6000 or The Shifting Gymnasion Agonon)

mounts.tooltip: How goes the training for your avian mount?    - Luquelot

mounts.description: Summon forth your island buffalo. Tough on the outside but tender on the inside.
mounts.enhanced_description: Belonging to a species introduced by pirates as livestock, this mild-mannered beast took to living on your island one day. Though it appears to have reverted to being feral, it is easily won over with food, in gratitude for which it happily bears you upon its back.
mounts.name: Island Buffalo
mounts.tooltip: It's one thing to see the buffaloes in a tizzy, but another to think they could have anything to do with the quakes.    - P'ebaloh

mounts.description: Summon forth your brachiosaur, a rare prehistoric creature sighted in frontier lands.
mounts.enhanced_description: Belonging to an ancient and enormous species, this juvenile creature was hatched from an egg found in the wilds by a hunter-scholar. As its body burgeoned, so too did its appetite for exploration, and it eventually found in you a worthy master to follow.
mounts.name: Brachiosaur

sources.text: Ryubool Ja - Tuliyollal - 3,200 Sacks of Nuts

mounts.tooltip: Due to unforeseen difficulties, House Haillenarte has been forced to suspend the expeditions to the Diadem.    - Aurvael

mounts.description: Summon forth your pod 602 mount. May leave you hanging, but will never let you go. Unless it malfunctions, or runs out of energy, or...you get the idea.
mounts.enhanced_description: Recovered from the ruins of the machine lifeforms, this diminutive white machina was created to provide YoRHa units with movement support. On account of this, it can easily transport one person...if not exactly in style or comfort.
mounts.name: Pod 602
mounts.tooltip: Those who are ready and willing to fight will never want for transportation!    - Grand Company Flyer

mounts.description: Summon forth the moon-hopper. Guaranteed to instill a sense of well-being within all those in earshot.
mounts.enhanced_description: This enhanced version of the supporter was lovingly created by the ever-innovative Inventingway. Not satisfied with merely making it ridable, the Loporrit also fitted a compact speaker that can belt out Dreamingway's feel-good sounds.
mounts.name: Moon-hopper

sources.text: Coiningway - Hoper's Hold (Mare Lamentorum) - 18 Loporrit Carats (Rank 7)

mounts.tooltip: Well, then, let's hop to it!    - Dreamingway

mounts.description: Summon forth your island alligator. Demands to be seen not later, but always.
mounts.enhanced_description: Hailing from unknown shores, this alligator appeared on your island one day and made itself at home. It takes pride in the fact that its kind is rare out at sea, and willingly carries a rider upon its back if only so it can parade itself in front of all and sundry.
mounts.name: Island Alligator
mounts.tooltip: A face you could kiss─if it weren't covered in scales, that is!    - Foerzagyl

mounts.description: Summon forth your hippo cart, a mean if not so lean transporting machine.
mounts.enhanced_description: Drawing upon the design of chocobo carriages, a collective of Arkasodara youths invented this two-wheeled hippo-drawn cart. The sunshade cloth incorporates techniques used in crafting Corvosi flying carpets, and grants cart and hippo both the ability to soar the skies.
mounts.name: Hippo Cart
mounts.tooltip: A hippo cart can outrun most anythin' in this jungle.    - Trna

mounts.description: Summon forth your troll mount, a gentle giant native to the northern seas.
mounts.enhanced_description: Contrary to their savage appearance, trolls are highly intelligent creatures. Sharlayan scholars once sought to teach them sign language, and on account of this specimen's friendly nature, it is believed that it was a subject in that experiment.
mounts.name: Troll
mounts.tooltip: If I didn't know better, I could've  sworn that troll was talking to you...    - Roegadyn Gleaner

mounts.description: Summon forth your UFO, and experience the sensation of an alien abduction.
mounts.enhanced_description: While appearing to be identical to PuPu's starship, this replica lacks certain functionalities such as a matter duplication facility, which, in light of recent events, is probably for the best. It is also unable to shrink you to a size to fit in the cockpit, meaning you do not so much ride as you are dangled around in its tractor beam.
mounts.name: UFO
mounts.tooltip: The *Truth* receives a large number of reports from readers claiming to have observed unidentified flying objects.    - Delion

mounts.description: Summon forth your vinegaroon mount, a carnivorous scalekin with a jaw reminiscent of claws.
mounts.enhanced_description: While it is common for dragons to use vinegaroons as servants, men have struggled to domesticate the creatures. In recent years, however, the gleaners have developed a successful training method, allowing them to be employed as beasts of burden.
mounts.name: Vinegaroon

sources.text: J'lakshai (Old Sharlayan) / Wilmetta (Radz-at-Han) - 3,200 Sacks Of Nuts

mounts.tooltip: Those vinegaroons are always chasing after us moogles, snapping their bladed jaws and swinging their bladed tails.    - Impatient Moogle

mounts.description: Summon forth your Orthos craklaw. May or may not have participated in famous battles which actually took place in history.
mounts.enhanced_description: Discovered in Eureka Orthos, this specimen of craklaw was imbued with magic in a bid to further harden its carapace. Though that experiment ended in failure, by way of a peculiar side effect, it has attained the power of flight.
mounts.name: Orthos Craklaw
mounts.tooltip: What you after? Fish? Crab?    - Eybor

mounts.description: Summon forth your bluefeather lynx mount, which could be what a certain feathered familiar might look like as a large, winged feline.
mounts.enhanced_description: A phantom creation composed of the esoteric power of dynamis. It is believed that the Endsinger brought forth this mysterious entity, but for what purpose is unclear. Could it be a tribute, perhaps, bestowed upon one who has overcome her aria of despair?
mounts.name: Bluefeather Lynx
mounts.tooltip: The light of hope shall ever guide our steps so long as we have the will to press onward.    - Edmont de Fortemps

mounts.description: Summon forth your megashiba mount─fluffy, living proof that massive can still be adorable.
mounts.enhanced_description: Sold as a “mameshiba,” a nonexistent miniature Far Eastern dog, this creature continued to grow until it was larger than a man. But despite its prodigious size, it has somehow retained its cuteness, which it combines with the practicality of being ridable.
mounts.name: Megashiba
mounts.tooltip: He's so fluffy!    - T'maritaa

mounts.description: Summon forth your traveling supporter. Proof that there is nothing a pair of bunny ears can't improve.
mounts.enhanced_description: This advanced bipedal machina was found wandering the Carteneau Flats by a quartermaster of the Eorzean Alliance. While it bears a striking resemblance to Allagan clockwork soldiers, it appears to have been enhanced by unknown hands (or paws).
mounts.name: Traveling Supporter
mounts.tooltip: The supporter? I never would have suspected... It's supposed to help us farm carrots, not eat them!    - Watchingway

mounts.description: Summon forth Miw Miisv, living proof that hope springs eternal─and in unexpected shapes.
mounts.enhanced_description: Born at Elysion from the hopes of the Ea, this peculiar dynamis life-form possesses a semi-transparent body reminiscent of a jellyfish, and can deliver a sting of sorts with the lightning it harbors. There is no greater pleasure for it than to connect with others in the microcosm of its heart. Literally.
mounts.name: Miw Miisv

sources.text: N-0598 - A-4 Research (Ultima Thule) - 18 Omicron Omnitokens (Rank 7)

mounts.tooltip: Just like jellyfish, they jump, jerk, and jolt to jiggle themselves up.    - Wawalago

mounts.description: Summon forth your wondrous lanner, a proud bird with a fondness for fantastical tales.
mounts.enhanced_description: Under the patronage of its mistress Rowena, this enchanted falcon has led a pampered life. Able to comprehend language, it loved nothing more than to listen to Khloe Aliapoh's tales, whose heroic protagonist it aspired to bear upon its back─in contest with another of Rowena's pets.
mounts.name: Wondrous Lanner
mounts.tooltip: I doubt even my falcons could keep pace with it.    - Yugiri

mounts.description: Summon forth your magicked umbrella to whisk you off your feet in the most delightful way.
mounts.enhanced_description: This flying umbrella was created by a certain elderly mage in her youth. It uses a black umbrella as the base, the better for blending into the night and sneaking into the Great Gubal Library from above. Its creator, it would seem, has always had a rebellious streak.
mounts.name: Magicked Umbrella
mounts.tooltip: You can stand under my umbrella.    - Kindly Maiden

mounts.description: Summon forth your magicked parasol, and have the whole world at your feet.
mounts.enhanced_description: This flying parasol was created by a certain elderly mage in her youth. Intending to sell them en masse to fund her research, she chose a pink parasol─popular in those days─as the base. Due to the need for considerable magical power and grip strength to use them, however, she experienced only modest success.
mounts.name: Magicked Parasol
mounts.tooltip: Perhaps you'll need a parasol the next time you visit!    - Sparkling-eyed Loporrit

mounts.description: Summon forth your Starlight steed, which, despite being an illusion, can bring very real joy to one and all.
mounts.enhanced_description: The reindeer Blitzen, visiting from Sharlayan, gifted you this ridable glamour as a show of gratitude for your kind aid. From the creature itself to the presents, all is recreated in such impressive detail that it could only be considered a Starlight miracle.
mounts.name: Starlight Steed
mounts.tooltip: It's a Starlight miracle!    - Nalipponcque

mounts.description: Summon forth your Sil'dihn throne. Once seating the rulers of Sil'dih, it now serves as your personal mode of transport.
mounts.enhanced_description: Discovered in a sector of the Sil'dihn Subterrane, this magnificent throne is believed to have been a spare. It moves in response to its master's will, but whether it does so via the spirits of Sil'dihns long dead or simple magicks is unknown.
mounts.name: Sil'dihn Throne
mounts.tooltip: H-How could you mistake me for that overstuffed throne-warmer!?    - Moghan

mounts.description: Summon forth your silkie mount. Because cleanliness is next to cuteness.
mounts.enhanced_description: Encountered in the depths of the Sil'dihn Subterrane, this arcane entity was the familiar of former sultana Nanasha Ul Nasha, who created it to keep the royal palace squeaky clean. Contrary to its appearance, the pom on the tail is the actual being rather than the mouselike creature.
mounts.name: Silkie
mounts.tooltip: I'm countin' on ye to clean up this mess.    - Bloeidin

mounts.description: Summon forth your sunforged. Its searing flames consume all─with the exception of its owner, thankfully.
mounts.enhanced_description: A product of the genius mind of Hephaistos, this fiery phantom creation combines two concepts─a flying snake and an immortal bird─and can shapeshift as the situation demands. Only the individual it recognizes as its master may ride it unscathed.
mounts.name: Sunforged
mounts.tooltip: It tastes like burning...    - Hapless Boy

mounts.description: Summon forth your lynx of imperious wind, which could be what a certain tempestuous archfiend might look like as a large, winged feline.
mounts.enhanced_description: A phantom creation whose elemental aspect is tipped strongly towards astral wind. Its blustery wings call to mind the caprice of Barbariccia, archfiend of wind, but the origins of this familiar are shrouded in unrelenting storms.
mounts.name: Lynx of Imperious Wind
mounts.tooltip: Motes against the tempest. In vain do they struggle...    - Sonu Vanu

mounts.description: Summon forth the aeturna, an imposing feline that boasts far more than the standard nine lives.
mounts.enhanced_description: During an expedition to Ilsabard in his younger years, Emperor Xande is said to have come upon this fearsome beast. As its name, meaning “eternal,” would suggest, it possesses remarkable vitality, and in addition to serving as an armored warbeast, it was also a subject in the Allagans' research into immortality.
mounts.name: Aeturna
mounts.tooltip: Eternal life can be yours, ladies and gentlemen!    - Silver-tongued Broker

mounts.description: Summon forth your set of ceruleum balloons. Propulsion not included.
mounts.enhanced_description: Filled with gasified ceruleum, this festive assortment of balloons boasts enough buoyancy to lift a full-grown Roegadyn off the ground. However, it possesses no means of propulsion, and one is required to provide one's own wind magicks to move.
mounts.name: Set of Ceruleum Balloons
mounts.tooltip: Squawk! Bring balloon directly over unbelievers' dung heap!    - Ixali Chieftain

mounts.description: Summon forth Anden III. It has a mouth, but it cannot scream.
mounts.enhanced_description: In gratitude for your kindness, the pixie Eo Tyr gifted you this peculiar ambulatory plant, which they created from the leaves of the original Anden after pruning him. While it resembles its namesake, it lacks the power of speech, and there is no telling what thoughts lie behind its permanently horrified expression.
mounts.name: Anden III
mounts.tooltip: Kind-hearted as we pixies are, we decided to turn him into a lovely leafman!    - Sheep-obsessed Pixie

mounts.description: Summon forth the *Blackjack*, or rather, its scale prototype. Exactly where inside it you ride is a mystery best left unanswered.
mounts.enhanced_description: Commissioned by Chairman Tatabaru of Highwind Skyways to develop a new airship, the engineers of Garlond Ironworks produced this scale prototype for testing purposes. Despite its diminutive size, it boasts an impressive loading capacity, and can easily carry you and a few friends.
mounts.name: Blackjack
mounts.tooltip: Good gods, it's the *Blackjack*!    - Tataramu

mounts.description: Summon forth fiery Phaethon, a legendary beast of Corvosi myth.
mounts.enhanced_description: According to Corvosi myth, simply being near this fiery steed is akin to bathing in hot coals, and it is only through the ingenuity of alchemy that one can ride it unscathed. A nigh-identical being, created to draw a carriage in the heavens, is said to have existed in the world unsundered, but it is uncertain what manner of connection, if any, exists between the two beasts.
mounts.name: Phaethon

sources.text: Nesvaaz - Radz-at-Han - 3 Burning Horns (The Shifting Gymnasion Agonon - Gold Chests)

mounts.tooltip: BURN! BURN! ALL IS BURN!    - Gogmagolem

mounts.description: Summon forth Pinky, an elephantine machine engineered to enrapture.
mounts.enhanced_description: Upon hearing that inebriated folk are wont to have visions of a delightful pink elephant, the Loporrits were inspired to make the creature a reality. The tale was, of course, simply a joke at their expense, but if this machine brings a smile to even one person, then their efforts will not have been in vain.
mounts.name: Pinky

sources.text: Nesvaaz - Radz-at-Han - 3 Bottles Of Exciting Tonic (The Excitatron 6000 - Gold Chests)

mounts.tooltip: This pink color is perfect!    - Auri Boy

mounts.description: Summon forth your lynx of righteous fire, which could be what a certain honor-bound archfiend might look like as a large, winged feline.
mounts.enhanced_description: A phantom creation whose elemental aspect is tipped strongly towards astral fire. Its fiery body calls to mind the ardor of Rubicante, archfiend of fire, but the origins of this familiar are shrouded in impenetrable flames.
mounts.name: Lynx of Righteous Fire
mounts.tooltip: It is time you were purified in the raging blaze of His blessing!    - Zagozz Teh

mounts.description: Call into battle your magitek avenger G1, an imperial warmachina made gaudier by goblin hands.
mounts.enhanced_description: Rumor holds that a golden sasquatch statue stands at the heart of the Garlean capital, from which magitek weapons would emerge to defend the city should it fall under attack. The veracity of the tale aside, the goblins liked it enough that they decided to create this golden avenger to match the statue.
mounts.name: Magitek Avenger G1
mounts.tooltip: I saw a golden opportunity just begging to be seized...    - Tataru

mounts.description: Summon forth Chrysomallos, the golden ram of legend─though legend doesn't seem to say anything about illusory coins spilling forth endlessly...
mounts.enhanced_description: Instead of the white commonly seen in its kind, the fleece of this sheep is a remarkable golden hue. While the seller insisted that it is the golden ram of legend, as with all such claims, this should be taken with a pinch of salt. Only time and perhaps a new growth of wool will reveal the creature's true nature.
mounts.name: Chrysomallos
mounts.tooltip: To think sheep can thrive in so remote a place as this...    - Cirina

mounts.description: Summon forth your Garlond GL-IS. Fitted with a sidecar to carry a trusty sidekick.
mounts.enhanced_description: A variant of the Garlond GL-I, this magitek vehicle is fitted with a sidecar to allow for two riders, with engine displacement increased to handle the additional weight. Comes with a life-size mascot lovingly crafted by Wedge─but strictly for a limited time only, and while stocks last!
mounts.name: Garlond GL-IS
mounts.tooltip: It's a Garlond through and through.    - Cid

mounts.description: Summon forth your megaloambystoma. Or should that be *max*olotl? You decide.
mounts.enhanced_description: The fact that this impossibly large ambystoma is fitted with an elaborate saddle strongly suggests it was created to be ridden. However, its presence in Pandæmonium means it was flawed in some way and deemed a failure.
mounts.name: Megaloambystoma
mounts.tooltip: It has been an age shhhince we have feashhhted on axolotl.    - Seww

mounts.description: Summon forth your Rising Phoenix, a symbol of rebirth and gratitude both.
mounts.enhanced_description: Created as a token of gratitude for the Warrior of Light, this majestic familiar assumes the likeness of the Phoenix, the immortal bird of legend. Upon death, the creature is said to rise again from its own ashes, on account of which it is revered as a symbol of rebirth.
mounts.name: Rising Phoenix
mounts.tooltip: The fires of Ifrit─nay─the Phoenix have taken up residence in my heart, where they will continue to burn forevermore!    - Jude

mounts.description: Summon forth your burabura chochin, a kindred spirit in wandering.
mounts.enhanced_description: Contrary to expectation, this lantern ghost did not care to haunt people, and was content to simply wander Mount Rokkon. When it saw you similarly wandering, it took you for a kindred spirit and decided to follow you wherever the wind should blow.
mounts.name: Burabura Chochin
mounts.tooltip: Could they be evil spirits, lying in wait for hapless treasure seekers?    - Zukin

mounts.description: Summon forth Shishioji, a prince who just can't wait to be king (again).
mounts.enhanced_description: When the mighty Shishio, legendary auspice and king of the nue, was defeated, it shed a fragment of its malevolent will, which took form as this being. Possessing a will of its own, it recognizes you as its superior, and consents to bearing you upon its back.
mounts.name: Shishioji
mounts.tooltip: Doubtless the lion's share of the credit lies with me.    - Nero tol Scaeva

mounts.description: Summon forth your shadow wolf, a nightmare creature that could only be dreamed up by the darkest of souls.
mounts.enhanced_description: A spawn of darkest shadow, this dread wolf is said to have been created by an evil king to do battle with a hero of eld. Though the truth of the tale cannot be verified, the creature's eyes betray not a hint of hatred towards the Warrior of Light, whom it serves with unfaltering obedience.
mounts.name: Shadow Wolf
mounts.tooltip: When brought into the light, the wolf can seem less fearsome.    - Pumpkin-headed Apparition

mounts.description: Summon forth your magicked children's bed, and enjoy the carefree sleep of a child wherever you go.
mounts.enhanced_description: Crafted especially for children, this magicked bed hovers by virtue of crystals sourced from floating isles, and gives the sensation of sleeping on a cloud. The design is said to be directly inspired by the beds used at Menphina's Arms.
mounts.name: Magicked Children's Bed
mounts.tooltip: Keep that up and I'll send you to bed without supper.    - Y'shtola

mounts.description: Summon forth your lynx of fallen shadow, which is what a certain knight in black might look like as a large, winged feline.
mounts.enhanced_description: A phantom creation whose elemental aspect is tipped strongly towards Darkness. The motes of Light it sheds call to mind the grim resolve of one who bears a great burden, but the origins of this familiar are shrouded in fallen shadow.
mounts.name: Lynx of Fallen Shadow
mounts.tooltip: I may deal from the shadows, but I dislike shadowy dealings.    - Remon

mounts.description: Summon forth Torgal, a trusty hound inspired by the trusty hound inspired by the memories of the actual trusty hound.
mounts.enhanced_description: According to the wandering minstrel, the beast who appeared to aid the stranded Clive was a guiding spirit born of its master's memory. So impressed was the ever-insightful musician by the creature, he decided to create this faithful facsimile in hopes that it might also serve as your loyal companion.
mounts.name: Torgal
mounts.tooltip: A more dependable comrade one would be hard-pressed to find.    - Alphinaud

mounts.description: Summon forth your Ark, a bipedal warmachina disguised as an airship─or an airship disguised as a bipedal warmachina, if you prefer.
mounts.enhanced_description: Seeking to develop an advanced transforming airship, the engineers of Garlond Ironworks turned to the expertise of a former Illuminati scientist. The result is a machina that can convert between bipedal and assault craft forms in the blink of an eye.
mounts.name: Ark
mounts.tooltip: It would seem there is more to you than meets the eye.    - Yugiri

mounts.description: Summon forth your apocryphal Bahamut, an embodiment of the fallen wyrm's burning desire to be free...and apparently carry you on a sofa.
mounts.enhanced_description: This draconic entity is brought forth by blowing into the horn you received from the wandering minstrel while holding in your heart Bahamut's song recorded by the Heimdall. Thus imbued with hopes and dreams, it desires nothing more than to soar the boundless skies and recognizes your free-spirited self as its master.
mounts.name: Apocryphal Bahamut
mounts.tooltip: Let me examine it, that I might ascertain its authenticity.    - Oboro

mounts.description: Summon forth your crescent moon mount. By all accounts more comfortable to perch upon than one shaped like a full moon.
mounts.enhanced_description: Designed in the likeness of a crescent moon, this magicked gondola was being kept in storage in Sharlayan, where it was classified as a gift. While its origin is undisclosed, the automaton that accompanies the contraption offers a telling clue.
mounts.name: Crescent Moon
mounts.tooltip: Gods, I can scarcely believe we went to the moon and back...    - Thancred

mounts.description: Summon forth your Rhiyes, a vibrantly hued mechanical rhinoceros that can't say no to terrorizing the Beans of Blunderville.
mounts.enhanced_description: Created to serve as an obstacle in Blunderville, this mechanical rhinoceros has employed its ample weight and power to thwart the progress of many a hapless Bean. Fortunately for you, however, this example was programmed to shuttle you around rather than send you flying.
mounts.name: Rhiyes
mounts.tooltip: There they go again, charging off before we have a chance to discuss our plan of action!    - Shigure

mounts.description: Summon your oppressor mount, a weapon of war-turned-conveyance of comfort.
mounts.enhanced_description: Originally an autonomous weapon developed by the Illuminati, this oppressor underwent a conversion to be able to carry a pilot. While the process necessitated the stripping of munitions, what the machina loses in destructive capabilities, it gains in luxury and comfort.
mounts.name: Oppressor
mounts.tooltip: What did you expect you were in for, a luxurious litter ride!?    - Sicard

mounts.description: Summon forth your lynx of abyssal grief, which could be what a certain dread voidsent born in the depths of the moon might look like as a large, winged feline.
mounts.enhanced_description: A phantom creation whose being brims with the Darkness that roiled in the depths of the Thirteenth's moon. The motes of Light it sheds calls to mind the yearning for home that drove the dread voidsent Zeromus, but the origins of this familiar are shrouded in abyssal grief.
mounts.name: Lynx of Abyssal Grief
mounts.tooltip: I just...I just want to go home...    - Drest

mounts.description: Summon forth your sabotender de la luna mount, a prodigious cactuar raised on a diet of rousing tales.
mounts.enhanced_description: Under the patronage of its mistress, Rowena, this cactuar has led a pampered life. With the merchant being too busy to personally tend to it, however, its care fell to Khloe Aliapoh, whose attentive hand and rousing tales allowed it to grow into a large specimen with a luminescent blossom.
mounts.name: Sabotender de la Luna
mounts.tooltip: The smell of the sea is sending needles up my nose!    - Presumptuous Postmoogle

mounts.description: Summon forth your spectral Statice, an avatar of the mischief-loving faerie from Aloalo Island.
mounts.enhanced_description: This mischief-loving faerie was originally companion to a scholar, but her aether refused to disperse in the wake of her master's death. After enduring a dull existence for long years, she found in you someone who could provide her with excitement, and thus did she weave an avatar of herself to join you on adventures.
mounts.name: Spectral Statice
mounts.tooltip: Most serious scholars consider it little more than a faerie tale.    - Phillice

mounts.description: Summon forth your Garlond GL-IIT, a magitek vehicle equipped with a tiller, and cultivate your isle in style.
mounts.enhanced_description: A variant of the popular Garlond GL-II, this trike has been engineered for cultivating the land. The ceruleum-powered rotary tiller makes short work of transforming rough terrain, while the cargo tray is ideal for transporting materials and passengers both.
mounts.name: Garlond GL-IIT
mounts.tooltip: This untamed isle is yours to cultivate as you see fit.    - Tataru

mounts.description: Summon forth Peatie, a goobbue maiden with a soft spot for peach blossoms.
mounts.enhanced_description: Hailing from a place where the peach trees bloom, this winsome goobbue maiden was found and taken in by the traveling entertainer Aldemund. After delighting the crowds on Little Ladies' Day, she made the decision to join you on your adventures in order to spread more cheer.
mounts.name: Peatie
mounts.tooltip: Place these peach blossoms in your hair, and become as princesses!    - Aldiytha

mounts.description: Summon forth Alsvid, a unicorn whose rainbow hair makes it the rarest of its kind─a veritable unicorn among unicorns.
mounts.enhanced_description: Legend holds that this unicorn, possessed of splendid rainbow hair, is destined to bear a soul who embodies the brilliance of the sun. In seeming confirmation of said legend, the creature spurns ordinary riders, and lends its back only to the Warrior of Light.
mounts.name: Alsvid
mounts.tooltip: Spying on you is as simple as sliding down the back of a rainbow.    - Feo Ul

mounts.description: Summon forth your quaqua, a familiar hailing from the south sea isles that has either a permanent snarl or grin, depending on one's outlook on life.
mounts.enhanced_description: Employed by a treasure hunter of Aloalo Island, this familiar was born of an early form of arcanima, an art which emerged in the south sea isles. The being's origin is attested by its predominantly wooden construction, a method which precedes the use of gemstones to create Carbuncles.
mounts.name: Quaqua
mounts.tooltip: Them younglin's will be grinnin' ear to ear when they see what you've got in store!    - Baenfaeld

mounts.description: Summon forth your island Peerifool. If anyone asks, it bears no relation whatsoever to a certain malicious rotting vegetable.
mounts.enhanced_description: Loaded aboard a trading vessel as part of its provisions, this mandragora decided to try her luck in the open sea rather than be added to soup. As luck would have it, the tides delivered her to a desert island, whose fertile soil and sunshine allowed her to attain enormous proportions.
mounts.name: Island Peerifool
mounts.tooltip: Honestly, I've never seen such foolishness!    - Namono Tayamono

mounts.description: Summon forth your island adenium. Literally a desert rose by another name, and doesn't have much of a scent to brag about.
mounts.enhanced_description: Sprouted and grown in the South Mandra Kingdom, this adenium lived what he thought was a happy life until he encountered the Peerifool. From the castaway vegetable, he learned about the great wide world beyond the island's bounds, and began to dream of embarking upon grand adventures.
mounts.name: Island Adenium
mounts.tooltip: I have oft heard it said that a blossom's beauty can move a man to love and long, but I never truly believed it until I met you two desert roses.    - Thancred

mounts.description: Summon forth your ty'aitya. Though its kind is ordinarily only capable of gliding, no one has apparently told this fellow, who can fly indefinitely.
mounts.enhanced_description: Its name meaning “little voices at play” in Xbr'aal, this herbivorous beastkin is capable of gliding impressive distances owing to the skin that stretches between its wrists and ankles. Fiercely territorial, it is known to attack even large predators using the bladelike cartilage protruding from the side of its hands.
mounts.name: Ty'aitya

sources.text: Edelina - Mor Dhona - 500 Turali Bicolor Gemstone Vouchers

mounts.tooltip: Have you ever seen a ty'aitya?    - Ty'at Roh

mounts.description: Summon forth your air-wheeler A9. The lights aren't merely for show and actually make it go.
mounts.enhanced_description: Designed and built in Alexandria, this single-rider flying vehicle uses electrope to convert lightning to wind energy, which it expels to produce levitation and propulsion. While air-wheelers are extensively employed by the military, the A9 is a civilian model and does not come fitted with armaments.
mounts.name: Air-wheeler A9
mounts.tooltip: I'm looking for an air-wheeler A9. Have you got any...er...smaller sizes?    - Milalla Customer

mounts.description: Summon forth your alpaca. Its foul spit is outweighed by its cuteness and utility. Mostly.
mounts.enhanced_description: Known as a Pelupelu merchant's best friend, the alpaca has long been raised as livestock in the mountainous regions of Tural. They are prized for their wool, a staple material in traditional textiles, as well as their sure-footedness, which sees them employed as both pack animals and cavalry mounts.
mounts.name: Alpaca
mounts.tooltip: You can take an alpaca to water, but you can't make it drink.    - Keshkwa

mounts.description: Manifest your wings of ruin. Rest assured they won't bring destruction wherever they go.
mounts.enhanced_description: Calling to mind Valigarmanda, the dread creature dubbed the Skyruin, these magicked wings grant their wearer an aura of irrepressible might. Though they are said to manifest only for those who are worthy, the truth of their nature is shrouded in mystery.
mounts.name: Wings of Ruin
mounts.tooltip: The tales these walls could tell of the Skyruin...    - Pameka

mounts.description: Manifest your wings of resolve. Their deep-blue hue exudes the burden of a lost man.
mounts.enhanced_description: Calling to mind Zoraal Ja, King of Resolve of Alexandria, these magicked wings grant their wearer an aura of undying pride. Though they were discovered near the throne on the summit of Everkeep, the truth of their nature is shrouded in mystery.
mounts.name: Wings of Resolve
mounts.tooltip: When the army fails in its duty, it is the charge of the King of Resolve to clean up its mess.    - Zoraal Ja

mounts.description: Summon forth your outrunner, a rotund machine built by the Alexandrians.
mounts.enhanced_description: A general-purpose machine, the outrunner can perform a wide variety of tasks, from the maintenance of facilities and devices to the elimination of dangerous creatures. Its design incorporates a monitor which displays comical expressions in lieu of a face, that it might be more approachable to the public.
mounts.name: Outrunner
mounts.tooltip: Outrunner guide unit identified.    - Mechanical Sentry

mounts.description: Summon forth your mehwapyarra. As dutiful as it is laid-back.
mounts.enhanced_description: This fully grown mehwapyarra (“capybara” in certain other parts) was wandering alone in Shaaloani when it was attacked and swallowed whole by the tural vidraal Ttokrrone. Fortunately for the creature, you appeared and put down its devourer before it could be digested, and it now lends you its back out of a sense of duty.
mounts.name: Mehwapyarra

sources.text: Uah'shepya - Solution Nine - 12 Ttokrrone Scales (FATE "The Serpentlord Seethes" - Shaaloani)

mounts.tooltip: The Fury take these ridiculous flying rodents!    - Estinien

mounts.description: Summon forth your monowheel S1, a bold vehicle fit for a champion of the Arcadion.
mounts.enhanced_description: A prize Ascension Arcadia bestows upon its champions, this unique one-wheeled vehicle employs an advanced stability system that allows it to traverse any and all terrain. Owing to its complex controls, however, it takes considerable practice to become a competent rider.
mounts.name: Monowheel S1
mounts.tooltip: Without further ado, let us set the wheels in motion!    - Lady Luck

mounts.description: Summon forth your rroneek. As your trusty steed, this creature can look forward to living to a ripe old age.
mounts.enhanced_description: Found grazing the plains of Xak Tural, this stoutly built beastkin has been prized since ancient times on account of fairly every part of it being a useful resource. Owing to its importance in their lives, many nomadic tribes revere it as their guiding animal, and migrate alongside it with the seasons.
mounts.name: Rroneek

sources.text: Splendors Vendor - Solution Nine - 100 Mount Tokens (100,000 Orange Gatherer's Scrips)

mounts.tooltip: Well, you two look happier than a pair of rroneek in the sun.    - Zemoweni

mounts.description: Summon forth Ullr, a dragon on the hunt for a musical collaboration.
mounts.enhanced_description: Belonging to Ratatoskr's brood, this dragon was searching for a mortal with whom it could weave songs when it chanced to see you in the middle of a hunt. So impressed was it by your prowess, it chose to accompany you on your travels in hopes of witnessing more heroic feats.
mounts.name: Ullr
mounts.tooltip: Like our esteemed ancestor, I will fill the skies with beauteous songs!    - Ehll Tou

mounts.description: Summon forth your qeziigural, a winged golem whose name means “gold that flies” in the Mamool Ja tongue.
mounts.enhanced_description: Encountered in Cenote Ja Ja Gural, this winged stone construct is outfitted with golden adornments whose engravings bespeak Mamool Ja origins. As its bare body appears to hail from an earlier time, however, it is believed to be a Yok Huy relic that was repurposed and decorated.
mounts.name: Qeziigural

sources.text: Uah'shepya - Solution Nine - 3 Twilight Gemstones (Cenote Ja Ja Gural or Vault Oneiron)

mounts.tooltip: Don't indulge them with anything but a face of stony indifference.    - Papa Gruff

mounts.description: Summon forth your automatoise, a weapon of war developed in Origenics.
mounts.enhanced_description: A weapon of war developed in Origenics, this giant tortoise has been augmented with a reinforced electrope skeleton and servomotors in order to enhance defense and strength. As the underlying creature is ordinarily mild-mannered, it is infused with the soul of a savage predator to lend it ferocity at the onset of battle.
mounts.name: Automatoise

sources.text: Ryubool Ja - Tuliyollal - 3,200 Sacks of Nuts

mounts.tooltip: That strikes me as a rather curious thing to be researching, but to each their own, I suppose!    - Knowledgeable Loporrit

mounts.description: Summon forth your mountain zu, and make ready to quench your thirst for adventure.
mounts.enhanced_description: This subspecies of the monstrous zu is known to inhabit the mountainous regions of the Near East. Seeking to tame the ill-tempered bird, Hannish alchemists fed it a specially concocted brew, which had the desired effect while causing the creature to give off a refreshing citrus aroma.
mounts.name: Mountain Zu
mounts.tooltip: I can't remember the last time I felt so refreshed!    - Tataru

mounts.description: Summon forth your barreltender, a sabotender possessed of a hulking frame that has earned it its name.
mounts.enhanced_description: Native to the arid wilds of Xak Tural, this abnormally well-built sabotender resolved to further hone its flesh after meeting its match in an adventurer. As part of a rigorous training regime, it willingly and tirelessly carries you hither and yon.
mounts.name: Barreltender

sources.text: Splendors Vendor - Solution Nine - 100 Mount Tokens (100,000 Orange Gatherer's Scrips)

mounts.tooltip: Hells, he's every bit as muscular and majestic as I remembered!    - Humphrey

mounts.description: Summon forth your eggeater, an anteater raised on a luxurious diet of eggs.
mounts.enhanced_description: Under the patronage of its mistress, Rowena, this widowmaker has led a pampered life. As it was impractical to feed it the prodigious quantities of ants its kind consumes in the wild, however, it was instead raised on a diet of beaten eggs. This specimen is well accustomed to men, and permits those it trusts to ride upon its back.
mounts.name: Eggeater
mounts.tooltip: We can ill afford to place all our eggs in one basket.    - Erenville

mounts.description: Summon forth your punutiy, and delight onlookers to no end with its winsome charm.
mounts.enhanced_description: Inhabiting the waters of Yok Tural, these gentle giants have been employed by men since olden days to tow boats on the continent's rivers and lakes. This specimen is particularly inquisitive, and having been imbued with the ability to fly, it has further developed a taste for travel.
mounts.name: Punutiy
mounts.tooltip: If the punutiys are happy, then I'm happy too.    - Yubli

mounts.description: Summon forth your Alexandrian axe beak, a reptilian bird favored of the merchant Rowena. Not to be confused with the beast native to Thanalan.
mounts.enhanced_description: Under the patronage of its mistress Rowena, this reptilian bird has led a pampered life. However, when a customer requested a specimen of the beast of the same name native to Thanalan, it was mistakenly transported all the way from Tural. The error did not come to light until it was too late, and the creature ended up in your care.
mounts.name: Alexandrian Axe Beak
mounts.tooltip: How do you hope to survive with even more beaks to feed?    - Sanu Vanu

mounts.description: Summon forth your shroud of Darkness, a lingering sliver of the Cloud of Darkness's eldritch raiment.
mounts.enhanced_description: A sliver of the eldritch raiment worn by the Cloud of Darkness. Appearing to be perpetuated by residual aether, it shows no sign of dissipating and allows its wearer to fly freely. Though soft to the touch like the finest wool, the fog that clings to it results in a persistent clamminess.
mounts.name: Shroud of Darkness

sources.text: Uah'shepya - Solution Nine - 99 Clouddark Demimateria I

mounts.tooltip: Darkness shall consume Light!    - Igeyorhm

mounts.description: Summon forth your dais of Darkness. Will not vanish beneath your feet after a set duration.
mounts.enhanced_description: A piece of the battlefield created by the Cloud of Darkness, upon which only those recognized by the being may set foot. While it has sent countless foes plummeting into endless void, by triumphing over its maker, you appear to have gained control over it.
mounts.name: Dais of Darkness

sources.text: Uah'shepya - Solution Nine - 75 Clouddark Demimateria II

mounts.tooltip: A well-maintained airship can mean the difference between life and a horrible, plummetin' death.    - Redbill Engineer

mounts.description: Summon forth your hovering hot pot. Formerly a ritual cauldron, it now soars the skies while simmering with scrumptious morsels.
mounts.enhanced_description: Long ago, when a ritual cauldron was accidentally used to cook dinner for the lord of Yanxia, a strange phenomenon occurred which saw the vessel rise into the air like the fiery wheels of divine legend. Thereafter, subsequent generations of rulers took to filling the cauldron with various delicacies, which they enjoyed even as they hovered in the heavens.
mounts.name: Hovering Hot Pot
mounts.tooltip: What is this? It smells...spicy.    - Erenville

mounts.description: Manifest your wings of eternity. Their luminous green hue exudes the determination of a recreated queen.
mounts.enhanced_description: Found within the virtual domain created by the Meso Terminal, these armor-clad wings are reminiscent of the dread entity that Sphene had become. While their origin is shrouded in mystery, they exude the unwavering determination of a ruler who placed her subjects above all else.
mounts.name: Wings of Eternity
mounts.tooltip: My desire to protect my people transcends all others!    - Sphene

mounts.description: Summon forth your vacuum suit, and live the dream of piloting a futuristic bipedal machina.
mounts.enhanced_description: Created for the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, this construction machina was developed as a collaboration between Loporrit, Sharlayan, and Garlean engineers. As a result, it exhibits magitek armor influences in its design, particularly in the area of its piloting system.
mounts.name: Vacuum Suit
mounts.tooltip: If I am not mistaken, this would not be the first time you've piloted one of these suits.    - G'nibnpha

mounts.description: Summon forth your venturous kamuy, blessed wolf who shall not be bound by such corporeal laws as gravity or aerodynamics.
mounts.enhanced_description: During a journey to the Far East, the merchant Rowena came upon and took in this wolf which, having received a divine blessing, is able to lope freely through the sky. In the part of the world whence it hails, a practice exists wherein dogs are sent to pay homage at distant shrines in their masters' stead.
mounts.name: Venturous Kamuy
mounts.tooltip: Oho, how enterprising!    - Hasdahd

mounts.description: Summon forth your cosmic countenance, a Loporrit-designed defense system that serves with a smile─albeit an unsettling one.
mounts.enhanced_description: Originally created to protect Smileton, this machina has the appearance of a face that smiles at residents and grimaces at trespassers. When the construction of the settlement was suspended with the forestalling of the Final Days, this unit was repurposed for general support duties.
mounts.name: Cosmic Countenance
mounts.tooltip: Let's get out there and serve up some smiles, eh?    - Jammingway

mounts.description: Summon forth your demon haul, a dreaded guardian-turned-mode of transport.
mounts.enhanced_description: This formerly inanimate block of stone was brought to ghastly life by way of arcane patterns engraved in blood. Though created in bygone times to repel trespassers as a guardian, the removal of its core has rendered it harmless while additionally allowing it to serve as a mode of transport.
mounts.name: Demon Haul

sources.text: A Fork to Be Reckoned With I

mounts.tooltip: How many times now have you and yours hauled us back from the brink?    - Merlwyb

mounts.description: Summon forth your petalodus, an ambulatory shark that thinks of you as a friend, not food.
mounts.enhanced_description: Though ancient Nymian legend speaks of mythical sharks possessed of arms and legs, it is unknown whether they bear any connection to the bipedal petalodus. Though its kind are ferocious by nature, for reasons unknown, this particular specimen treats you as an old friend...and here we are.
mounts.name: Petalodus
mounts.tooltip: Shark! Shark! Run for your lives!    - Faire-goer

mounts.description: Summon forth your snowstreamer. Guaranteed not to inconveniently melt while you are inside.
mounts.enhanced_description: Hollow on the inside and sustained by the power of eternal ice, this snowman garbed in fetching purple promises to keep its rider cool even in the hottest of climes. Rumor holds it is the perfect companion for those who wish to share their adventures with others, as well as those who wish to cheer others along on theirs.
mounts.name: Snowstreamer
mounts.tooltip: There's something strange about these snowmen, yes, but...I can't quite put my finger on it.    - Isainne

mounts.description: Summon forth the pilgrim's protector, a wandering worshiper's best friend.
mounts.enhanced_description: A white-furred beast native to lands formerly belonging to the Kingdom of Voeburt. They can be domesticated if raised from birth, and were known to escort adherents of the Church of the First Light on pilgrimages. Due to its exceptional docility, this specimen is believed to be descended from such trained creatures.
mounts.name: Pilgrim's Protector

sources.text: Pilgrim's Traverse - Sack of First Light

mounts.tooltip: There is much I could learn from your pilgrimage.    - Hien

mounts.description: Summon forth your branchbearer. If it looks like a bird, flies like a bird, and cries like a bird, then it...could be a predatorial seedkin disguised as a bird.
mounts.enhanced_description: The branchbearer is employed as a companion plant in Gok Golma, where it protects crops by deterring pests with its aetheric emissions. In the past, the species was so aggressive that it was known to actively hunt animals for sustenance, but the Doppro people have succeeded in their domestication.
mounts.name: Branchbearer

sources.text: Veerul Ja - Gok Golma (Yak T'el) - 18 Mamool Ja Nanook (Rank 4)

mounts.tooltip: Truly, a more effective deterrent I could not imagine.    - Alphinaud

mounts.description: Summon forth your air-wheeler C9, and turn heads all over Solution Nine.
mounts.enhanced_description: The C9 is the latest flying passenger vehicle to be developed in Alexandria. Propelled by six electrope thrusters that serve as wheels when driven on the ground, it performs equally well on land as it does in the air, and is the object of desire for the youths of Solution Nine.
mounts.name: Air-wheeler C9
mounts.tooltip: It's almost scary what you can do with electrope...    - Wuk Lamat

mounts.description: Summon your ancient airship, a magic-propelled vessel capable of bearing you and three companions.
mounts.enhanced_description: Discovered on the Occult Crescent, this ancient airship is powered not by ceruleum like modern vessels, but rather relies on magic to manipulate wind-aspected aether and generate propulsion. As this magic must be provided by passengers, it is recommended to ride in a group in order to avoid exhaustion.
mounts.name: Ancient Airship
mounts.tooltip: Go as a gale wind to the wrecked airship.    - Sonu Vanu

mounts.description: Summon forth your high mobility vacuum suit, and live the dream of piloting a futuristic bipedal machina.
mounts.enhanced_description: Those who have made exceptional contributions to the Cosmic Exploration Initiative are presented with this special vacuum suit, whose chassis and drivetrain have been tuned to increase power output. While proportionately more difficult to maneuver as a result, it is highly regarded among veteran pilots.
mounts.name: High Mobility Vacuum Suit
mounts.tooltip: Hop into the pilot's seat! We'll begin as soon as you're ready!    - Wedge

mounts.description: Call into action your warp loader, and bulldoze your way through life.
mounts.enhanced_description: Created for the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, this six-wheeled construction machina can traverse the roughest terrain with ease, and boasts ample power for clearing away obstacles with its front-facing blade. It is highly regarded among the Loporrits for its combination of utility and mobility.
mounts.name: Warp Loader
mounts.tooltip: You've certainly proven you are not one to let obstacles stand in your path.    - Grynewyda

mounts.description: Summon forth His Royal Headness on Parade, that all may bask in the splendor of a well-formed noggin.
mounts.enhanced_description: This uncanny mascot of a forgotten amusement park has no tolerance for unsightly heads, and will stop at nothing to separate those that fail to satisfy him from their bodies. The only way to escape his scrutiny is to ride him, thereby becoming one with his flawless noggin.
mounts.name: His Royal Headness on Parade
mounts.tooltip: I shall not rest until my every subject bears a beauteous noggin!    - His Royal Headness Leonogg I

mounts.description: Manifest your wings of the knighthood. Their vibrant red hue exudes the passion of a dutiful knight.
mounts.enhanced_description: Found within the ruins of Alexandria Castle, these armor-clad wings are reminiscent of the formidable machine imbued with the memories of Zelenia, former second-in-command of the royal knights of Alexandria. While their origin is shrouded in mystery, they exude the passion of a knight who lived to serve her queen.
mounts.name: Wings of the Knighthood
mounts.tooltip: She was the soul of conviction─ and so are we!    - Kenwrec

mounts.description: Call into battle your magitek slasher. Has been stripped of its blades and is therefore safe to ride.
mounts.enhanced_description: An autonomous imperial warmachina designed in the likeness of a vilekin; the razor-sharp blades fitted onto their forelimbs are said to haunt the dreams of many an enemy soldier. This particular unit was seized by the Eorzean Alliance, and subsequently disarmed for use in transportation.
mounts.name: Magitek Slasher
mounts.tooltip: My expertise is more in hacking and slashing.    - Giott

mounts.description: Summon forth Vurgar the Loyal, and give your enemies twenty seconds to comply.
mounts.enhanced_description: In ages past, the Yok Huy employed golems such as this as weapons of war, but following Tuliyollal's founding, they refrained from creating new ones out of their newfound aversion to conflict. In the Yok Huy tongue, the name Vurgar simply means “one who possesses a body of stone.”
mounts.name: Vurgar the Loyal
mounts.tooltip: If you want the golem restored, you may leave it to my husband!    - Dulia-Chai

mounts.description: Summon forth your wanyudo, and hold on for dear life as the nightmare rolls on.
mounts.enhanced_description: Appearing as an oxcart wheel adorned with a demonic face, this automaton originating from the Far East is created in the likeness of mythical apparitions that steal the souls of any who look upon them. While originally intended to repel intruders, it can also serve as a mode of transport for those with sufficient endurance.
mounts.name: Wanyudo
mounts.tooltip: Creaky wheels get the grease around here!    - Nitowikwe

mounts.description: Summon forth your forgiven mimicry. Not actually a sin eater, so it can be ridden without fear of turning those around you into one.
mounts.enhanced_description: Found prowling Pilgrim's Traverse, this motley creature appeared to be a sin eater at first glance, but is in fact a variety of ambulating plant. It is believed that it learned to assume its present form in order to survive in the Light-flooded First.
mounts.name: Forgiven Mimicry

sources.text: Pilgrim's Traverse - Sack of First Light

mounts.tooltip: I don't think anyone can truly mimic your unique strengths.    - Jessie

mounts.description: Summon forth your Ambulario, and ride in the delightfully fiendish spirit of All Saints' Wake.
mounts.enhanced_description: Designed in the fiendish likeness of the Impresario, the leader of the Continental Circus, this automaton incorporates an enchantment which allows it to weave festive glamours. Its head also produces a satisfyingly sonorous bonk when struck, for a more mundane sort of amusement.
mounts.name: Ambulario
mounts.tooltip: Hello there, pumpkin! Enjoying the festivities, I hope?    - Continental Circus Publicist

mounts.description: Summon forth your shagcoat cat, a gigantic-yet-gentle feline with a penchant for sporting a blue bow tie.
mounts.enhanced_description: Native to Tural, this enormous breed of cat is regarded as a gentle giant on account of its intelligence and mild temperament. While those who have gained its trust are permitted upon its back, would-be riders should be prepared to get fur everywhere when it sheds its shaggy coat during the warmer seasons.
mounts.name: Shagcoat Cat
mounts.tooltip: Let us spread a love for all things feline far and wide across the land!    - Neko Bugyo

mounts.description: Summon forth your Seikret, the steed of choice for serious hunters.
mounts.enhanced_description: A beast of burden known for its strength and swiftness. Additionally possessed of a superior sense of smell, they are able to track prey over great distances, making them an indispensable hunting companion whence they hail.
mounts.name: Seikret
mounts.tooltip: So what's the adventure? Monster hunting?    - Yozan

mounts.description: Summon forth your Felyne support team cart, safe in the knowledge that there is no reward penalty for riding it.
mounts.enhanced_description: Featuring a time-tested construction, this cart is purpose-built to bear distressed hunters to safety. No matter how dangerous the destination, the Felynes will never fail to sally forth to the rescue, but it appears some hunters would not be caught dead being carted away.
mounts.name: Felyne Support Team Cart
mounts.tooltip: That was meow-gnificent!    - Felyne

mounts.description: Summon forth your yan, a sheep spirit whose disarmingly adorable appearance belies its tremendous might.
mounts.enhanced_description: Hailing from the Ninth, this unusually proportioned sheep is held to be a benevolent spirit that bestows blessings in exchange for an offering of diamonds. This entity in particular is especially genial and generous, and gladly employs its powers in service to your transportation.
mounts.name: Yan
mounts.tooltip: I believe diamonds would be best for that.    - Crystal Merchant

mounts.description: Summon forth your interstellar dhalmel, and ride it boldly where no dhalmel has gone before.
mounts.enhanced_description: This dhalmel was a subject in adaptability testing for life-forms native to Etheirys. As their kind is found in multifarious lands, from arid wastes to floating isles, they are believed to be highly adaptable, and it is hoped that they will also thrive in interstellar environments.
mounts.name: Interstellar Dhalmel
mounts.tooltip: If some ill misfortune befalls you─ say, you're trampled by the dhalmels─ know that your remains will not go to waste.    - Atelloune

mounts.description: Deploy your cosmoboard, and shred up the cosmos (figuratively) wherever you go.
mounts.enhanced_description: Originally used to convey workers around Sinus Ardorum as part of the Cosmoliner network, this hovering board has undergone modification to incorporate a crystal power source. The result is a personal mode of transportation that is unbound to set routes, and looks radical besides.
mounts.name: Cosmoboard
mounts.tooltip: How in the world do they make it hover like that?    - Anxious Girl

mounts.description: Summon forth your chandelier of First Light, and live like tomorrow doesn't exist. Like it doesn't exist.
mounts.enhanced_description: A furnishing at the Church of the First Light, this chandelier was imbued with levitation magicks to prevent it from falling and causing injury. In a development the church could not have foreseen, it has since been enhanced by fae enchantments and made able to soar the skies while bearing a rider.
mounts.name: Chandelier of First Light
mounts.tooltip: My, how fancy. Though I suppose this is a rather fancy place, isn't it.    - Moogle Suitor

mounts.description: Manifest your wings of death. Their somber hue exudes a sense of impending doom.
mounts.enhanced_description: Found within the Meso Terminal, these somber wings are reminiscent of Necron, the dark primal brought forth by the fear of death that had gripped Alexandrians. While their origin is shrouded in mystery, only one who stands unyielding beneath the weight of impending doom can hope to bear them.
mounts.name: Wings of Death
mounts.tooltip: You are bound by the limits of flesh. It will betray you.    - Calyx

mounts.description: Summon forth your ornamental shrublet. Seeks either revenge or proliferation or both on its way to a new land.
mounts.enhanced_description: This ambulating plant appears to be an offshoot of the ornamental shrubs you encountered along Pilgrim's Traverse. Though it is unclear whether it desires revenge for its fallen parents or simply wishes to sow its seeds in faraway lands, it has seemingly decided to follow you.
mounts.name: Ornamental Shrublet
mounts.tooltip: Only the most fearsome bits of shrubbery get given elite mark status.    - Aytienne

mounts.description: Summon forth your dynamite, a soulkin favored of the merchant Rowena. House-trained and should therefore not explode in a fiery conflagration.
mounts.enhanced_description: A variety of fiend that is brought to life when an inanimate rock is imbued with aether. Due to the possibility that it harbors precious stones, this specimen was acquired by Rowena and entrusted to the care of Khloe Aliapoh. As a result, it has become so familiar with people that it is willing to carry a rider.
mounts.name: Dynamite
mounts.tooltip: Oh, d-dear... A swarm of dynamite has drifted inside the burrow!    - Warringway

mounts.description: Summon forth your genie of the lamp. Not the actual being of legend so cannot grant wishes─unless your wish is to be carried somewhere.
mounts.enhanced_description: In the region of Corvos, there exists a legend of a lamp-dwelling spirit that grants wishes to its master. As this particular entity is an imitation later brought forth by a sorcerer, it is far from the omnipotent being described in tales, but in accordance with its creator's design, it will dutifully carry you wherever you wish to go.
mounts.name: Genie of the Lamp
mounts.tooltip: What child wouldn't have wanted a friend like that?    - Beruru

mounts.description: Call into battle your Lowrider T1RANT, and rule the roads with an iron fist (around the custom leather-bound steering wheel).
mounts.enhanced_description: This vintage vehicle manufactured in Lindblum once belonged to the president of the Arcadion, who had inherited it from his forebears. It was comprehensively modified with cutting-edge technology for the Tyrant's use, and boasts enhanced flight capabilities as well as the latest comforts, the better to lord it over the peasants.
mounts.name: Lowrider T1RANT
mounts.tooltip: Not bad for an antique...    - Vitus quo Messalla

mounts.description: Summon forth your uolon, a great big beast that tends the forest with a great big grin.
mounts.enhanced_description: This enormous beastkin native to the temperate forests of eastern Yok Tural is believed to be closely related to trolls and yetis. Possessed of exceptional intelligence, it has been observed accelerating plant growth by way of peculiar dances and aetheric emissions, a behavior that has earned it the attention of scholars.
mounts.name: Uolon
mounts.tooltip: I'd have to recommend an uolon bristle hairbrush.    - Vapli

mounts.description: Summon forth your volatile gravity vacuum suit, and live the dream of piloting a futuristic bipedal machina.
mounts.enhanced_description: Created for the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, this construction machina was developed to handle the gravitational anomalies that rack Oizys. On account of its considerable bulk, along with its somewhat unwieldy model name, many initiative members have taken to fondly referring to it by the epithet “Big Boy.”
mounts.name: Volatile Gravity Vacuum Suit
mounts.tooltip: I'm the pilot, not you!    - Rex

mounts.description: Call into battle your cosmic armored weapon, a deadly imperial warmachina-turned-handy (leggy?) exploration vehicle.
mounts.enhanced_description: This imperial warmachina has been adapted for use in the Cosmic Exploration Initiative. Its low stance and arachnoid legs combine to provide exceptional stability, allowing it to perform tasks with aplomb on Oizys, a planet where gravitational anomalies are a regularity.
mounts.name: Cosmic Armored Weapon
mounts.tooltip: Be sure you're properly armed and armored before beginning your task.    - Nahctahr

mounts.description: Summon forth your inflatable mograft, a flotation device designed with both relaxation and safety in mind.
mounts.enhanced_description: Created for the Moonfire Faire, the inflatable mograft was originally a simple device for lounging on the water. When an incident occurred which saw riders swept out to sea, however, it was decided that the units would be fitted with wind crystals, that festival-goers may fly to safety in the event of an emergency.
mounts.name: Inflatable Mograft
mounts.tooltip: All kinds of things come floating in on the waves.    - Zukin

mounts.description: スターライトスレイに騎乗する。 星芒祭で作られた大型のソリ。トナカイ付き
mounts.enhanced_description: 星芒祭のため、グリダニアの有志が協力して作り上げた大型ソリ。飾り付けをはじめ、細部に子どもたちの一生懸命な仕事ぶりがうかがえる。ベルを鳴らせば気分は上々、星屑の煌めきが聖人の従者を祝福するだろう
mounts.name: スターライトスレイ
mounts.tooltip: シャンシャンシャン…

mounts.description: Manifest your wings of legacy, a spirit of legend said to favor the strong.
mounts.enhanced_description: Tonawawtan legend speaks of a spirit that favors the strong and bestows wings upon those it deems worthy. Having gifted you several arrays of wings, the being has seen fit to grace your shoulders itself in recognition of the unimaginable trials you have overcome.
mounts.name: Wings of Legacy
mounts.tooltip: I have the makings of a new verse that captures Tural's shining legacy!    - The Wandering Minstrel

mounts.description: Call into battle your Hardy-Daytona, a lore-bending battlebike that will have you feeling as though you were playing a minigame.
mounts.enhanced_description: Designed for battle, the Hardy-Daytona is propelled by a V-type double overhead camshaft engine that produces so much power, it is regarded as a monster of a machine that chooses its rider. Rumor holds it was developed by the weapons division of a mega-corporation, but the truth of its origin cannot be verified.
mounts.name: Hardy-Daytona
mounts.tooltip: Try catching us now, ya bastards!    - Burly Man

mounts.description: Manifest your wings of mist. Their eldritch aura exudes an unstoppable resolve.
mounts.enhanced_description: Found along the railroad tracks near Treno, these eldritch wings are reminiscent of the Doomtrain, the monstrous locomotive that had sped nonstop across the Mist Continent for long years. While their origin is shrouded in mystery, they exude the steely resolve of one who walks levin-ravaged wastes.
mounts.name: Wings of Mist
mounts.tooltip: It's a veritable calamity on rails.    - Eyaney

mounts.description: Summon forth your rapid-fab vacuum suit, and live the dream of piloting a futuristic bipedal machina.
mounts.enhanced_description: Created for the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, this mass-production model construction machina incorporates innovative engineering to minimize manufacturing cost without sacrificing performance. It primarily serves as a mode of transport for initiative members.
mounts.name: Rapid-fab Vacuum Suit
mounts.tooltip: We've gone ahead and licensed the design for mass production.    - Biggs

mounts.description: Call into action your alert red warp loader, and bulldoze your way through life faster.
mounts.enhanced_description: The six-wheeled warp loader, tireless workhorse of the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, has been reimagined in spirited red. Although it is identical to the original yellow variant in practically every other way, the new color scheme has proven very popular among the Loporrits.
mounts.name: Alert Red Warp Loader
mounts.tooltip: Warp loaders are simply the best!    - Cosmic Exploration Initiative Member

mounts.description: Summon forth your royal magicked carpet, and set forth to see the world shining, shimmering, splendid.
mounts.enhanced_description: According to Corvosi legend, there once lived a king who had a pari for a lover. At the monarch's behest, she wove an array of flying carpets, but his promiscuity led her to set fire to her handiworks in anger. This example was the only one to survive the blaze...or so certain peddlers might claim.
mounts.name: Royal Magicked Carpet

sources.text: Trisassant - Old Sharlayan - 100 Pieces of Corvosi Brass

mounts.tooltip: They have carpets. *Flying* carpets!    - G'raha Tia

mounts.description: Summon forth your Turali snowman, and frolic as only Ryoqor Terteh can.
mounts.enhanced_description: A snowman designed in the likeness of Ryoqor Terteh, one of the playful spirits that call Worqor Zormor home. Said spirit is known to disguise itself as a snowman in order to sneak into settlements─a trick which you can now also perform thanks to the enchantment which allows this imitation to carry a single person.
mounts.name: Turali Snowman
mounts.tooltip: Have you ever beheld such a magnificent snowman!?    - Frost Fanatic

mounts.description: Call into action your rocket punch. A ridable rocket that takes the form of a fist─or vice versa, depending on one's philosophy.
mounts.enhanced_description: This personal mode of transport assuming the form of a fist was created by Wedge of Garlond Ironworks, who went so far as to give it fully articulated fingers. While the reason for its unconventional design is unclear, it cannot be denied that it boasts a certain awe factor.
mounts.name: Rocket Punch
mounts.tooltip: I'll warm up when I throw a punch or two.    - Lyse

mounts.description: Manifest your wings of nihility. Their unsettling, tendriled form exudes the bottomless obsession of a voidsent sovereign.
mounts.enhanced_description: Found in the Unmaking, these unsettling wings are reminiscent of Enuo, the dread voidsent who had made their domain in the ocean's depths. While their origin is shrouded in mystery, only one whose inner light can repel all-consuming nothingness can hope to bear them.
mounts.name: Wings of Nihility
mounts.tooltip: All shall return to nothingness!    - Emperor Xande
